# Full page

Re-implement this UI section faithfully on your stack. Keep the CSS custom-property
names (`var(--…)`) so it stays themeable — the values below are the resolved
`beacon` theme of the **prototypes-setup-wizard-obligations-chain** design system (an ESA Ecology spoke).

- **Source prototype:** http://localhost:4399/beacon-design/prototypes/setup-wizard/obligations-chain/
- **Section element:** `<page>`
- **Components:** esa-alert-box (hub), esa-badge (hub), esa-button (hub), esa-card (hub), esa-empty-state (hub), esa-icon (hub), esa-loading-spinner (hub), esa-pill (hub)

                      "req_01M2ESMD8P1D9GP5SHAZ2ZEEXK": {
                        "code": "COA 9.2",
                        "commitment": "Designated Biologists, Fisheries Biologists, and Biological Monitors",
                        "name": "Submit Annual Biologist Reapproval List by January 31",
                        "text": "Permittee shall provide a list prior to\nJanuary 31 each year thereafter seeking annual reapproval of Designated Biologist(s), Fisheries\nBiologist(s), and Biological Monitor(s) Resume Forms indicating any changes pertaining to the\nqualifications, roles, and/or responsibilities of the Designated Biologist(s), Fisheries Biologist(s),\nand/or Biological Monitor(s) being utilized for all ongoing Project Phases.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34ZRWNWJ42W3E737QZY",
                            "name": "Submit Annual Biologist Reapproval List to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMD8P1D9GP5SHAZ2ZEEXM": {
                        "code": "COA 9.2",
                        "commitment": "Designated Biologists, Fisheries Biologists, and Biological Monitors",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval Before Replacing a Biologist or Monitor",
                        "text": "If the Designated\nBiologist(s), Fisheries Biologist(s), or Biological Monitor(s) must be changed for a given Project Phase,\nafter initiation of Covered Activities, the Permittee shall obtain CDFW approval at least five business\ndays in advance of the new individual undertaking biological monitoring activities.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34ZRWNWJ42W3E737QZX",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval of a Substitute Biologist or Monitor"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMD8P1D9GP5SHAZ2ZEEXN": {
                        "code": "COA 9.2",
                        "commitment": "Designated Biologists, Fisheries Biologists, and Biological Monitors",
                        "name": "Maintain Biological Monitor Presence During Construction",
                        "text": "The Designated\nBiologist(s) Fisheries Biologist(s), and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall be on-site during all construction\nactivities that may result in the take of Covered Species as required by Conditions of Approval in this\nITP.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDAT8XEFVPD8J1CHZG7X": {
                        "code": "COA 9.2.1",
                        "commitment": "Designated Biologist and Fisheries Biologist Qualifications",
                        "name": "Maintain Qualified Designated/Fisheries Biologist Credentials",
                        "text": "A Designated Biologist and Fisheries\nBiologist is an individual who shall have a minimum of five years of academic training and\nprofessional experience in biological sciences and related resource management activities with\nexperience monitoring, surveying for, collecting, and handling of Covered Species.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDCJSES4G0RSSPXC7J7J": {
                        "code": "COA 9.2.2",
                        "commitment": "Biological Monitor Qualifications and Duties",
                        "name": "Maintain Qualified Biological Monitor Scope of Work",
                        "text": "A Biological Monitor is an individual who shall have a minimum of four\nyears of academic and professional experience in biological sciences and related resource\nmanagement activities relevant to this project, has a minimum of six months’ experience with\nconstruction level biological monitoring, has training and the ability to recognize the Covered\nSpecies in the Project construction area, and who is familiar with the habitats and behavior of the\nCovered Species.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDCKEBRF744X854M9ESF": {
                        "code": "COA 9.2.2",
                        "commitment": "Biological Monitor Qualifications and Duties",
                        "name": "Report Daily to Designated Biologist and Flag Non-Compliance",
                        "text": "The Biological Monitor(s) shall\nreceive training and direction from the Designated Biologist(s) or Fisheries Biologist(s) for each\ntask performed, and shall communicate daily with the Designated Biologist(s) or Fisheries\nBiologist(s) and immediately report any occurrence of Covered Species within the Project\nconstruction site, as well as any apparent non-compliance with any provision of this ITP.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDEBV2KH7CJHQF9ZB8XJ": {
                        "code": "COA 9.3",
                        "commitment": "Biologist and Monitor Stop-Work Authority",
                        "name": "Provide Unfettered Biologist Access to the Project Site",
                        "text": "Permittee shall provide unfettered access to the Project Site and\notherwise facilitate the Designated Biologist in the performance of his/her duties.",
                        "type": "Other",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDEC1Q0RGFP8KGZD7JYG": {
                        "code": "COA 9.3",
                        "commitment": "Biologist and Monitor Stop-Work Authority",
                        "name": "Exercise Stop-Work Authority for Non-Compliant Activity",
                        "text": "the Designated Biologist(s),\nFisheries Biologist(s), and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall immediately stop any activity that does not\ncomply with this ITP and/or order any reasonable measure to avoid the unauthorized take of an\nindividual of the Covered Species.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDEC1Q0RGFP8KGZD7JYH": {
                        "code": "COA 9.3",
                        "commitment": "Biologist and Monitor Stop-Work Authority",
                        "name": "Notify CDFW When Unable to Comply with the ITP",
                        "text": "If the Designated\nBiologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) is unable to comply with the ITP, then the Designated\nBiologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall notify the CDFW Representative immediately.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RB67EQDRWNDJBKFW6P",
                            "name": "Notify CDFW of Inability to Comply with the ITP"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDEC1Q0RGFP8KGZD7JYJ": {
                        "code": "COA 9.3",
                        "commitment": "Biologist and Monitor Stop-Work Authority",
                        "name": "Prohibit Contracts That Restrict CDFW Communication",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not enter into any agreement or contract of any kind, including but not limited to\nnon-disclosure agreements and confidentiality agreements, with its contractors and/or the\nDesignated Biologist(s), Fisheries Biologist(s), and/or Biological Monitor(s) that prohibit or impede\nopen communication with CDFW, including but not limited to providing CDFW staff with the results\nof any surveys, reports, or studies or notifying CDFW of any non-compliance or take.",
                        "type": "Other",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDG5ZAFW7GT3S4AFYDA4": {
                        "code": "COA 9.4",
                        "commitment": "Worker Education Program",
                        "name": "Conduct Worker Education Program Before Work Begins",
                        "text": "Permittee shall conduct an education program for all persons employed or otherwise working in the\nProject Area before performing any work.",
                        "type": "Training & Education",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y40SJ78J9AJM2D416MYM",
                            "name": "Conduct Worker Education Program and Annual Refresher Training"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDG5ZAFW7GT3S4AFYDA5": {
                        "code": "COA 9.4",
                        "commitment": "Worker Education Program",
                        "name": "Repeat Worker Education Annually for Long-Term Employees",
                        "text": "This training shall be repeated at least once annually for long-term and/or permanent\nemployees that will be conducting work in the Project Area.",
                        "type": "Training & Education",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y40SJ78J9AJM2D416MYM",
                            "name": "Conduct Worker Education Program and Annual Refresher Training"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDG5ZAFW7GT3S4AFYDA6": {
                        "code": "COA 9.4",
                        "commitment": "Worker Education Program",
                        "name": "Distribute Wallet Cards or Fact Sheets to All Workers",
                        "text": "Permittee shall prepare and distribute wallet-sized cards or a fact sheet handout containing this\ninformation for all workers to carry in the Project Area.",
                        "type": "Training & Education",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDHYF867YQNWQK3NVG8W": {
                        "code": "COA 9.5",
                        "commitment": "Construction Monitoring Documentation",
                        "name": "Maintain On-Site Construction Monitoring Documentation",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s), Fisheries Biologist(s), or Biological Monitor(s) shall maintain\nconstruction-monitoring documentation on-site in either hard copy or digital format throughout the\nconstruction period, which shall include a copy of this ITP with attachments and a list of signatures of\nall personnel who have successfully completed the education program. Permittee shall ensure a copy\nof the construction-monitoring documentation is available for review at each Project construction\nsite…",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDKPBV0KRRJY304RM6H9": {
                        "code": "COA 9.6",
                        "commitment": "Trash Abatement Program",
                        "name": "Maintain Trash Abatement Program with Animal-Proof Containers",
                        "text": "Permittee shall initiate a trash abatement program before starting Covered Activities and shall\ncontinue the program for the duration of the Project. Permittee shall ensure that trash and food\nitems are contained in animal-proof containers and removed, ideally at daily intervals but at least\nonce a week, to avoid attracting opportunistic predators such as ravens, coyotes, and feral dogs.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDND6Q88AT76ZWVB5VRW": {
                        "code": "COA 9.7",
                        "commitment": "Erosion and Sediment Control",
                        "name": "Install and Maintain Erosion and Sediment Control Measures",
                        "text": "Erosion and sediment control measures shall be installed prior to earth-moving Covered Activities\nconsistent with requirements of Conditions of Approval 11.25, 11.26, and 11.27. Permittee shall\nutilize erosion and sediment control measures throughout all phases of the Project where sediment\nrunoff from exposed slopes could leave the Project construction site and/or enter an existing\ndrainage, stream, or ponded area.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6YKM817BXJNTVA76DKTZ2",
                            "name": "Install Erosion and Sediment Control Measures Before Earth-Moving"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDND6Q88AT76ZWVB5VRX": {
                        "code": "COA 9.7",
                        "commitment": "Erosion and Sediment Control",
                        "name": "Monitor Construction Sites Before, During and After Storm Events",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall monitor\neach Project construction site before, during, and after each storm event",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDND6Q88AT76ZWVB5VRY": {
                        "code": "COA 9.7",
                        "commitment": "Erosion and Sediment Control",
                        "name": "Restrict Sediment-Generating Work Ahead of Storm Onset",
                        "text": "No phase of the Project that may cause the introduction of\nsediments into a drainage, stream, or ponded area may be started if that phase and its associated\nerosion control measures cannot be completed prior to the onset of a storm (rainfall exceeding 0.5\ninch during a 24-hour period).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDQ70QCZ5B0X554ZQPFC": {
                        "code": "COA 9.8",
                        "commitment": "Delineation of Property Boundaries",
                        "name": "Delineate and Maintain Construction Site Boundary",
                        "text": "Before starting Covered Activities within a Project construction site, Permittee shall clearly delineate\nthe boundaries of the Project construction site with highly visible fencing, stakes, or flags, in each\nportion of the area that is safely accessible on foot.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37DQ86DQQR0DMG43C04",
                            "name": "Delineate habitat, buffers, and construction site boundaries"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDQ8FGD7Z8V69VMS5X55": {
                        "code": "COA 9.8",
                        "commitment": "Delineation of Property Boundaries",
                        "name": "Confine Covered Activities to Delineated Construction Sites",
                        "text": "No Project-related construction activities shall\noccur outside of the delineated Project construction sites unless approved by CDFW prior to initiation\nof Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDS4KC7YKNABBMKNV6GV": {
                        "code": "COA 9.9",
                        "commitment": "Delineation of Covered Species Habitat",
                        "name": "Delineate Covered Species Habitat and Show on Construction Plans",
                        "text": "Permittee shall clearly delineate avoidable habitat of the Covered Species within Project construction\nsites with highly visible posted signs, posting stakes, flags, and/or rope or cord, and place fencing as\nnecessary to minimize the disturbance of Covered Species’ habitat. Covered Species’ habitat, known\npopulations of the Covered Species, and jurisdictional waters shall be clearly indicated on the Project\nconstruction plans (Condition of Approval 6.2).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6YKM817BXJNTVA76DKTZ3",
                            "name": "Delineate Covered Species Habitat and Fence Construction Sites"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDS5E818E06EZYTVMJ35": {
                        "code": "COA 9.9",
                        "commitment": "Delineation of Covered Species Habitat",
                        "name": "Inspect and Maintain Habitat Fencing, Stakes and Flags",
                        "text": "Permittee shall inspect and maintain all fencing,\nstakes, and flags until the completion of Covered Activities in that area and include the location of the\nfenced, staked, or flagged areas.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDS5E818E06EZYTVMJ36": {
                        "code": "COA 9.9",
                        "commitment": "Delineation of Covered Species Habitat",
                        "name": "Verify and Document Fencing Status in Monthly Compliance Report",
                        "text": "Status of the fencing shall be verified and documented by the\nDesignated Biologist(s), Fisheries Biologist(s), or Biological Monitor(s) within the Monthly Compliance\nReport (Condition of Approval 10.15).",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R2ZP7KE7EZHM396ZJZ",
                            "name": "Submit Monthly Compliance Report to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDV1RTA9PERE8C8MBS0S": {
                        "code": "COA 9.10",
                        "commitment": "Project Access Routes",
                        "name": "Confine Site Access and Vehicle Travel to Established Routes",
                        "text": "All Project personnel shall access the Project construction site and any Project maintenance area\nusing existing and established routes identified in the Project Description and shall not cross Covered\nSpecies’ habitat outside of or enroute to the Project construction site or maintenance area unless\nauthorized by CDFW through Conditions of Approval in this ITP. All ingress/egress at the Project\nconstruction site shall be restricted to those routes identified in the Project Description.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDV2Z1D8E43SV3PA7GH9": {
                        "code": "COA 9.10",
                        "commitment": "Project Access Routes",
                        "name": "Mark Cross-Country Access Routes in the Field",
                        "text": "Cross-\ncountry access routes shall be clearly marked in the field with appropriate flagging and signs.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6YKM817BXJNTVA76DKTZ4",
                            "name": "Flag and Sign Cross-Country Access Routes"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDV2Z1D8E43SV3PA7GHA": {
                        "code": "COA 9.10",
                        "commitment": "Project Access Routes",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval Before Constructing New Travel Routes",
                        "text": "If Permittee determines construction of routes for travel are necessary outside of the Project\nconstruction site, the Designated Representative shall contact CDFW for written approval before\ncarrying out such an activity.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34X89RDDJZVZVMK8Y0P",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval to Construct Off-Site Travel Routes"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDWX0TGCJRKPXWPA79HX": {
                        "code": "COA 9.11",
                        "commitment": "Staging Areas",
                        "name": "Confine Staging and Laydown to Disturbed Areas Within the Site",
                        "text": "Permittee shall confine all Project-related parking, storage areas, laydown sites, equipment storage,\nand any other surface-disturbing activities to the Project construction site using, to the extent\npossible, previously disturbed areas such as paved or previously cleared areas. Staging areas shall be\nidentified within the appropriate Project Phase Authorization Package.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDWYWKYNTP6J9K2FJE2J": {
                        "code": "COA 9.11",
                        "commitment": "Staging Areas",
                        "name": "Store Equipment and Vehicles 200 Feet from Aquatic Habitat",
                        "text": "Permittee shall store\nequipment, supplies, and vehicles, and conduct vehicle and equipment services within the Project\nconstruction site at least 200 feet from suitable Covered Species aquatic habitat and/or other\ndesignated staging/storage areas.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDWYWKYNTP6J9K2FJE2K": {
                        "code": "COA 9.11",
                        "commitment": "Staging Areas",
                        "name": "Confine Activity to the Marked Site, Avoiding Covered Species Habitat",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not use or cross Covered Species'\nhabitat outside of the marked Project construction site unless authorized by CDFW consistent with\nCondition of Approval 9.10.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDYRSCC4TRN3XVY6KGWC": {
                        "code": "COA 9.12",
                        "commitment": "Vehicle and Equipment Inspection for Invasive Species",
                        "name": "Inspect and Clean Equipment and Vessels for Invasive Species",
                        "text": "Permittee shall inspect all equipment, including marine vessels, used for construction and habitat\ncreation, enhancement, and management for invasive terrestrial and aquatic plant and animal\nspecies prior to entering work areas, when moving from one work area to another, and when\nentering Covered Species terrestrial and aquatic habitats. Permittee shall remove mud and/or\naccumulated soils from equipment and vehicles to the maximum extent practicable. Vehicles and\nequipment shall be cleaned or…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCR7",
                            "name": "Clean and decontaminate equipment at each work site"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMDYRSCC4TRN3XVY6KGWD": {
                        "code": "COA 9.12",
                        "commitment": "Vehicle and Equipment Inspection for Invasive Species",
                        "name": "Inspect Idle Vehicles and Equipment for Wildlife Before Moving",
                        "text": "Vehicles and equipment shall be visually\ninspected by the Designated Biologist(s), Fisheries Biologist(s), and/or Biological Monitor(s) before\nbeing moved if they have been idle and/or unoccupied for 30 minutes or longer. If an individual of a\nCovered Species is present, the worker shall wait for the Covered Species to move unimpeded to a\nsafe location. Alternatively, the Designated Biologist(s) or Fisheries Biologist(s) shall be contacted to\ndetermine if the individual may be safely moved…",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESME0G47Q8BCWPAWVMG2J8": {
                        "code": "COA 9.13",
                        "commitment": "Refueling and Maintenance Controls",
                        "name": "Daily Inspect and Maintain Vehicles to Prevent Contaminant Release",
                        "text": "Any equipment or vehicles driven and/or operated in or adjacent to Project construction sites shall\nbe checked daily and maintained in good working order to prevent the release of contaminants that,\nif introduced to water, could be deleterious to aquatic life, wildlife, or riparian habitat. If a vehicle is\nfound to be leaking fluids of any kind, it shall be placed into secondary containment immediately.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESME0G47Q8BCWPAWVMG2J9": {
                        "code": "COA 9.13",
                        "commitment": "Refueling and Maintenance Controls",
                        "name": "Contain and Attend Vehicle Refueling Operations",
                        "text": "Vehicles shall be kept away from all sensitive areas and positioned over drip pans or other suitable\nsecondary containment prior to refueling.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESME0HFZBS8WNTW5P7481F": {
                        "code": "COA 9.13",
                        "commitment": "Refueling and Maintenance Controls",
                        "name": "Keep Refueling, Maintenance and Fuel Storage 200 Feet from Water",
                        "text": "All\nreserve fuel supplies shall be stored only within the confines of the designated staging areas, a\nminimum of 200 feet from surface waters and other sensitive habitats, such as wetlands.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESME28WH6M351CX8A8P93C": {
                        "code": "COA 9.14",
                        "commitment": "Hazardous Waste Spill Response",
                        "name": "Implement CDFW-Approved Hazardous Materials Management Plan",
                        "text": "Permittee shall implement\nthe CDFW approved hazardous materials management plan (Condition of Approval 11.21) for each\nProject construction site and Project Phase.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCR8",
                            "name": "Prepare the hazardous materials management plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESME28WH6M351CX8A8P93D": {
                        "code": "COA 9.14",
                        "commitment": "Hazardous Waste Spill Response",
                        "name": "Immediately Stop and Clean Up Fuel and Hazardous Waste Spills",
                        "text": "Permittee shall immediately stop and, pursuant to pertinent state and federal statutes and\nregulations, arrange for repair and clean up by qualified individuals of any fuel or hazardous waste\nleaks or spills at the time of occurrence, or as soon as it is safe to do so.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESME404SWG6PS2ESE8KYH7": {
                        "code": "COA 9.15",
                        "commitment": "CDFW Access to Project and Mitigation Lands",
                        "name": "Provide CDFW Access to Project and Mitigation Lands",
                        "text": "Permittee shall provide CDFW staff with reasonable access to the Project and mitigation lands under\nPermittee control and shall otherwise fully cooperate with CDFW efforts to verify compliance with\nthe Project Description, evaluation of effects on Covered Species and their habitats, and compliance\nwith or effectiveness of minimization and mitigation measures set forth in this ITP.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESME5SZR3H6JG2521K9KK5": {
                        "code": "COA 9.16",
                        "commitment": "No Disturbance of CDFW Conserved and Managed Lands",
                        "name": "Prohibit Surface Disturbance of CDFW Conserved and Managed Lands",
                        "text": "During the entirety of the Project’s preconstruction, construction, and operations phases, Permittee\nshall not disturb the surface ground of CDFW’s existing conserved and managed lands, namely the\nBethany Reservoir Conservation Easement, Woodbridge Ecological Reserve, Cosumnes River\nEcological Reserve, or any adjacent lands protected by CDFW such as Christensen Road Burrowing\nOwl Site.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESME7HX3P38N1DXDK3KCVC": {
                        "code": "COA 9.16.1",
                        "commitment": "Conservation Easement 50-Foot Buffer",
                        "name": "Maintain 50-Foot Buffer at Bethany Complex Conservation Easements",
                        "text": "Permittee shall implement a minimum buffer\nof no less than 50 feet between Covered Activities within the Bethany Complex and adjacent\nconservation easements to minimize impacts to Covered Species.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESME9BSX73B5K904W1AMCF": {
                        "code": "COA 9.17",
                        "commitment": "Refuse Removal on Completion",
                        "name": "Remove Temporary Fill and Construction Refuse on Completion",
                        "text": "Upon completion of Covered Activities, Permittee shall remove from the Project construction site and\nproperly dispose of all temporary fill and construction refuse, including, but not limited to, broken\nequipment parts, wrapping material, cords, cables, wire, rope, strapping, twine, buckets, metal or\nplastic containers, and boxes.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6YKM817BXJNTVA76DKTZ6",
                            "name": "Remove Temporary Fill and Construction Refuse at Completion"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMEB3JEW0AY0NARFBHQMP": {
                        "code": "COA 9.18",
                        "commitment": "Wildfire Prevention at Bethany Complex",
                        "name": "Keep Basic Fire Suppression Supplies On Site at Bethany Complex",
                        "text": "Permittee shall keep basic fire suppression supplies on site at all times during construction of the\nBethany Complex or while undertaking maintenance activities within the Bethany Complex.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMEB3JEW0AY0NARFBHQMQ": {
                        "code": "COA 9.18",
                        "commitment": "Wildfire Prevention at Bethany Complex",
                        "name": "Hand Clear Vegetation for Fire Prevention, Timed to Surveys and Exclusion Barriers",
                        "text": "Hand\nremoval of vegetation and/or weed whacking are the authorized methods for vegetation removal\nalong access roads, staging areas, and work areas within the Bethany Complex prior to allowing\nheavy equipment and vehicles to access these project sites after Covered Species preconstruction\nsurveys and installment of wildlife exclusion barriers.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMEB3JEW0AY0NARFBHQMR": {
                        "code": "COA 9.18",
                        "commitment": "Wildfire Prevention at Bethany Complex",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval for Mowing, Disking or Tilling as Fire Prevention",
                        "text": "Mowing may be permitted with CDFW approval\nfollowing preconstruction surveys. Disking and/or tilling shall not be permitted for fire prevention\nwithout prior written approval from CDFW.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34WE7XE98281ZXQVPK8",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval of Mowing or Clearing Equipment"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMEB3JEW0AY0NARFBHQMS": {
                        "code": "COA 9.18",
                        "commitment": "Wildfire Prevention at Bethany Complex",
                        "name": "Clear Non-Living Vegetative Debris from the Work Footprint",
                        "text": "Non-living vegetative debris shall be cleared from around\nthe immediate work footprint.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMECVYQSPE08483H5P0ET": {
                        "code": "COA 10.1",
                        "commitment": "Notification Before Commencement",
                        "name": "Notify CDFW 14 Days Before Starting Covered Activities",
                        "text": "The Designated Representative shall notify CDFW 14 calendar days before starting Covered Activities\nwithin a Project construction site in an approved Phase (Condition of Approval 6.2) or Project\noperations (Condition of Approval 7.2).",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R2ZP7KE7EZHM396ZJY",
                            "name": "Notify CDFW 14 Days Before Starting Covered Activities"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMEEMEXGEGREP1K279WSX": {
                        "code": "COA 10.2",
                        "commitment": "Notification of Non-compliance",
                        "name": "Notify and Report Non-Compliance with the ITP to CDFW",
                        "text": "The Designated Representative shall immediately notify CDFW if the Permittee is not in compliance\nwith any Condition of Approval of this ITP, including but not limited to any actual or anticipated\nfailure to implement measures within the time periods indicated in this ITP and/or the MMRP. The\nDesignated Representative shall follow up within 24 hours with a written report to CDFW describing,\nin detail, any non-compliance with this ITP and suggested measures to remedy the situation.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RB67EQDRWNDJBKFW6N",
                            "name": "Report ITP Non-Compliance to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMEGDMF3XE1YW7BYGW6H7": {
                        "code": "COA 10.3",
                        "commitment": "Tracking Habitat Feature Disturbances and GIS Reporting",
                        "name": "Maintain GIS Layers Tracking Land and Habitat Feature Disturbance",
                        "text": "Permittee shall maintain Geographic Information System (GIS) shapefile layers and associated maps\ndepicting: 1) mapped areas of all land disturbances within each Project construction site; and 2)\nmapped areas of disturbed identified habitat features suitable for Covered Species (see Condition of\nApproval 10.4 for habitat features) within the Project construction site. Permittee shall maintain the\nGIS layers and metadata for those maps and update the GIS layers and maps if there are any…",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMEGDMF3XE1YW7BYGW6H8": {
                        "code": "COA 10.3",
                        "commitment": "Tracking Habitat Feature Disturbances and GIS Reporting",
                        "name": "Photo-Document Habitat Areas Before Covered Activities Begin",
                        "text": "Permittee shall maintain this tracking formatted in GIS that includes\nphoto documentation of the habitat feature that was conducted no more than 14 days prior to\ninitiation of Covered Activities. The photo documentation shall provide a visual representation of the\nProject construction site and include a minimum of five photographs showing each distinct habitat\narea: one taken each from the North, South, East, and West and facing the habitat area. Permittee\nshall include separate photo…",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3XZ7WK0185QGKR0185W",
                            "name": "Complete Pre-Disturbance Habitat Photo Documentation"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMEGEH6VF63EFMK7NHEGK": {
                        "code": "COA 10.3",
                        "commitment": "Tracking Habitat Feature Disturbances and GIS Reporting",
                        "name": "Attach GIS Layers and Metadata to the Monthly Compliance Report",
                        "text": "Permittee shall provide GIS layers and the associated metadata (description and purpose of each\ndataset or layer, creation and last updated dates, geoprocessing history/GIS methodology to create\nthe data layer, descriptions of unclear attribute fields, data layer, data quality (if applicable), contact\ninformation, and any other pertinent information), to CDFW attached to the Monthly Compliance\nReport (Condition of Approval 10.12). Permittee shall also provide up-to-date GIS layers of…",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R8HSR7K069ZM5EZCXX",
                            "name": "Report Habitat Disturbance Acreage and GIS Layers to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMEGEH6VF63EFMK7NHEGM": {
                        "code": "COA 10.3",
                        "commitment": "Tracking Habitat Feature Disturbances and GIS Reporting",
                        "name": "Summarize Habitat Disturbance and Update Maps with the Annual Status Report",
                        "text": "Permittee shall also maintain maps for each Covered Species separately and shall include updates to\nany of the maps along with a summation of all disturbance to identified habitat features annually at\nthe time of Annual Status Report submission (Condition of Approval 10.13).",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R8HSR7K069ZM5EZCXX",
                            "name": "Report Habitat Disturbance Acreage and GIS Layers to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMEJ50ANJZ1WRG9NY1TNR": {
                        "code": "COA 10.4",
                        "commitment": "Suitable Habitat Monitoring Features by Species",
                        "name": "Track and Map Suitable Habitat Features by Species",
                        "text": "Permittee shall track suitable habitat for the Covered Species in each Project construction site and\nsurrounding species-specific buffers.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMEKX08QZ22RBTX3WH5T9": {
                        "code": "COA 10.5",
                        "commitment": "Reporting Approved Habitat Maps",
                        "name": "Report Habitat Disturbance Acreages to CDFW",
                        "text": "Permittee shall document the cumulatively disturbed acreages of identified habitat suitable for each\nCovered Species within the Project Area, as well as acreages of identified habitat features anticipated\nto be disturbed over the succeeding 30 days, using the data maintained according to Condition of\nApproval 10.4.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R8HSR7K069ZM5EZCXX",
                            "name": "Report Habitat Disturbance Acreage and GIS Layers to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMENP1CJ80TQ2PM1VM14P": {
                        "code": "COA 10.6",
                        "commitment": "Photo Monitoring Stations",
                        "name": "Photograph Impact Areas Before and During Construction",
                        "text": "At least one photograph shall be taken at all stations prior to construction activities, and\neach month thereafter until construction and initial restoration is complete.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H41AKKXC7WAC4X6PQN",
                            "name": "Conduct Photo Monitoring of Temporary Impact Areas"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMENP1CJ80TQ2PM1VM14Q": {
                        "code": "COA 10.6",
                        "commitment": "Photo Monitoring Stations",
                        "name": "Document Restoration Success with Quarterly Photos",
                        "text": "Photo\ndocumentation of restoration success as defined in the Restoration and Revegetation Plan\n(Condition of Approval 12.3.3) shall occur every three months following the initial\nrestoration until restoration success is reached.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H41AKKXC7WAC4X6PQN",
                            "name": "Conduct Photo Monitoring of Temporary Impact Areas"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMENP1CJ80TQ2PM1VM14R": {
                        "code": "COA 10.6",
                        "commitment": "Photo Monitoring Stations",
                        "name": "Submit Photo Monitoring with Compliance Reports",
                        "text": "Photo monitoring obtained for Project elements resulting in temporary impacts shall be provided for\neach calendar month with the Monthly Compliance Report (Condition of Approval 10.12) and all\nphoto monitoring shall be included with the Annual Status Report (Condition of Approval 10.13).",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R99JZNVA7RWDTVTCW2",
                            "name": "Submit Photo Monitoring Documentation Report"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMEQFTWDF4BPXFH799KTB": {
                        "code": "COA 10.7",
                        "commitment": "Species Observations Outside of Mapped Habitat",
                        "name": "Email CDFW of Covered Species Sightings Within One Day",
                        "text": "Any sightings of Covered\nSpecies throughout the entirety of the Project construction site before or during construction work,\nincluding dewatering, shall be reported to CDFW via email within one working day of the discovery.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R8HSR7K069ZM5EZCXS",
                            "name": "Report Covered Species Sightings to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMEQGNEXHJ6WJ7QGSE8T9": {
                        "code": "COA 10.7",
                        "commitment": "Species Observations Outside of Mapped Habitat",
                        "name": "Apply Avoidance Measures to Unmapped Species Occurrences",
                        "text": "If a Covered Species occurrence(s) is observed within a Project construction site outside of the\nmodeled habitat areas shown in Attachment 5, all avoidance and minimization requirements that are\napplicable to the Covered Species shall apply and Permittee shall consult with CDFW regarding the\nneed for additional avoidance, minimization, or mitigation measures.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMES8P77HCP3S39H7JS57": {
                        "code": "COA 10.8",
                        "commitment": "Habitat Evaluation Field Survey for Covered Species",
                        "name": "Conduct Preconstruction Habitat Evaluation Field Survey",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) shall conduct a field survey and identify suitable habitat for each Covered\nSpecies in areas within the planned Project construction site and within 1,300 feet from the Project\nconstruction site consistent with the largest no-disturbance buffer for Covered Species (see Condition\nof Approval 11.85), where accessible.",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3XZ7WK0185QGKR0185X",
                            "name": "Conduct Habitat Evaluation Field Survey"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMES8P77HCP3S39H7JS58": {
                        "code": "COA 10.8",
                        "commitment": "Habitat Evaluation Field Survey for Covered Species",
                        "name": "Submit Habitat Survey Results in Authorization Package",
                        "text": "Permittee shall include all initial preconstruction field survey\nresults to CDFW in the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.2) and identify the spatial extent of suitable habitat for each Covered Species as well as the total\narea surveyed by the Designated Biologist(s).",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RA6HTPQEBMJTM46QTN",
                            "name": "Submit Preconstruction Habitat Survey Results in the Phase Package"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMES8P77HCP3S39H7JS59": {
                        "code": "COA 10.8",
                        "commitment": "Habitat Evaluation Field Survey for Covered Species",
                        "name": "Apply Avoidance Measures to Unmapped Suitable Habitat",
                        "text": "Any suitable habitat not included in the species’ modeled habitat within the Project construction site\nthat will be impacted by Covered Activities shall be subject to the same avoidance and minimization\nrequirements for the Covered Species.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMEV1NQSW0M2DXK8JVMJB": {
                        "code": "COA 10.9",
                        "commitment": "Tracking Temporary and Permanent Impacts",
                        "name": "Track Temporary and Permanent Impacts by Project Phase",
                        "text": "Permittee shall track temporary and permanent impacts accumulated as a result of Covered Activities\nwithin each Project Phase.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMEV1NQSW0M2DXK8JVMJC": {
                        "code": "COA 10.9",
                        "commitment": "Tracking Temporary and Permanent Impacts",
                        "name": "Notify CDFW of Likely Impact Exceedance",
                        "text": "Permittee shall notify CDFW if the level of impacts as tracked in the Annual Status Report (Condition of Approval 10.13) is likely to exceed the expected permanent and\ntemporary impacts for each Covered Species as approved by CDFW in the appropriate Construction\nPhase Authorization Package (Condition of Approval 6) and/or Phase 2 Authorization Package\n(Condition of Approval 7).",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RB67EQDRWNDJBKFW6M",
                            "name": "Notify CDFW of Likely Impact Exceedance and Revised Schedule"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMEV1NQSW0M2DXK8JVMJD": {
                        "code": "COA 10.9",
                        "commitment": "Tracking Temporary and Permanent Impacts",
                        "name": "Submit Revised Phase Schedule After Exceedance Notice",
                        "text": "Permittee shall submit an appropriately revised Project Phase schedule\n(see Conditions of Approval 6.2 and7.1) within 10 business days of the notification to ensure\ntemporary impacts remain within the temporary impact criteria according to Conditions of Approval\n11.66 and 12.3.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RB67EQDRWNDJBKFW6M",
                            "name": "Notify CDFW of Likely Impact Exceedance and Revised Schedule"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMEWT6ZZDZ4V47ZTC9YBS": {
                        "code": "COA 10.10",
                        "commitment": "Daily Compliance Monitoring and Inspection Records",
                        "name": "Conduct Daily Compliance Inspections at Each Site",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall be present at each Project construction\nsite and during each maintenance activity, each day, to conduct compliance inspections at a\nminimum of one inspection daily, after periods of inactivity prior to initiating work, and after clearing,\ngrubbing, and grading are completed.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMEWT6ZZDZ4V47ZTC9YBT": {
                        "code": "COA 10.10",
                        "commitment": "Daily Compliance Monitoring and Inspection Records",
                        "name": "Prepare Daily Written Inspection Records",
                        "text": "The Designated Representative or Designated Biologist(s) shall prepare daily written observation and\ninspection records, including photo-documentation records (Condition of Approval 10.6),\nsummarizing oversight activities and compliance inspections, observations of Covered Species and\ntheir sign, survey results, dates of Covered Activity and inactivity, and monitoring activities required\nby this ITP.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMEYQKN0BMMHCSCGJAM12": {
                        "code": "COA 10.11",
                        "commitment": "Environmental Compliance Monitoring Plan",
                        "name": "Develop Environmental Compliance Monitoring Plan",
                        "text": "Permittee shall develop an Environmental Compliance Monitoring Plan (ECMP) for each Project\nconstruction site and include any proposed Project facilities maintenance activities to monitor,\nenforce, and document measures to protect Covered Species and their habitats, designated critical\nhabitat, and sensitive natural communities.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NH29YN1B50VPENFKBD",
                            "name": "Develop Environmental Compliance Monitoring Plan per Site"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMF0PKSGVSRBAB5339S9M": {
                        "code": "COA 10.12",
                        "commitment": "Monthly Compliance Report",
                        "name": "Compile and Submit Monthly Compliance Report",
                        "text": "The Designated Representative or Designated Biologist shall compile the observation and inspection\nrecords identified in Condition of Approval 10.10 into a Monthly Compliance Report and submit it to\nCDFW along with a copy of the MMRP table with notes showing the current implementation status of\neach mitigation measure.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R2ZP7KE7EZHM396ZJZ",
                            "name": "Submit Monthly Compliance Report to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMF2JKWGK226B0XNDKRFC": {
                        "code": "COA 10.13",
                        "commitment": "Annual Status Report",
                        "name": "Deliver Annual Status Report by January 31",
                        "text": "Permittee shall provide CDFW with an Annual Status Report no later than January 31 of every year\nbeginning the year after issuance of this ITP and continuing until CDFW accepts the Final Mitigation\nReport identified below.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R3GHBSN2G09CZKZQ72",
                            "name": "Deliver Annual Status Report to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMF4D5N9ER94Y6T84ZHQW": {
                        "code": "COA 10.14",
                        "commitment": "CNDDB Observation Submittals",
                        "name": "Submit Species Observations to CNDDB Within 60 Days",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall submit all observations of Covered\nSpecies to CDFW’s California Natural Diversity Database (CNDDB) during preconstruction,\nconstruction, operations, and maintenance activities within 60 calendar days of the observation",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R5TVSWTRCYD79ASQ4C",
                            "name": "Submit Covered Species Observations to CNDDB"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMF4D5N9ER94Y6T84ZHQX": {
                        "code": "COA 10.14",
                        "commitment": "CNDDB Observation Submittals",
                        "name": "Include CNDDB Forms with Next Compliance Report",
                        "text": "the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall include copies of the submitted forms\nwith the next Monthly Compliance Report (Condition of Approval 10.12) or Annual Status Report\n(Condition of Approval 10.13), whichever is submitted first relative to the observation.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R5TVSWTRCYD79ASQ4C",
                            "name": "Submit Covered Species Observations to CNDDB"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMF66E2240EKD6VJ291QY": {
                        "code": "COA 10.15",
                        "commitment": "Final Mitigation Report",
                        "name": "Deliver Final Phase Mitigation Report After Phase Completion",
                        "text": "Permittee shall provide CDFW with Final Phase Mitigation Reports no later than 45 days after\ncompletion of Covered Activities and all mitigation measures for each Project Phase and after\nCovered Activities and all mitigation measures for all Project Phases are complete.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R6NBY4JTT233FQYDT9",
                            "name": "Deliver Final Phase Mitigation Report to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMF7XVAKBFM66763ENDSK": {
                        "code": "COA 10.15.1",
                        "commitment": "Mitigation Status Report Before ITP Expiration",
                        "name": "Deliver Mitigation Status Report Before ITP Expiration",
                        "text": "Ninety days prior to the expiration of this ITP, Permittee shall\nprovide CDFW with a Mitigation Status Report.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R7PYV1TN3PG7JYE8R0",
                            "name": "Deliver Mitigation Status Report Before ITP Expiration"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMF9PFFTXCX5ZD1XJ6RT3": {
                        "code": "COA 10.16",
                        "commitment": "Notification of Take or Injury/Damage",
                        "name": "Notify Biologist Immediately of Take or Injury",
                        "text": "Permittee shall immediately notify the Designated Biologist(s), Fisheries Biologist(s), and/or Biological\nMonitor(s) if a Covered Species is taken or injured/damaged by a Covered Activity, or if a Covered\nSpecies is otherwise found dead or injured/damaged within the vicinity of the Project.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R8HSR7K069ZM5EZCXN",
                            "name": "Notify the Designated Biologist of Covered Species Take or Injury"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMF9PFFTXCX5ZD1XJ6RT4": {
                        "code": "COA 10.16",
                        "commitment": "Notification of Take or Injury/Damage",
                        "name": "Call CDFW with Initial Take or Injury Notification",
                        "text": "The\nDesignated Biologist(s) or Permittee’s Designated Representative shall provide initial notification to\nCDFW by calling the CDFW Bay-Delta Region Stockton Office at (209) 234-3420.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R7PYV1TN3PG7JYE8R1",
                            "name": "Report Covered Species Take or Injury to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMF9PFFTXCX5ZD1XJ6RT5": {
                        "code": "COA 10.16",
                        "commitment": "Notification of Take or Injury/Damage",
                        "name": "Send Written Take Report to CDFW Within Two Days",
                        "text": "Following initial notification,\nPermittee shall send CDFW a written report within two business days.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R7PYV1TN3PG7JYE8R1",
                            "name": "Report Covered Species Take or Injury to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFBFFQB6W6S2SBSGX16J": {
                        "code": "COA 10.17",
                        "commitment": "Subsurface Vibratory Testing and Monitoring Study",
                        "name": "Develop Draft Subsurface Vibration Study Plan",
                        "text": "Permittee shall develop, in coordination with CDFW, a draft Subsurface Testing and Monitoring Study\nPlan to investigate thresholds and effects of subsurface vibrations on fossorial species (CTS, GGS, and\nCBB) behavior and overall health, prior to the initiation of Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NH29YN1B50VPENFKBE",
                            "name": "Submit Subsurface Testing and Monitoring Study Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFBG0N35H82TF02GZ3ZK": {
                        "code": "COA 10.17",
                        "commitment": "Subsurface Vibratory Testing and Monitoring Study",
                        "name": "Submit Final Study Plan One Year Before Ground Disturbance",
                        "text": "Permittee shall work collaboratively\nwith CDFW to incorporate comments into the draft Study Plan and submit the final Study Plan to\nCDFW for review and approval a minimum of one year prior to initiating any ground-disturbing\nactivities within fossorial Covered Species habitat.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NH29YN1B50VPENFKBE",
                            "name": "Submit Subsurface Testing and Monitoring Study Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFBG0N35H82TF02GZ3ZM": {
                        "code": "COA 10.17",
                        "commitment": "Subsurface Vibratory Testing and Monitoring Study",
                        "name": "Implement Approved Vibration Study Before Covered Activities",
                        "text": "Permittee shall implement the CDFW-approved\nStudy Plan prior to initiating Covered Activities within a Project site containing CTS, GGS, or CBB\nsuitable habitat",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H29GVGPNMNFZ3NX9WZ",
                            "name": "Implement CDFW-Approved Subsurface Vibration Study"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFBG0N35H82TF02GZ3ZN": {
                        "code": "COA 10.17",
                        "commitment": "Subsurface Vibratory Testing and Monitoring Study",
                        "name": "Submit Vibration Study Results in Construction Phase Package",
                        "text": "and shall submit the results of the Study with suggested vibratory monitoring\nprotocols for fossorial Covered Species to CDFW as part of the appropriate Construction Phase\nAuthorization Package.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RA6HTPQEBMJTM46QTQ",
                            "name": "Submit Subsurface Vibration Study Results to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFDD89X51ER81SA5A47W": {
                        "code": "COA 10.18",
                        "commitment": "Covered Fish Species Monitoring and Science Plan",
                        "name": "Develop Draft Covered Fish Species Monitoring and Science Plan",
                        "text": "Within twelve months of permit issuance, Permittee shall, in coordination with CDFW, initiate\ndevelopment of a draft Covered Fish Species Monitoring and Science Plan for CDFW review.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NJADVCJBHXD7RXW12B",
                            "name": "Submit Covered Fish Species Monitoring and Science Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFDD89X51ER81SA5A47X": {
                        "code": "COA 10.18",
                        "commitment": "Covered Fish Species Monitoring and Science Plan",
                        "name": "Submit Final Fish Monitoring Plan for CDFW Approval",
                        "text": "Permittee shall submit a final draft plan to CDFW for review no less than six months prior to the first deadline established in the plan and no less than five years before initiation of in-water construction\nCovered Activities.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NJADVCJBHXD7RXW12B",
                            "name": "Submit Covered Fish Species Monitoring and Science Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFDD89X51ER81SA5A47Y": {
                        "code": "COA 10.18",
                        "commitment": "Covered Fish Species Monitoring and Science Plan",
                        "name": "Conduct Covered Fish Species Monitoring Across Project Phases",
                        "text": "Permittee shall initiate Covered Fish Species monitoring and science\nactivities prior to Project in-water construction and shall continue Covered Fish Species monitoring\nand science activities throughout Project construction and operations (Phase 1 Operations and Phase 2 Operations).",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H3KQ2JH8QCYXWA8G3K",
                            "name": "Implement Covered Fish Species Monitoring and Science Program"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFDD89X51ER81SA5A47Z": {
                        "code": "COA 10.18",
                        "commitment": "Covered Fish Species Monitoring and Science Plan",
                        "name": "Report Aquatic Conditions in Phase 2 Package and Final Report",
                        "text": "Permittee shall include assessments of aquatic conditions in each monitoring time period described\nbelow in the Phase 2 Operations Authorization Package (Condition of Approval 7.1) and the Final\nMitigation Report following completion of Phase 2 Operations (Condition of Approval 10.15) to\nfacilitate CDFW evaluation of changes in aquatic conditions throughout Project construction and\noperations.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RA6HTPQEBMJTM46QTT",
                            "name": "Submit Aquatic Conditions Assessments with the Phase 2 Package"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFF83ZDJRVZFNX2DKF42": {
                        "code": "COA 10.18.1",
                        "commitment": "Monitoring Plan and Report Review and Finalization Process",
                        "name": "Adhere to CDFW Review Process for Fish Study Plans and Reports",
                        "text": "Permittee shall submit draft plans to CDFW for review according to the timelines in the\nCDFW-approved Covered Fish Species Monitoring and Science Plan, and as specified in each\nCondition of Approval.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34TCYX1R0179FZ33YWM",
                            "name": "Submit Fish Study Plans and Reports for CDFW Approval"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFGZ8HC07KDBN51TGSY5": {
                        "code": "COA 10.18.2",
                        "commitment": "Long-term Purpose of Fish Monitoring and Studies",
                        "name": "Evaluate Fish Monitoring Results Against Biological Criteria",
                        "text": "Permittee shall work\ncollaboratively with CDFW to use the results from science and monitoring required in Conditions\nof Approval 10.18, 10.19, 10.20, 10.21, 10.26, and 10.27 to 1) ensure that impacts to Covered Fish\nSpecies during Phase 2 Operations do not exceed Covered Fish Species Biological Criteria, and 2)\nprepare for future regulatory processes that may address long-term authorizations for Project\noperations.",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFJP84FPQ8WD96C79HB3": {
                        "code": "COA 10.18.3",
                        "commitment": "Alternative Operating Criteria for Hydrograph Limbs",
                        "name": "Evaluate Hydrograph Limb Impacts on Covered Fish Species",
                        "text": "By 2030, Permittee shall, in coordination with CDFW,\nuse best available science and information gained from studies required by this ITP (Conditions of\nApproval 10.18, 10.19, 10.20, and 10.21) to evaluate differences in impacts to Covered Fish\nSpecies in January and February between ascending and descending limbs of the Sacramento\nRiver hydrograph.",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y32EX2B7J0Q0QX2WW1TN",
                            "name": "Complete Sacramento River Hydrograph Limb Impact Evaluation"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFJQSEEGPYZYE6WVCX4G": {
                        "code": "COA 10.18.3",
                        "commitment": "Alternative Operating Criteria for Hydrograph Limbs",
                        "name": "Consult CDFW on ITP Amendment for Alternative Operating Criteria",
                        "text": "Permittee shall consult with\nCDFW if it seeks to amend the ITP (Condition of Approval 8) to modify Conditions of Approval\n11.111 and 11.111.2.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34V8WHD9WZSVEXW30W6",
                            "name": "Notify and Consult CDFW on ITP Amendment Conditions"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFMEJXZM1HVYK3XV5PQT": {
                        "code": "COA 10.19",
                        "commitment": "Fisheries Evaluation Studies",
                        "name": "Conduct Fisheries Evaluation Studies for Covered Fish Species",
                        "text": "Permittee shall conduct Fisheries Evaluation Studies to characterize baseline conditions and\nuncertainties regarding the effects of Covered Activities (construction, operations, and maintenance)\non Covered Fish Species.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H3KQ2JH8QCYXWA8G3M",
                            "name": "Conduct Fisheries Evaluation Studies for Covered Fish"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFP7PJEEVSGSWXDT8J8C": {
                        "code": "COA 10.19.1",
                        "commitment": "Migration and Survival Study",
                        "name": "Develop Migration and Survival Study Plan",
                        "text": "Permittee shall, in collaboration with CDFW, develop a\nMigration and Survival Study Plan to 1) assess the baseline behavior and survival of CHNWR,\nCHNSR, and WS in river reaches potentially impacted by Project construction and operation and 2) evaluate changes to baseline conditions established during In-water Preconstruction Baseline\nMonitoring as the Project is implemented during In-water Construction Monitoring, Phase 1\nOperations Monitoring, and Phase 2 Operations Monitoring.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NJADVCJBHXD7RXW12C",
                            "name": "Develop Migration and Survival Study Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFP7PJEEVSGSWXDT8J8D": {
                        "code": "COA 10.19.1",
                        "commitment": "Migration and Survival Study",
                        "name": "Fund and Implement Migration and Survival Telemetry Study",
                        "text": "Permittee shall fund and initiate the\nCDFW-approved study plan as informed by the final Covered Fish Species Monitoring and Science\nPlan (Condition of Approval 10.18).",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H3KQ2JH8QCYXWA8G3M",
                            "name": "Conduct Fisheries Evaluation Studies for Covered Fish"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFR2KXGWDWNPQA65Y5SW": {
                        "code": "COA 10.19.2",
                        "commitment": "Predation Study",
                        "name": "Develop Predation Study Plan",
                        "text": "Permittee shall, in collaboration with CDFW, develop a Predation Study\nPlan to assess the baseline risk of predation to DS, LFS, CHNWR, CHNSR, and WS in river reaches\npotentially impacted by Project construction and operations, including areas immediately\nadjacent to the north Delta intakes.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NJADVCJBHXD7RXW12D",
                            "name": "Develop Predation Study Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFR2KXGWDWNPQA65Y5SX": {
                        "code": "COA 10.19.2",
                        "commitment": "Predation Study",
                        "name": "Capture, Tag, and Survey Predatory Fish Distribution",
                        "text": "Permittee shall employ several methods, as approved by CDFW, to capture predatory fish and\nretain a subsample for diet analysis. Permittee shall tag predatory fish with acoustic transmitters\ncompatible with the dominant concurrently installed acoustic array within the Delta and pursuant\nto the Migration and Survival Study.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H3KQ2JH8QCYXWA8G3M",
                            "name": "Conduct Fisheries Evaluation Studies for Covered Fish"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFR2KXGWDWNPQA65Y5SY": {
                        "code": "COA 10.19.2",
                        "commitment": "Predation Study",
                        "name": "Measure Predation Rate on Covered Fish Species",
                        "text": "Permittee shall use the following approaches to measure predation, unless otherwise approved in\nwriting by CDFW:",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H3KQ2JH8QCYXWA8G3M",
                            "name": "Conduct Fisheries Evaluation Studies for Covered Fish"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFSVPYFXAKH7EGNG5276": {
                        "code": "COA 10.19.3",
                        "commitment": "Abundance and Distribution Study",
                        "name": "Develop Covered Fish Species Abundance and Distribution Study Plan",
