                        "text": "develop a\nCovered Fish Species Abundance and Distribution Study Plan to assess the baseline densities and\nseasonal and geographic distribution of all life stages of DS, LFS, CHNWR, CHNSR, and WS in river\nreaches potentially impacted by Project construction and operations",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NJADVCJBHXD7RXW12E",
                            "name": "Develop Covered Fish Species Abundance and Distribution Study Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFSWDA12BBS51THCDAHH": {
                        "code": "COA 10.19.3",
                        "commitment": "Abundance and Distribution Study",
                        "name": "Conduct Near-Field Abundance and Distribution Monitoring",
                        "text": "Permittee shall fund and initiate abundance and fine‐scale distribution studies according to\ntimelines established in the Covered Fish Species Monitoring and Science Plan (Condition of\nApproval 10.18) and continue implementation annually through Phase 2 Operations Monitoring.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H3KQ2JH8QCYXWA8G3M",
                            "name": "Conduct Fisheries Evaluation Studies for Covered Fish"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFSWDA12BBS51THCDAHJ": {
                        "code": "COA 10.19.3",
                        "commitment": "Abundance and Distribution Study",
                        "name": "Conduct Far-Field Abundance and Distribution Monitoring",
                        "text": "Permittee shall use a combination of existing IEP Delta monitoring programs (e.g., CDFW Summer\nTownet Survey, Fall Midwater Trawl Survey, Smelt Larval Surveys; USFWS Enhanced Delta Smelt\nMonitoring Program and Delta Juvenile Fish Monitoring Program; CDFW and USFWS Kodiak Trawl\nand 20 mm Trawl) and night sampling, as approved by CDFW and USFWS.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H3KQ2JH8QCYXWA8G3M",
                            "name": "Conduct Fisheries Evaluation Studies for Covered Fish"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFVMMT7GYMAYSSJWC4NA": {
                        "code": "COA 10.20",
                        "commitment": "Water Quality Evaluation Studies",
                        "name": "Conduct Water Quality Evaluation Studies Program",
                        "text": "conduct Water Quality Evaluation Studies to characterize baseline conditions and\nuncertainties regarding the effects of Covered Activities (construction, operations, and maintenance)\non Covered Fish Species",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H3KQ2JH8QCYXWA8G3N",
                            "name": "Conduct Water Quality Evaluation Studies"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFXACJWZR5W6GS2G1D3B": {
                        "code": "COA 10.20.1",
                        "commitment": "Installation of New Real-time Monitoring Station",
                        "name": "Install and Maintain Real-Time Water Quality Monitoring Station",
                        "text": "Permittee shall fund, install, and\nmaintain a new real-time monitoring station downstream of the north Delta diversion Intake C\nbefore initiation of In-Water Preconstruction Baseline Monitoring.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H3KQ2JH8QCYXWA8G3P",
                            "name": "Install Real-Time Water Quality Monitoring Station"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFXB7WQBC5CM212M571M": {
                        "code": "COA 10.20.1",
                        "commitment": "Installation of New Real-time Monitoring Station",
                        "name": "Develop Hydraulic Data Plan for Operating Criteria",
                        "text": "Permittee shall work collaboratively with CDFW to develop a\nHydraulic Data Plan to use the data obtained from this new real-time monitoring station, in addition to upstream monitoring stations described in Section 20.2.1 of the Project Description\nand existing stations, to implement operating criteria described in Conditions of Approval 11.109\nand 11.111.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NJADVCJBHXD7RXW12F",
                            "name": "Develop Hydraulic Data Plan for Operating Criteria"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFZ5H9GH44E6MV06FWQT": {
                        "code": "COA 10.20.2",
                        "commitment": "Sediment and Turbidity Monitoring Study",
                        "name": "Develop Sediment and Turbidity Monitoring Study Plan",
                        "text": "Permittee shall, in collaboration with CDFW, develop a Sediment and\nTurbidity Monitoring Study Plan to: 1) Assess the baseline sediment transfer in river reaches potentially impacted by Covered\nActivities (construction and operations); 2) Evaluate changes to baseline conditions established during In-water Preconstruction Baseline\nMonitoring occurring from Covered Activities measured during In-water Construction\nMonitoring, and Phase 1 and Phase 2 Operations Monitoring; and 3) Establish sediment…",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NJADVCJBHXD7RXW12G",
                            "name": "Develop Sediment and Turbidity Monitoring Study Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFZ5H9GH44E6MV06FWQV": {
                        "code": "COA 10.20.2",
                        "commitment": "Sediment and Turbidity Monitoring Study",
                        "name": "Implement Sediment and Turbidity Monitoring Through Phase 2 Operations",
                        "text": "Permittee shall initiate the CDFW-approved study plan after installation of the new real-time\nmonitoring station (Condition of Approval 10.20.1), and shall continue implementation through\nPhase 2 Operations.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H3KQ2JH8QCYXWA8G3N",
                            "name": "Conduct Water Quality Evaluation Studies"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMFZ5H9GH44E6MV06FWQW": {
                        "code": "COA 10.20.2",
                        "commitment": "Sediment and Turbidity Monitoring Study",
                        "name": "Develop and Implement Sediment Reintroduction Plan if Criteria Unmet",
                        "text": "If results of the Sediment and Turbidity Monitoring Study indicate that performance criteria will\nnot be met, Permittee shall develop a Sediment Reintroduction Plan to reintroduce sediment and\ncreate conditions in the Project Area that meet performance criteria.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NJADVCJBHXD7RXW12H",
                            "name": "Develop Sediment Reintroduction Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMG0XBZNCYVWPBKFF9KN3": {
                        "code": "COA 10.20.3",
                        "commitment": "Harmful Algal Blooms Monitoring Plan",
                        "name": "Develop and Implement Harmful Algal Bloom Monitoring Plan",
                        "text": "Before initiation of Phase 1 Operations, Permittee shall\ndevelop and implement a Harmful Algal Bloom Plan to monitor baseline frequency, duration, and\nintensity of harmful algal blooms in river reaches potentially impacted by Project operations using\na combination of field surveys and hydrodynamic modeling of residence time.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H3KQ2JH8QCYXWA8G3N",
                            "name": "Conduct Water Quality Evaluation Studies"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMG2PRTZSMCABGAWR0K28": {
                        "code": "COA 10.20.4",
                        "commitment": "Selenium Bioaccumulation Study Plan",
                        "name": "Develop and Implement Selenium Bioaccumulation Monitoring",
                        "text": "Before initiation of Phase 1 Operations, Permittee\nshall develop and implement a Selenium Bioaccumulation Study Plan to evaluate the effect of\nCovered Activities on selenium bioaccumulation in DS and LFS.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H3KQ2JH8QCYXWA8G3N",
                            "name": "Conduct Water Quality Evaluation Studies"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMG4EDSA27H7ZGNA9A8PQ": {
                        "code": "COA 10.20.5",
                        "commitment": "Mercury Monitoring Study Plan",
                        "name": "Develop and Implement Mercury Monitoring Study",
                        "text": "Permittee, in collaboration with CDFW, shall develop and\nimplement a Mercury Monitoring Study Plan to evaluate changes in mercury concentrations in\nthe ecosystem from Covered Activities (construction and operations).",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H3KQ2JH8QCYXWA8G3N",
                            "name": "Conduct Water Quality Evaluation Studies"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMG4EDSA27H7ZGNA9A8PR": {
                        "code": "COA 10.20.5",
                        "commitment": "Mercury Monitoring Study Plan",
                        "name": "Develop and Implement Methylmercury Management Approach if Criteria Exceeded",
                        "text": "If Project impacts exceed Covered Fish Species Biological Criteria, Permittee\nshall develop methylmercury management approaches and implement them consistent with the\nSacramento-San Joaquin Delta Estuary Total Maximum Daily Load (TMDL) for Methylmercury and\nAmendments to the Water Quality Control Plan for the Sacramento River and San Joaquin River\nBasins for the Control of Methylmercury and Total Mercury in the Sacramento-San Joaquin Delta\nEstuary.",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3V103NJ75GYQV09GB8S",
                            "name": "Develop and Implement Methylmercury Management Approach"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMG67SBQQ9NGTDVYWB5GJ": {
                        "code": "COA 10.21",
                        "commitment": "Ecological Response Evaluation Studies",
                        "name": "Conduct Ecological Response Evaluation Studies Program",
                        "text": "conduct Ecological Response Evaluation Studies to characterize baseline conditions\nand uncertainties regarding the effects of Covered Activities (construction, operations, and\nmaintenance) on Covered Fish Species",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H3KQ2JH8QCYXWA8G3Q",
                            "name": "Conduct Ecological Response Evaluation Studies"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMG7ZSS0VR9VCVNR8Q59C": {
                        "code": "COA 10.21.1",
                        "commitment": "Hydrodynamics at Georgiana Slough Monitoring",
                        "name": "Develop and Implement Georgiana Slough Hydrodynamics Monitoring",
                        "text": "Permittee shall develop a\nHydrodynamics at Georgiana Slough Monitoring Study Plan to monitor the timing, magnitude,\nfrequency, and duration of Sacramento River reverse flows at the Georgiana Slough junction and\nevaluate changes to baseline conditions from Covered Activities (construction and operations)\nthrough Phase 2 Operations.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H3KQ2JH8QCYXWA8G3Q",
                            "name": "Conduct Ecological Response Evaluation Studies"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMG9R17WXSGP8V7T4FYJV": {
                        "code": "COA 10.21.2",
                        "commitment": "Covered Fish Species Life Cycle Models",
                        "name": "Fund and Support Covered Fish Species Life Cycle Models",
                        "text": "Permittee shall 1) fund the development and refinement of the following life cycle models; and 2) provide data to\nconsider in life cycle model updates to quantify the effects of Covered Activities (construction,\noperations, and maintenance) through Phase 2 Operations and ensure compliance with Covered\nFish Species Biological Criteria (Conditions of Approval 11.115, 11.116, and 11.117)",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMGBG6K7E9GGDZEX3WR6M": {
                        "code": "COA 10.21.3",
                        "commitment": "Food Web and Larval Fishes Entrainment Study",
                        "name": "Conduct Baseline Food Web Resource Surveys",
                        "text": "Permittee shall use existing monitoring surveys, such as\n20mm Survey, Environmental Monitoring Program, Fall Midwater Trawl Survey, Summer Townet\nSurvey, the Fish Restoration Program, and new monitoring surveys near the north Delta intakes\nto quantify the distribution and abundance of Covered Fish Species food web resources in river\nreaches potentially impacted by Project operations.",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3XYHN837NKGVMS0K46X",
                            "name": "Conduct Baseline Food Web Resource Surveys"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMGBHRNY6JFE0S1HFFP8V": {
                        "code": "COA 10.21.3",
                        "commitment": "Food Web and Larval Fishes Entrainment Study",
                        "name": "Monitor Food Web and Larval Fish Entrainment During Operations",
                        "text": "Permittee shall monitor behind the north Delta intake fish screens to quantify the abundance of\nfood web resources, DS and LFS larvae and juveniles, WS larvae and juveniles, and CHNWR and\nCHNSR fry being entrained into the north Delta intakes.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H3KQ2JH8QCYXWA8G3Q",
                            "name": "Conduct Ecological Response Evaluation Studies"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMGBHRNY6JFE0S1HFFP8W": {
                        "code": "COA 10.21.3",
                        "commitment": "Food Web and Larval Fishes Entrainment Study",
                        "name": "Incorporate Food Web and Entrainment Results into Life Cycle Models",
                        "text": "Permittee shall incorporate near-field and far-field impacts from changes in food web resources\nand Covered Fish Species entrainment into Covered Fish Species life cycle models to evaluate\neffects of Project operations on DS, LFS, CHNWR, CHNSR, and WS populations and ensure\ncompliance with the Covered Fish Species Biological Criteria (Conditions of Approval 11.115,\n11.116, and 11.117).",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMGD8N4F2ZYV5J3EF3N0N": {
                        "code": "COA 10.21.4",
                        "commitment": "Tidal Wetland Restoration Efficacy Study",
                        "name": "Develop Tidal Wetland Restoration Efficacy Study and Evaluate Benefits",
                        "text": "Before Phase 1 Operations\nbegin, Permittee shall develop a Tidal Wetland Restoration Efficacy Study Plan that uses\nmonitoring data from the Fish Restoration Program, and potentially other data sources, to\nanalyze the efficacy of restored tidal wetlands in producing food web resources.",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y32EX2B7J0Q0QX2WW1TP",
                            "name": "Develop Tidal Wetland Restoration Efficacy Study Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMGF1TSJX5H4GGJY5YZCJ": {
                        "code": "COA 10.21.5",
                        "commitment": "Delta Smelt and Longfin Smelt Spawning Habitat Study",
                        "name": "Fund and Implement DS/LFS Spawning Habitat Study",
                        "text": "At least one year before initiating\nin-water construction Covered Activities, Permittee shall, in collaboration with CDFW, fund and\nimplement a study to evaluate the impact of Covered Activities (construction, operations, and\nmaintenance) on DS and LFS spawning habitat as part of the Abundance and Distribution Study\n(Condition of Approval 10.19.3).",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3XYHN837NKGVMS0K46Y",
                            "name": "Fund and Implement the DS/LFS Spawning Habitat Study"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMGGSKMA3NH7DNR3MW3SN": {
                        "code": "COA 10.21.6",
                        "commitment": "Refugia Design and Field Study",
                        "name": "Develop Refugia Design and Field Study Plan",
                        "text": "Permittee shall develop a Refugia Design and Field Study Plan to implement a study to inform the\ndesign and optimization of fish refugia at the north Delta intakes.",
                        "type": "Design",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3CAZ0RTVT4JT3NA167V",
                            "name": "Develop Refugia Design and Field Study Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMGJJCNQNMMN75S2PQQTY": {
                        "code": "COA 10.21.7",
                        "commitment": "Sacramento River Flow Reversal and Routing Minimization",
                        "name": "Manage Diversions to Minimize Sacramento River Flow Reversals",
                        "text": "By adhering to the\nrequirements in Conditions of Approval 11.109, 11.110, 11.111, 11.112, 11.113, and 11.114\nPermittee shall manage diversions at the north Delta intakes at all times to minimize increases in\nthe timing, magnitude, frequency, or duration of flow reversals in the Sacramento River at the\nGeorgiana Slough junction above pre-Project levels.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMGJJCNQNMMN75S2PQQTZ": {
                        "code": "COA 10.21.7",
                        "commitment": "Sacramento River Flow Reversal and Routing Minimization",
                        "name": "Assess Juvenile Salmon Route Entrainment by Reach and Junction",
                        "text": "Permittee shall assess changes in\nCHNWR and CHNSR route entrainment by reach within the lower Sacramento River and through the Delta between baseline conditions established during In-water Preconstruction Baseline\nMonitoring and In-water Construction Monitoring, and Phase 1 and Phase 2 Operations\nMonitoring using the Hydrodynamics at Georgiana Slough Monitoring Study and the Far-field\nRouting and Survival Study (Conditions of Approval 10.21.1 and 10.19.1).",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMGMAMKBY5AJH52CX903X": {
                        "code": "COA 10.21.8",
                        "commitment": "Joint Operations Optimization Study",
                        "name": "Ensure Operations Meet Covered Fish Species Biological Criteria",
                        "text": "Permittee shall ensure that Covered Fish Species Biological Criteria are met during Phase 1 and\nPhase 2 operations (Conditions of Approval 11.115, 11.116, and 11.117).",
                        "type": "Other",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMGMBN9YSZN01BVXBTRPV": {
                        "code": "COA 10.21.8",
                        "commitment": "Joint Operations Optimization Study",
                        "name": "Develop and Implement Joint Operations Optimization Study Plan",
                        "text": "During In-water Preconstruction Monitoring, Permittee shall convene a team of biologists and\nhydrologic engineers to collaboratively develop a Joint Operations Optimization Study Plan that\nwill describe a series of modeling studies, informed by empirical data, to evaluate a wide range of\npossible joint operations scenarios, including approaches to balancing diversions between north\nand south for carriage water savings, and associated implications for Delta biotic and abiotic\nconditions,…",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NJADVCJBHXD7RXW12J",
                            "name": "Submit Joint Operations Optimization Study Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMGMBN9YSZN01BVXBTRPW": {
                        "code": "COA 10.21.8",
                        "commitment": "Joint Operations Optimization Study",
                        "name": "Report Joint Operations Study Results in Phase 2 Authorization Package",
                        "text": "Permittee shall include a final report documenting results of the studies and demonstrating the\nProject’s ability to meet Covered Species Biological Criteria as a part of the Phase 2 Authorization\nPackage (Condition of Approval 7.1).",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RA6HTPQEBMJTM46QTV",
                            "name": "Submit Joint Operations Study Results and Compliance Report"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMGP1Y7ZE95PPTF235TAA": {
                        "code": "COA 10.21.9",
                        "commitment": "Modeling Needed to Implement Real-time Operations",
                        "name": "Evaluate and Refine Real-Time Operations Modeling Tools",
                        "text": "Permittee shall collaborate with\nCDFW throughout In-water Preconstruction and In-water Construction Monitoring to evaluate\nthe ability of existing modeling tools to implement Covered Fish Species Biological Criteria as a\npart of real-time operations (Conditions of Approval 11.115, 11.116, and 11.117). Permittee shall\ncollaborate with CDFW to refine existing modeling tools, or develop new modeling tools, to\nensure that Covered Fish Species Biological Criteria can be evaluated in real-time and…",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y32EX2B7J0Q0QX2WW1TQ",
                            "name": "Develop Real-Time Biological Criteria Compliance Model"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMGQVQ28RFNJX1ZA1EZMC": {
                        "code": "COA 10.21.10",
                        "commitment": "Ascending and Descending Hydrograph Limb Studies",
                        "name": "Model Ascending Versus Descending Hydrograph Limb Impacts",
                        "text": "Permittee shall work collaboratively with CDFW to utilize new information gained from Conditions of Approval 10.18,\n10.19, 10.20, and 10.21 in this ITP to conduct new modeling and evaluate differences in impacts\nto Covered Fish Species as a result of Project operations during times when the Sacramento River\nhydrograph is ascending or descending.",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y32EX2B7J0Q0QX2WW1TN",
                            "name": "Complete Sacramento River Hydrograph Limb Impact Evaluation"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMGSM98FYZAKW9PV13PEW": {
                        "code": "COA 10.22",
                        "commitment": "Personnel Conducting Studies and Monitoring",
                        "name": "Ensure Permitted Personnel Conduct Covered Species Studies",
                        "text": "Permittee shall ensure that all Covered Species Monitoring and Scientific Studies which may result in\ntake of DS, LFS, CHNWR, CHNSR, and WS are conducted by a person or entity with necessary state\nand federal scientific collecting permits and take authorizations.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": []
                      },

                        "code": "COA 10.23",
                        "commitment": "Sacramento River Bathymetric Surveys",
                        "name": "Conduct Sacramento River Bathymetric Surveys Near Intakes",
                        "text": "Permittee shall conduct bathymetric surveys focused on sections of the Sacramento River adjacent to\neach north Delta intake to understand annual changes in river bottom conditions.",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [

                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3XZ7WK0185QGKR0185V",
                            "name": "Conduct Sacramento River Bathymetric Surveys Near the Intakes"

                        "code": "COA 10.23",
                        "commitment": "Sacramento River Bathymetric Surveys",
                        "name": "Report Bathymetric Survey Results Within 120 Days",
                        "text": "Permittee shall provide reports documenting the\nresults of surveys within 120 days of completion of each survey.",

                        "actions": [

                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RA6HTPQEBMJTM46QTM",
                            "name": "Report Bathymetric Survey Results to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },

                        "name": "Submit Final Models and Reports to CDFW Before 30% Design",
                        "text": "Permittee shall provide copies of the final models described in Conditions of Approval 10.24.1 and\n10.24.2 and associated reports to CDFW before completing 30% Project design.",

                        "actions": [

                      "req_01M2ESMGYXR984FC4A4EABEBSG": {
                        "code": "COA 10.24.1",
                        "commitment": "Sacramento River Hydraulic Model",
                        "name": "Complete 3D Sacramento River Hydraulic Model",
                        "text": "Permittee shall complete Sacramento River hydraulic\nmodeling to support improved understanding of hydrological effects using a 3D model of river\nflow, stream trajectories, and velocities under various Sacramento River flows, stages, and\ndiversion rates.",
                        "type": "Analysis",

                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y32EX2B7J0Q0QX2WW1TR",
                            "name": "Complete Hydraulic and Sediment Transport Modeling Report"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMH0NYS2HV9RZRDQC1BKX": {
                        "code": "COA 10.24.2",
                        "commitment": "Sediment Transport Model",
                        "name": "Complete Sacramento River Sediment Transport Model",
                        "text": "Permittee shall complete a Sacramento River sediment\ntransport model focused on areas adjacent to each north Delta intake to estimate potential\nsediment erosion and deposition around the intake structure.",
                        "type": "Analysis",

                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y32EX2B7J0Q0QX2WW1TR",

                        "commitment": "North Delta Intake Hydraulic Modeling Deliverables",
                        "name": "Submit 10.25.1 Mathematical Model and Report to CDFW",
                        "text": "Permittee shall provide copies of the final model and associated reports described in Condition of\nApproval 10.25.1 before completing 30% Project design.",
                        "type": "Reporting",

                      "req_01M2ESMH2DT08G18ZCGEFSA9TX": {
                        "code": "COA 10.25",
                        "commitment": "North Delta Intake Hydraulic Modeling Deliverables",
                        "name": "Submit 10.25.2-10.25.4 Models and Reports to CDFW",
                        "text": "Permittee shall provide copies of the final\nmodels described in Conditions of Approval 10.25.2, 10.25.3, and 10.25.4 and associated reports, to\nCDFW before completing 60% Project design.",

                      "req_01M2ESMH482SRYPDZ45R1CEVHY": {
                        "code": "COA 10.25.1",
                        "commitment": "Intake Structure Hydraulic Model, Mathematical",
                        "name": "Complete Mathematical Intake Structure Hydraulic Model",
                        "text": "Permittee shall complete an intake\nstructure hydraulic model, which will be a 3D model of the intake structure and tee screen\nhydraulic performance from the Sacramento River to the sedimentation basin, for the purpose of\nconfirming the hydraulic performance and to recommend any refinements to the configuration\nprior to completion of physical modeling.",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y32F2DZX3TCXSF7HD073",
                            "name": "Complete COA 10.25 Series Models and Report"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMH6093KC5P4SWVRJXXM3": {
                        "code": "COA 10.25.2",
                        "commitment": "Intake Structure Hydraulic Modeling, Physical",
                        "name": "Complete Physical Reduced-Scale Intake Structure Model",
                        "text": "Permittee shall complete a physical\nreduced-scale model of intake structure and tee screen hydraulic performance from the\nSacramento River to the sedimentation basin for the purpose of confirming the hydraulic\nperformance and to identify any refinements to the configuration to be incorporated during the\nfinal design phase.",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y32F2DZX3TCXSF7HD073",
                            "name": "Complete COA 10.25 Series Models and Report"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMH7PGYFFQ2NB0Y9XC3HP": {
                        "code": "COA 10.25.3",
                        "commitment": "Intake Tee Screen Hydraulic Model, Mathematical",
                        "name": "Complete Mathematical Tee Screen Hydraulic Model",
                        "text": "Permittee shall complete a 3D\nhydraulic model of intake tee screens (including baffle cylinders) to refine baffle configuration\nand facilitate uniform fish screen approach velocity.",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y32F2DZX3TCXSF7HD073",
                            "name": "Complete COA 10.25 Series Models and Report"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMH9F16JCFE1QH35MGSZB": {
                        "code": "COA 10.25.4",
                        "commitment": "Intake Tee Screen Hydraulic Model, Physical",
                        "name": "Develop Physical Tee Screen Lab Model",
                        "text": "Permittee shall develop a physical reduced-\nscale lab model of one intake tee screen for the purpose of refining baffle configuration and to\nfacilitate uniform fish screen approach velocity.",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y32F2DZX3TCXSF7HD073",
                            "name": "Complete COA 10.25 Series Models and Report"
                          }
                        ]
                      },

                        "code": "COA 10.26",
                        "commitment": "Fish Guidance System Working Group and Study Plan",
                        "name": "Develop Fish Guidance System Study Plan",
                        "text": "Permittee shall use input from the working group to develop a Fish Guidance System Study Plan for\nCDFW review.",
                        "type": "Plan",

                        "code": "COA 10.26",
                        "commitment": "Fish Guidance System Working Group and Study Plan",
                        "name": "Implement Study and Recommend Fish Guidance Approach",
                        "text": "Permittee shall complete implementation of the CDFW-approved study plan and\nprovide a recommended approach to CDFW no less than one year prior to finalization of 30% Project\ndesign to ensure that the results are available to inform Project design refinements for the north\nDelta intakes.",
                        "type": "Analysis",

                            "name": "Submit Fish Guidance System Recommendation Report to CDFW"

                      "req_01M2ESMHB8XDGERVYJ54SWK0BD": {
                        "code": "COA 10.26",
                        "commitment": "Fish Guidance System Working Group and Study Plan",
                        "name": "Convene Fish Guidance System Working Group",
                        "text": "Permittee shall convene a working group comprised of representatives from Permittee, CDFW,\nReclamation, USFWS, and NMFS to evaluate the potential to include a fish deterrence and/or\nguidance system, i.e., a non-physical barrier, into the north Delta intake structure designs at least two\nyears prior to completion of 30% Project design.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",

                            "name": "Convene Fish Guidance System Working Group"

                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMHD09XMJW13QPHXCDF52": {

                        "name": "Prepare and Submit Hydraulic Testing Plan",
                        "text": "Permittee shall prepare a Hydraulic Testing Plan to demonstrate that the north Delta intake fish\nscreens are operating within CDFW and NMFS fish screening criteria as specified in Condition of\nApproval 11.109.",

                        "code": "COA 10.27",
                        "commitment": "Hydraulic Testing for Velocity Requirements",
                        "name": "Conduct Scheduled Fish Screen Hydraulic Tests",
                        "text": "The Hydraulic Testing Plan shall include a minimum of three tests during Phase 1 or Phase 2\noperations: one test during a low river flow, another during a high diversion flow event, and the third\nduring a “normal” operating condition.",

                        "code": "COA 10.27",
                        "commitment": "Hydraulic Testing for Velocity Requirements",
                        "name": "Retest Fish Screens After a Qualifying Event",
                        "text": "Permittee shall conduct additional hydraulic testing following each qualifying event as defined\nbelow:",
                        "type": "Monitoring",

                            "name": "Retest Fish Screen Hydraulics After a Qualifying Event"
                          }

                      "req_01M2ESMHESPTYZVZHBGTPERHSP": {
                        "code": "COA 10.27.1",
                        "commitment": "Hydraulic Testing Procedures and Plan Contents",
                        "name": "Conduct Fish Screen Testing per NMFS 2023 Guidance",
                        "text": "Permittee shall conduct all north Delta intake fish screen\nhydraulic testing using guidance provided in the NMFS 2023 Performing Hydraulic Evaluations32\nto ensure water passing through the cylindrical screens is distributed uniformly over all wetted\nsurfaces.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",

                            "name": "Conduct North Delta Intake Fish Screen Hydraulic Tests"

                        "commitment": "Hydraulic Testing Procedures and Plan Contents",
                        "name": "Specify Hydraulic Testing Plan Methods and Contents",
                        "text": "Permittee shall provide detailed descriptions of the methods, procedures, and\nparameters for hydraulic testing in the Hydraulic Testing Plan.",

                            "name": "Submit Hydraulic Testing Plan for Intake Fish Screens"

                        "code": "COA 10.27.2",
                        "commitment": "Approach Velocity Testing Compliance",
                        "name": "Submit Hydraulic Testing Data Within 72 Hours",
                        "text": "Permittee shall provide all hydraulic testing data\nto CDFW within 72 hours of each north Delta intake fish screen hydraulic test.",

                            "name": "Submit Fish Screen Hydraulic Testing Data and Report to CDFW"

                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMHGJED0F8PP04FMVHBE0": {
                        "code": "COA 10.27.2",
                        "commitment": "Approach Velocity Testing Compliance",
                        "name": "Adjust Baffles and Retest After Non-Compliance",
                        "text": "Permittee shall\nconduct baffle adjustments within seven days of a non-compliant hydraulic test, and Permittee\nshall retest within seven days of the baffle adjustment and provide the subsequent hydraulic\ntesting data to CDFW within 72 hours.",

                            "name": "Adjust and Retest Fish Screen Baffles After a Non-Compliant Test"

                        "code": "COA 10.27.2",
                        "commitment": "Approach Velocity Testing Compliance",
                        "name": "Maintain Approach Velocity Within Screening Criteria",
                        "text": "Permittee shall employ additional actions such as the decrease of diversion\nrates at the north Delta intakes, as needed, to maintain Va.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []

                        "code": "COA 10.27.3",
                        "commitment": "Hydraulic Testing Reports",
                        "name": "Submit Hydraulic Testing Report Within 30 Days",
                        "text": "Permittee shall submit hydraulic testing reports within thirty\ndays of completion of each hydraulic test described in Condition of Approval 10.27.",

                      "req_01M2ESMHM3MDV37W0VHBA7M7NS": {
                        "code": "COA 10.28",
                        "commitment": "Fish Screen Visual Inspections",
                        "name": "Visually Inspect Fish Screens Several Times per Year",
                        "text": "Permittee shall perform visual inspections of the north Delta intake screens at least several times per\nyear (using a diver and/or underwater inspection surveillance) to evaluate screen integrity, the\neffectiveness of the cleaning mechanism, and potential impingement of Covered Fish Species.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []

                      "req_01M2ESMHM4KCFCMYCV8HCE6WB9": {
                        "code": "COA 10.28",
                        "commitment": "Fish Screen Visual Inspections",
                        "name": "Remove and Clean Fish Screens Every Six Months",
                        "text": "Permittee\nshall remove fish screens from the river and clean them approximately every six months.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6YKM817BXJNTVA76DKTZ7",
                            "name": "Remove and Clean North Delta Intake Fish Screens"

                      "req_01M2ESMHNV33KRJW34PYX96NJ9": {
                        "code": "COA 10.29",
                        "commitment": "Sediment Management Inspections at Intakes",
                        "name": "Inspect Sediment Deposition at Intake Tee Screens",
                        "text": "Permittee shall conduct inspections to quantify sediment deposition in front of the tee screen bases\nat both north Delta intakes at least annually after initiating Phase 1 Operations to evaluate the\neffectiveness of sediment management devices and demonstrate that sediment is not impacting fish\nscreen performance.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [

                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H41AKKXC7WAC4X6PQK",
                            "name": "Inspect Sediment Deposition at Intake Tee Screens Annually"

                        "code": "COA 10.29",
                        "commitment": "Sediment Management Inspections at Intakes",
                        "name": "Report Sediment Deposition Assessment to CDFW",
                        "text": "Within 30 days of each inspection Permittee shall provide estimates of sediment\ndeposition and an assessment of 1) the effectiveness of sediment management devices and 2)\npotential impacts to fish screen performance to CDFW.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [

                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R99JZNVA7RWDTVTCW9",
                            "name": "Report Intake Sediment Deposition Assessment to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },

                        "code": "COA 10.30",
                        "commitment": "Screen Impingement Study",
                        "name": "Develop and Submit Screen Impingement Study Plan",
                        "text": "Permittee shall develop a study plan to\ncollect data on impinged fish, including fork length, to better understand the sizes of Covered Fish\nSpecies exposed to screen impacts. The study shall also evaluate seasonal variation in impingement,\nand measure environmental covariates (i.e. velocity, turbidity, dissolved oxygen, temperature) to\ninform potential environmental causes of variation in screen impingement. Permittee shall submit a\ndraft study plan to CDFW no less than six months before…",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NK6K0BZ6XYWCKNWKMS",
                            "name": "Submit Screen Impingement Study Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMHQM4Y8XNWWGJWTJ3P5N": {
                        "code": "COA 10.30",
                        "commitment": "Screen Impingement Study",
                        "name": "Implement Screen Impingement Study During Operations",
                        "text": "implement the plan during Phase 1 and Phase 2 Operations.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
