                            "name": "Implement Fish Screen Impingement Study"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMHSDAW774SZWKJC8RQZB": {
                        "code": "COA 11.1",
                        "commitment": "Covered Species Observations and Work Stoppage",
                        "name": "Report Covered Species Encounters and Halt Work",
                        "text": "Permittee shall direct all\nworkers to inform the Designated Biologist(s), Fisheries Biologist(s), or Biological Monitor(s) if they\nencounter any Covered Species within or near the Project site. All Covered Activities with potential to\ntake Covered Species shall cease until the animal moves from the Project site on its own accord.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMHSDAW774SZWKJC8RQZC": {
                        "code": "COA 11.1",
                        "commitment": "Covered Species Observations and Work Stoppage",
                        "name": "Relocate Trapped or Injured Covered Species from Construction Site",
                        "text": "If\nthe animal is found within a fenced Project construction site and cannot move of its own volition, the\nDesignated Biologist(s) shall move the animal outside of the area of construction according to their\nspecies-specific relocation or transplantation plans described in this ITP for each Covered Species.\nCapture and relocation of trapped or injured special-status wildlife may only be performed by the\nDesignated Biologist(s) and Fisheries Biologist(s).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMHSDAW774SZWKJC8RQZD": {
                        "code": "COA 11.1",
                        "commitment": "Covered Species Observations and Work Stoppage",
                        "name": "Record and Report Covered Species Sighting Locations to CDFW",
                        "text": "Covered Species sightings shall be recorded with a\nGPS (including datum and horizontal accuracy in feet) and the Designated Biologist(s), Fisheries\nBiologist(S), or Biological Monitor(s) shall report Covered Species observed locations to CDFW within\none business day of the observation.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R8HSR7K069ZM5EZCXS",
                            "name": "Report Covered Species Sightings to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMHV7XKMQW8P8NFN047XX": {
                        "code": "COA 11.2",
                        "commitment": "Covered Species Injury Response",
                        "name": "Transport Injured Covered Species to Rehabilitation Facility",
                        "text": "If a Covered Species is injured as a result of Covered Activities, the Designated Biologist shall\nimmediately take it to a CDFW-approved wildlife rehabilitation or veterinary facility specific to the\ninjured individual. Permittee shall bear any costs associated with the care or treatment of such\ninjured Covered Species.",
                        "type": "Other",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMHV8ZTVEEH1XRC04ZSKM": {
                        "code": "COA 11.2",
                        "commitment": "Covered Species Injury Response",
                        "name": "Notify CDFW of Injury and Submit Written Incident Report",
                        "text": "The Permittee shall notify CDFW of the injury to the Covered Species\nimmediately by telephone and e-mail followed by a written incident report as described in Condition\nof Approval 10.16. Notifications shall include the name of the facility where the animal was taken.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R7PYV1TN3PG7JYE8R1",
                            "name": "Report Covered Species Take or Injury to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMHX0CTAX0Q3ZYCPP7TNK": {
                        "code": "COA 11.3",
                        "commitment": "Covered Species Capture, Handling, and Reporting",
                        "name": "Capture and Handle Covered Species per Hygiene Protocol",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) shall be responsible for and direct efforts to capture and handle Covered\nSpecies. The Designated Biologist(s) shall ensure their hands are free of soaps, oils, creams, lotions,\ninsect repellants, solvents or other potentially harmful chemicals and if not single use, nitrile or other\nhypo-allergenic gloves (non-latex) will be used for handling special-status fish or wildlife.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMHX1CGVWY7BBSAT1ZC2S": {
                        "code": "COA 11.3",
                        "commitment": "Covered Species Capture, Handling, and Reporting",
                        "name": "Maintain Capture and Relocation Monitoring Records",
                        "text": "The\nDesignated Biologist(s) shall maintain monitoring records that include, but are not limited to: (1) the beginning and ending time the capture and relocation effort, (2) a statement identifying the Covered\nSpecies encountered, (3) the time of discovery, by whom, and the condition of the Covered Species, (4) the capture and release locations of each Covered Species individual, (5) photographs of each\nCovered Species individual, (6) measurements of each Covered Species individual if doing so…",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMHYSHPSSPHZ1CGQNSKGT": {
                        "code": "COA 11.4",
                        "commitment": "Pesticide, Fungicide, and Herbicide Use Restrictions",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval Before Any Pesticide or Herbicide Use",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not use pesticides, including herbicides, insecticides, or fungicides, within the Project\nArea (including during preconstruction activities, construction, postconstruction maintenance, and\noperations), without prior consultation with and written approval from CDFW.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34X89RDDJZVZVMK8Y0C",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval for Pesticide and Herbicide Use"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMHYSHPSSPHZ1CGQNSKGV": {
                        "code": "COA 11.4",
                        "commitment": "Pesticide, Fungicide, and Herbicide Use Restrictions",
                        "name": "Apply Sprays via Licensed Applicator Within Wind Speed Limit",
                        "text": "Through this\nconsultation, CDFW may approve limited use of herbicides or pesticides through targeted spray (e.g.,\nbackpack sprayer) at a buffer from Covered Species habitat. Permittee shall only apply sprays via\nground application when wind speed measures less than three miles per hour. If approved by CDFW,\nall use (mixing, application, and clean-up) shall be conducted in accordance with federal, state, and\ncounty regulations, as directed by the manufacturer, and shall be applied by a…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMHYSHPSSPHZ1CGQNSKGW": {
                        "code": "COA 11.4",
                        "commitment": "Pesticide, Fungicide, and Herbicide Use Restrictions",
                        "name": "Prepare and Submit Annual Herbicide Application Plan to CDFW",
                        "text": "If herbicides are required to control invasive species, the Permittee shall prepare an Herbicide\nApplication Plan and submit it to CDFW for review and approval for each calendar year that\nherbicides will be used, and no later than 60 days prior to the first intended application.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NNJMTS3JZDQQZNRKET",
                            "name": "Submit Herbicide and Pesticide Application Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMHYSHPSSPHZ1CGQNSKGX": {
                        "code": "COA 11.4",
                        "commitment": "Pesticide, Fungicide, and Herbicide Use Restrictions",
                        "name": "Keep Herbicide and Pesticide Application 300 Feet from Aquatic Habitat",
                        "text": "Herbicides shall not\nbe used within or near 300 feet of Covered Species aquatic habitats or no-activity buffers and ESAs\nand shall only be applied by an applicator holding a valid license issued by the California Department\nof Pesticide Regulation.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJ0HTG8W8PBKM9K3J0JS": {
                        "code": "COA 11.5",
                        "commitment": "Prohibition of Rodenticide and Poison Use",
                        "name": "Prohibit Rodenticide, Poison, and Broadcast Baiting Use",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not use rodenticides, other poisons, or broadcast baiting used to control rodents in\nthe Project Area (including during construction, postconstruction maintenance, and operations).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJ29XED85VTSSFH9QFYF": {
                        "code": "COA 11.6",
                        "commitment": "Fertilizer Use Restrictions",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Written Approval Before Fertilizer Use",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not use fertilizers (or similar soil additives, hereby referred to as “fertilizer”) within\nthe Project Area, unless Permittee requests and receives a written approval from CDFW.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34X89RDDJZVZVMK8Y0K",
                            "name": "Submit Fertilizer Application Plan for CDFW Approval"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJ2AQJCN2G7VR9PBB3JB": {
                        "code": "COA 11.6",
                        "commitment": "Fertilizer Use Restrictions",
                        "name": "Prepare and Submit Fertilizer Application Plan to CDFW",
                        "text": "To request\nwritten approval for fertilizer application, no less than 60 days prior to the proposed application,\nPermittee shall submit to CDFW for review and approval a Fertilizer Application Plan. The Fertilizer\nApplication Plan shall detail the type of fertilizer proposed to be used, method of application, amount\nof fertilizer to be used, spatial extent and timing of proposed application, impact assessment of\napplication specific to Covered Species, measures to reduce impacts to Covered…",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NNJMTS3JZDQQZNRKEX",
                            "name": "Submit Fertilizer Application Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJ42JSX41WJGE87W85HT": {
                        "code": "COA 11.7",
                        "commitment": "Daily Work Restrictions",
                        "name": "Restrict Covered Activities to Daylight Hours",
                        "text": "Covered Activities shall cease 30 minutes before sunset and shall not resume until 30 minutes after\nsunrise, unless Permittee obtains approval by CDFW as part of the appropriate Construction Phase\nAuthorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.2).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJ42JSX41WJGE87W85HV": {
                        "code": "COA 11.7",
                        "commitment": "Daily Work Restrictions",
                        "name": "Detail and Justify Nighttime Work in Authorization Package",
                        "text": "In the appropriate Construction Phase\nAuthorization Package, Permittee shall detail the type of Covered Activity proposed for nighttime\nwork, assess the impact of the Covered Activity specific to Covered Species within the Project\nconstruction site where the nighttime work is being proposed, identify measures that will be\nimplemented to reduce impacts to Covered Species, and provide a justification for the need of\nnighttime work.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34YSP53SW383CFT2CZD",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval of Nighttime Covered Activities"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJ42JSX41WJGE87W85HW": {
                        "code": "COA 11.7",
                        "commitment": "Daily Work Restrictions",
                        "name": "Exercise Caution for Nighttime Vehicle Travel After Construction",
                        "text": "Any vehicle traffic necessary during\nnighttime hours associated with emergency response, security, or operations and maintenance\nactivities subsequent to construction shall be conducted with extra caution to minimize impacts to\nnocturnal Covered Species.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJ42JSX41WJGE87W85HX": {
                        "code": "COA 11.7",
                        "commitment": "Daily Work Restrictions",
                        "name": "Prohibit Non-Emergency Night Work in CTS Habitat After Construction",
                        "text": "Covered Activities subsequent to construction shall not occur at night for\nnon-emergency work in CTS habitat at any time of the year unless otherwise authorized by CDFW.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJ5TQR3PPTWS4JN8K985": {
                        "code": "COA 11.8",
                        "commitment": "Artificial Lighting at Night",
                        "name": "Shield and Limit Nighttime Lighting Spill Toward Habitat",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not use permanent or temporary, fixed, exterior lighting, including motion-triggered security lighting that\ncasts light on Covered Species habitat beyond the Project construction site between sunset and\nsunrise. Project-related lighting shall not result in significant illumination beyond the immediate\nProject construction site. Nighttime lighting during all Covered Activities shall be shielded and\noriented downward to minimize effects on any nearby Covered Species. All lights,…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJ5VAA2348XZ4ZFCRAC9": {
                        "code": "COA 11.8",
                        "commitment": "Artificial Lighting at Night",
                        "name": "Use Yellow or Orange Lighting Near Covered Species Habitat",
                        "text": "All construction lighting used within 500 feet of Covered Species suitable\nhabitat shall be yellow or orange lighting.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJ7J7YMKT4NMKG844FM5": {
                        "code": "COA 11.9",
                        "commitment": "Lighting on Intake Structure",
                        "name": "Prohibit Permanent Intake Lighting Toward the Sacramento River",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not permanently mount any lighting on the north Delta intake structure or buildings\nassociated with the north Delta intake structures that will produce lux in the direction of the\nSacramento River, to minimize predation effects on juvenile CHNWR and CHNSR from artificial\nlighting at night. Permanent lighting shall not be positioned such that lux can intersect the river\nchannel at any angle regardless of vertical angle of the light source.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJ7J7YMKT4NMKG844FM6": {
                        "code": "COA 11.9",
                        "commitment": "Lighting on Intake Structure",
                        "name": "Position Temporary Construction Lighting to Avoid the River Channel",
                        "text": "Temporary lighting on the north\nDelta intake structure or buildings associated with the north Delta intakes may be utilized for CDFW\napproved construction phase nighttime Covered Activities. Temporary lighting for worker safety\nduring approved construction phase Covered Activities shall not be positioned such that lux can\nintersect the river channel, to the greatest extent possible. All lights along the river channel shall\ncomply with U.S. Coast Guard criteria and regulations.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJ9BGHZMB473YX12MFMD": {
                        "code": "COA 11.10",
                        "commitment": "Visual Barriers Along Access Routes for Nighttime Activities",
                        "name": "Install CDFW-Approved Visual Barriers Along Access Routes",
                        "text": "Permittee may install a temporary (e.g., chain link with privacy slats) or semi-permanent (e.g., a\nroadway median barrier or architectural concrete wall system) barrier retrofitted using a CDFW-\napproved visual screen along portions of access routes where screening would prevent excessive light\nspill that could provide a continuous surface impenetrable by light. The visual barriers shall not be\ninstalled within 300 feet of CTS and GGS upland habitats.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCR5",
                            "name": "Install visual barriers along night access routes"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJ9BGHZMB473YX12MFME": {
                        "code": "COA 11.10",
                        "commitment": "Visual Barriers Along Access Routes for Nighttime Activities",
                        "name": "Assess Access Road Locations Before Visual Barrier Installation",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or\nBiological Monitor(s) shall assess the locations of the identified access roads prior to the installation\nof any visual barriers.",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJB3K0AEXATZED9H08N1": {
                        "code": "COA 11.11",
                        "commitment": "Project Vehicle Speed Limits",
                        "name": "Enforce Project Vehicle Speed Limits on Access Roads",
                        "text": "Project vehicles shall observe a maximum speed limit of 10 miles per hour on unpaved non-public\nProject access roads and in construction and maintenance sites. Vehicles on paved, non-public\nProject access roads shall observe a maximum speed limit of 30 miles per hour.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJB4W12EQY1N5B9E03H0": {
                        "code": "COA 11.11",
                        "commitment": "Project Vehicle Speed Limits",
                        "name": "Post Speed Limit and Wildlife Crossing Signage",
                        "text": "Speeds limits shall be\nenforced and posted in both directions. Wildlife crossing signs and signage requiring extra caution\nshall be posted in both directions on all Project access roads that overlap with CTS and GGS aquatic\nand upland habitat during Project construction, operations, and maintenance.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJB4W12EQY1N5B9E03H1": {
                        "code": "COA 11.11",
                        "commitment": "Project Vehicle Speed Limits",
                        "name": "Enforce Nighttime 10 MPH Limit at Bethany Complex",
                        "text": "Project vehicles shall observe a nighttime speed limit of 10 miles per hour in Project construction sites within the Bethany\nComplex between October 16 through July 14 (i.e., outside the “dry season” defined as July 15-Oct 15) to avoid potential vehicle strikes of CTS.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJB4W12EQY1N5B9E03H2": {
                        "code": "COA 11.11",
                        "commitment": "Project Vehicle Speed Limits",
                        "name": "Limit Speed Near GGS Habitat During Active Season",
                        "text": "Project vehicles shall observe a 10 mile per hour speed\nlimit on paved, non-public access roads where they occur within 200 feet of GGS habitat during the\nactive season (May 1 – October 1) except where exclusion fencing has been installed, in which case\nProject vehicles may observe a speed limit of up to 30 miles per hour.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJCW3S0Y78C3N63HEMHA": {
                        "code": "COA 11.12",
                        "commitment": "Wildlife Road-crossing Structures",
                        "name": "Design Wildlife-Passable Roadway Curbs and Barriers",
                        "text": "Permittee shall construct roadways that are within Covered Species habitat such that there are no\nsteep curbs, berms, dikes, or median barriers (e.g., k-cuts) that could prevent Covered Species from\ncrossing or exiting the roadway. If curbs are necessary for safety and/or surface runoff, Permittee\nshall design and construct them to allow Covered Species to walk over them.",
                        "type": "Design",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJCW3S0Y78C3N63HEMHB": {
                        "code": "COA 11.12",
                        "commitment": "Wildlife Road-crossing Structures",
                        "name": "Submit Wildlife Culvert Under-crossing Plan for CDFW Approval",
                        "text": "Large culverts shall be\ninstalled for wildlife road under-crossings, to the extent possible, every 500 feet on new access roads\nto minimize road mortality and isolation on amphibian and reptile Covered Species. Permittee shall\nprovide the number and approximate location(s) of proposed culverts designed for wildlife road\nunder-crossings within the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization Package for CDFW-\napproval.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34WE7XE98281ZXQVPK7",
                            "name": "Submit Culvert Under-Crossing Count and Location Report"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJCW3S0Y78C3N63HEMHC": {
                        "code": "COA 11.12",
                        "commitment": "Wildlife Road-crossing Structures",
                        "name": "Construct Wildlife Under-crossing Culverts to Specification",
                        "text": "Unless otherwise approved by CDFW due to site-specific constraints, Permittee shall\nconstruct road culvert under-crossings using concrete with a natural substrate bottom such as sand,\ndirt, or gravel. A minimum under-crossing culvert size of six inches shall be used to ensure Covered\nSpecies and other wildlife may move across active roadways. Culvert under-crossing tunnels shall use\n“windows” for new roads within GGS suitable habitat as diurnal snakes are less likely to utilize…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCR4",
                            "name": "Install wildlife under-crossing culverts and speed limit signage"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJEM2TNZCJNZX5RKPYYN": {
                        "code": "COA 11.13",
                        "commitment": "Precipitation Work Limit",
                        "name": "Restrict Work Near Waters During Rain and Wet Weather",
                        "text": "For preconstruction activities, construction activities, and maintenance activities including\ntransmission line construction, transmission line maintenance, ground-disturbing work activities, and\nfacilities maintenance within 100 feet of rivers, streams, sloughs, ponds, or vernal pools, Permittee\nshall restrict Covered Activities to periods of low rainfall (less than 0.25 inches per 24-hour period)\nand periods of dry weather (with less than a 30% chance of rain).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJEM2TNZCJNZX5RKPYYP": {
                        "code": "COA 11.13",
                        "commitment": "Precipitation Work Limit",
                        "name": "Initiate Erosion Control Measures Before Storm Events",
                        "text": "Permittee shall initiate all erosion\ncontrol measures prior to all storm events.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJEM2TNZCJNZX5RKPYYQ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.13",
                        "commitment": "Precipitation Work Limit",
                        "name": "Monitor 72-Hour Weather Forecast for Each Project Site",
                        "text": "Permittee and Designated Biologist(s) shall monitor the\nNational Weather Service (http://www.nws.noaa.gov) 72-hour forecast for each Project Site.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJEM2TNZCJNZX5RKPYYR": {
                        "code": "COA 11.13",
                        "commitment": "Precipitation Work Limit",
                        "name": "Survey Site for Clearance Before Resuming After Rain",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) shall survey each Project construction site before\nCovered Activities resume, using the CDFW-approved preconstruction survey protocol (Condition of\nApproval 11.38).",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJGCA5WEKEPJA6HV1AQE": {
                        "code": "COA 11.14",
                        "commitment": "Daily Entrapment Inspections",
                        "name": "Inspect Overnight Equipment and Excavations Each Morning",
                        "text": "All construction equipment, or construction materials left overnight in areas that may be occupied by\nwildlife shall be inspected by the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) prior to\ninitiation of any Covered Activity within a Project construction site, to prevent inadvertent\nentrapment of Covered Species during construction.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJGDAZD639XYXVJKZ53Z": {
                        "code": "COA 11.14",
                        "commitment": "Daily Entrapment Inspections",
                        "name": "Cover or Ramp Open Excavations Nightly",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall ensure that all excavated areas, steep-\nwalled holes, pumps, or trenches more than six inches deep, with the exception of shaft excavation,\nwill be covered at the close of each working day with plywood or similar material and shall ensure the\ncover is sealed with rock bags or other methods to prevent animals from reentering or provided with\none or more escape ramps constructed of earth fill or wooden planks at no more than a 30°…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37TC7ZSR7P81QYD2TH9",
                            "name": "Cover open excavations at the close of each working day"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJGDAZD639XYXVJKZ540": {
                        "code": "COA 11.14",
                        "commitment": "Daily Entrapment Inspections",
                        "name": "Install Exclusion Barriers Around Shaft Openings",
                        "text": "Prior to shaft construction, the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall ensure that\nvertical shafts have suitable exclusion barriers placed around the shaft opening to prohibit entry of\nCovered Species into the shaft.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCQZ",
                            "name": "Install exclusion barriers at work areas and shaft openings"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJGDAZD639XYXVJKZ541": {
                        "code": "COA 11.14",
                        "commitment": "Daily Entrapment Inspections",
                        "name": "Inspect Excavations Before Filling for Trapped Animals",
                        "text": "Before such holes\nor trenches are filled, the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall thoroughly\ninspect them for trapped animals and be present when holes or trenches are being covered or filled\nto ensure there is no entrapment of Covered Species and that the cover is secure.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJGDAZD639XYXVJKZ542": {
                        "code": "COA 11.14",
                        "commitment": "Daily Entrapment Inspections",
                        "name": "Divert Activities When Wildlife Found in Excavations",
                        "text": "If a Covered\nSpecies or other animal is encountered in excavated pits, holes, or trenches during Covered Activities,\nPermittee shall divert Covered Activities away from the Covered Species until Project personnel\ncontact the Designated Biologist(s).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJGDAZD639XYXVJKZ543": {
                        "code": "COA 11.14",
                        "commitment": "Daily Entrapment Inspections",
                        "name": "Relocate Wildlife Found in Excavations",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) shall relocate the animal consistent\nwith Conditions of Approval in this ITP and determine any further actions to be taken.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJJ6GFENC0595YKR32VJ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.15",
                        "commitment": "Pipes, Culverts, and Other Materials Inspections",
                        "name": "Inspect Stored Pipes and Culverts for Wildlife",
                        "text": "All pipes, culverts, and similar structures with a diameter of 0.25\ninches or greater that are stored in Project construction sites for one or more overnight periods shall\nbe thoroughly inspected by the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) for Covered\nSpecies prior to the initiation of any Covered Activity and when these materials are subsequently\nburied, capped, or otherwise used or moved in any way.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJJ7FY4RXDK08MWJQGCH": {
                        "code": "COA 11.15",
                        "commitment": "Pipes, Culverts, and Other Materials Inspections",
                        "name": "Minimize and Regularly Remove Debris Piles After Inspection",
                        "text": "Debris piles shall be kept to a minimum and\nremoved regularly after thorough inspection by the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological\nMonitor(s).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJJ7FY4RXDK08MWJQGCJ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.15",
                        "commitment": "Pipes, Culverts, and Other Materials Inspections",
                        "name": "Respond to Wildlife Found in Stored Pipes or Debris",
                        "text": "If Project personnel detect Covered Species or other wildlife within a pipe, culvert, debris\npile, or similar structure, they shall notify the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) and\nallow the animal to safely escape or be relocated by the Designated Biologist(s) outside of the Project construction site before moving, capping, burying, or utilizing the structure. If necessary, under the\ndirect supervision of the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s), Project…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJKYQ156WGZ62C1YQYFS": {
                        "code": "COA 11.16",
                        "commitment": "Disposal of Spoils, RTM, and Dredged Material",
                        "name": "Develop Spoils, RTM and Dredged Material Disposal Plan",
                        "text": "Before finalizing Project engineering design, Permittee shall coordinate with CDFW to develop a\nspoils disposal plan for the storage of spoils, RTM, and dredged materials. The spoils disposal plan\nshall describe, but not be limited to, the size, locations, and required characteristics of designated\nstorage sites; storage site preparation and dewatering; excavation of contaminated material; and\nchemical characterization, drainage, and treatment.\nThe spoils disposal plan shall include protocols…",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NK6K0BZ6XYWCKNWKMY",
                            "name": "Develop Spoils and Dredged Material Disposal Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJKZ1ZK3GZFZDFASB7W9": {
                        "code": "COA 11.16",
                        "commitment": "Disposal of Spoils, RTM, and Dredged Material",
                        "name": "Size and Site Spoils and RTM Storage Areas",
                        "text": "Permittee shall size the designated storage sites to accommodate all RTM, dredge material, or spoils\nexpected to be generated by Covered Activities and shall size and locate the sites to minimize the\nimpact or encroachment on environmentally sensitive areas within the Project Area. Permittee shall\nset aside a portion of each designated storage site for topsoil storage.",
                        "type": "Design",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJKZ1ZK3GZFZDFASB7WA": {
                        "code": "COA 11.16",
                        "commitment": "Disposal of Spoils, RTM, and Dredged Material",
                        "name": "Restrict Storage Site Placement Near Habitat and Watercourses",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not place materials where soil could\npass into Covered Species habitat (i.e. CTS breeding pools); and shall not locate storage sites where\nmaterials may be washed back into a watercourse and pass into any other waters, in accordance with\nFish and Game Code section 5650. Permittee shall use appropriate best management practices to\nprotect storage sites and prevent soil erosion.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJKZ1ZK3GZFZDFASB7WB": {
                        "code": "COA 11.16",
                        "commitment": "Disposal of Spoils, RTM, and Dredged Material",
                        "name": "Haul or Pile Cleared Vegetative Material Away From Habitat",
                        "text": "Permittee shall immediately\nhaul vegetative material off site for disposal or place the material in piles at least 200 feet from\nCovered Species habitat to be left undisturbed.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJKZ1ZK3GZFZDFASB7WC": {
                        "code": "COA 11.16",
                        "commitment": "Disposal of Spoils, RTM, and Dredged Material",
                        "name": "Restrict Chipping and Stockpiling Over Topsoil",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not chip, stockpile, and spread\nvegetative material over the topsoil unless such material does not contain seeds of invasive\nnonnative species, and it is chipped and spread immediately.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJKZ1ZK3GZFZDFASB7WD": {
                        "code": "COA 11.16",
                        "commitment": "Disposal of Spoils, RTM, and Dredged Material",
                        "name": "Backfill or Remove Grubbed Rock and Inorganic Material",
                        "text": "Permittee shall use rocks and other\ninorganic material grubbed from storage sites to backfill borrow pits at that site or shall remove these\nmaterials from the site.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJKZ1ZK3GZFZDFASB7WE": {
                        "code": "COA 11.16",
                        "commitment": "Disposal of Spoils, RTM, and Dredged Material",
                        "name": "Prevent Erosion and Toxicity from RTM Drainage Discharge",
                        "text": "Permittee shall conduct discharges from RTM draining operations in such a way as not to cause\nerosion at the discharge point. If RTM liquid requires chemical treatment, Permittee shall ensure\nchemical treatment of RTM liquid is nontoxic to aquatic organisms.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJNPKPZXW6GQRP907SEQ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.17",
                        "commitment": "Electrical Power Line Support Placement",
                        "name": "Site Power Lines and Structures to Avoid Covered Species Habitat",
                        "text": "Permittee shall coordinate with electric utilities to design and construct power transmission and\ndistribution lines and the locations of necessary structures such as supports and substations, to avoid\nCovered Species terrestrial habitats by 200 feet and aquatic habitats by 300 feet.",
                        "type": "Design",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJNQ9FV420MSYCZ3Q6ET": {
                        "code": "COA 11.17",
                        "commitment": "Electrical Power Line Support Placement",
                        "name": "Restore Areas Disturbed by Power Line Construction",
                        "text": "Where Covered\nSpecies habitat cannot be avoided, disturbance shall be minimized to the greatest degree feasible\nand all disturbed areas shall be returned to preconstruction conditions or better (see Condition of\nApproval 11.66) by reestablishing surface conditions through carefully grading and reconstructing\nCovered Species habitat features such as irrigation and drainage facilities, and replanting vegetation\nand crops (see Condition of Approval 12.3.3).",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3V103NJ75GYQV09GB8T",
                            "name": "Restore Temporarily Impacted Habitat to Pre-Project Conditions"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJQFYA8QN1KR6N41VJE2": {
                        "code": "COA 11.17.1",
                        "commitment": "Transmission Line Bird Strike Diverters",
                        "name": "Install Bird Strike Diverters on New and Existing Power Lines",
                        "text": "Permittee shall construct new power transmission and\ndistribution lines using bird strike diverters to minimize the potential for bird strikes. Permittee\nshall install bird strike diverters on existing power transmission lines equal in length to the length\nof new permanent and temporary overhead transmission lines, except where new transmission\nlines replace existing transmission lines. Permittee shall space the diverters along the lines in\naccordance with the Avian Powerline Interaction…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6YKM817BXJNTVA76DKTZ1",
                            "name": "Install Bird Strike Diverters on New Transmission Lines"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJQG67M0XWJTESQAFJ49": {
                        "code": "COA 11.17.1",
                        "commitment": "Transmission Line Bird Strike Diverters",
                        "name": "Inspect and Replace Bird Strike Diverters Annually",
                        "text": "Permittee shall inspect bird strike diverters annually and replace malfunctioning or lost\ndiverters until or unless the transmission lines are removed.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJS8SQ5SW593M924G2B3": {
                        "code": "COA 11.18",
                        "commitment": "Vegetation Management",
                        "name": "Minimize Vegetation Disturbance and Protect No-Disturbance Buffers",
                        "text": "Disturbance or removal of vegetation shall be kept to the minimum necessary to complete Covered\nActivities. Permittee shall not remove vegetation within established Covered Species no-disturbance\nbuffers.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJS8SQ5SW593M924G2B4": {
                        "code": "COA 11.18",
                        "commitment": "Vegetation Management",
                        "name": "Hand-Trim Protected Vegetation for Access Only",
                        "text": "Vegetation marked for protection may only be trimmed with hand tools limited to string\ntrimmers (e.g., weed whackers) to the extent necessary to gain access to work sites or for facility\nmaintenance, to minimize potential of crushing burrows or impacting the ground.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJS999Z18GR8YFDYGW1G": {
                        "code": "COA 11.18",
                        "commitment": "Vegetation Management",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval for Non-String-Trimmer Mowing Equipment",
                        "text": "Other mowing\nequipment requested for use by the Permittee in locations away from Covered Species refugia and\nburrow complexes shall be subject to CDFW written approval once site-specific Covered Species\nsurveys have been conducted.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34WE7XE98281ZXQVPK8",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval of Mowing or Clearing Equipment"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJS999Z18GR8YFDYGW1H": {
                        "code": "COA 11.18",
                        "commitment": "Vegetation Management",
                        "name": "Set Minimum Mower Blade Heights",
                        "text": "Where permitted, Permittee shall set mower blade heights no lower\nthan four inches, and no lower than six inches in suitable GGS habitat, unless otherwise approved by\nCDFW.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJS999Z18GR8YFDYGW1J": {
                        "code": "COA 11.18",
                        "commitment": "Vegetation Management",
                        "name": "Monitor for Fossorial Species During Vegetation Management",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor shall be on site during vegetation management activities to monitor for any fossorial Covered Species.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJS999Z18GR8YFDYGW1K": {
                        "code": "COA 11.18",
                        "commitment": "Vegetation Management",
                        "name": "Time Mowing to Species Dormancy and Dry Conditions",
                        "text": "Permittee shall ensure, to the\nextent feasible that mowing only occurs when Covered Species are dormant or less active on the\nsurface and during dry conditions (no rain within the past 24 hours).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJV4F9SC76BM0QNDZZVY": {
                        "code": "COA 11.19",
                        "commitment": "Prevention of Spread of Invasive Species",
                        "name": "Conduct Pre-Project Baseline Invasive Plant Survey",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) qualified to do botanical surveys and approved by\nCDFW shall submit the sampling methodology to CDFW as part of the appropriate Phase\nAuthorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.1 and 6.2). The baseline survey shall include both a\nqualitative and quantitative assessment of target species within the Project construction site.\nPermittee shall ensure that baseline sampling is conducted consistent with the CDFW approved\nsampling methodology prior to the start of any…",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3XZ7WK0185QGKR01860",
                            "name": "Conduct Baseline Invasive Plant Survey"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJV4F9SC76BM0QNDZZVZ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.19",
                        "commitment": "Prevention of Spread of Invasive Species",
                        "name": "Conduct Annual Invasive Plant Monitoring Survey",
                        "text": "Permittee shall ensure the same CDFW approved sampling methodology is conducted annually\nthereafter by a Designated Biologist(s). The pre-Project baseline condition survey results and\nsubsequent annual surveying shall be utilized by the Permittee in the Invasive Plan Species\nMonitoring, Management, and Control Plan (IPSMMCP Condition of Approval 11.19.1) and reporting\nprovided to CDFW in the Annual Status Report (Condition of Approval 10.13).",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H41AKKXC7WAC4X6PQP",
                            "name": "Conduct Annual Invasive Plant Survey"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJV4F9SC76BM0QNDZZW0": {
                        "code": "COA 11.19",
                        "commitment": "Prevention of Spread of Invasive Species",
                        "name": "Prevent Introduction and Spread of Invasive Species Between Sites",
                        "text": "Permittee shall conduct Covered Activities in a manner that prevents the introduction, transfer, and\nspread of invasive species, including plants, animals, and microbes (e.g., algae, fungi, parasites,\nbacteria, etc.) from one Project construction site and/or water body to another. Prevention best\nmanagement practices and guidelines for invasive plants can be found on the Cal-IPC’s website\n(http://www.cal-ipc.org/ip/prevention/index.php). Prevention best management practices and\nguidelines for…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJV4F9SC76BM0QNDZZW1": {
                        "code": "COA 11.19",
                        "commitment": "Prevention of Spread of Invasive Species",
                        "name": "Implement BMPs to Prevent Phytophthora and Mold Spread",
                        "text": "Permittee shall incorporate best\nmanagement practices approved by CDFW as part of the appropriate Project Phase Authorization\nPackage (Condition of Approval 6.1 and 6.2) to minimize risk of introduction and/or spread of molds\nsuch as Phythophthora spp. within the Project Area as introduction or exacerbation in the Project\nArea may reduce viability of restoration plantings and already occurring native plant species.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJV5HBRQ84EMFSSQ1EN9": {
                        "code": "COA 11.19",
                        "commitment": "Prevention of Spread of Invasive Species",
                        "name": "Permanently Remove Bullfrogs Encountered During Work",
                        "text": "Any bullfrogs (Rana catesbeiana) encountered during construction or monitoring shall be\npermanently removed from the wild. Pursuant to Fish and Game Code section 6854, it is unlawful to\ntake bullfrogs using firearms of any caliber or type. BB or pellet guns are prohibited.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJWX86XC6P7ST3J5X0Q8": {
                        "code": "COA 11.19.1",
                        "commitment": "Invasive Plant Species Monitoring, Management, and Control Plan",
                        "name": "Develop Draft Invasive Plant Species Management Plan",
                        "text": "Permittee shall\nconsult with CDFW and local invasive species experts such as the California Invasive Plant\nCouncil to develop a draft invasive plant species monitoring, management, and control plan (IPSMMCP) prior to starting Covered Activities that ensures invasive plant species and\npopulations are kept below preconstruction distribution levels. The draft IPSMMCP shall be\nincluded in the Pre-implementation Phase Authorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.1).\nThe IPSMMCP shall incorporate…",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NK6K0BZ6XYWCKNWKMZ",
                            "name": "Submit Invasive Plant Species Monitoring, Management and Control Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJWX86XC6P7ST3J5X0Q9": {
                        "code": "COA 11.19.1",
                        "commitment": "Invasive Plant Species Monitoring, Management, and Control Plan",
                        "name": "Submit Final IPSMMCP for Each Construction Phase",
                        "text": "Permittee shall submit a completed final IPSMMCP to CDFW for\neach Construction Phase Authorization Package, and submit related reporting as part of the\nAnnual Status Report (Condition of Approval 10.13).",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NK6K0BZ6XYWCKNWKMZ",
                            "name": "Submit Invasive Plant Species Monitoring, Management and Control Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMJYNR0JHB8SG91G6WA6E": {
                        "code": "COA 11.19.2",
                        "commitment": "Invasive Plant Species Management",
                        "name": "Oversee Invasive Plant Removal During Restoration",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological\nMonitor(s) shall oversee invasive terrestrial and aquatic plant species management utilizing best\nmanagement practices such as hand removal in seeding and planting areas during vegetation\nrestoration (see Condition of Approval 12.3.3). The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological\nMonitor(s) shall ensure that weed removal does not result in damage to root systems of the\ninstalled plants. Woody (tree or shrub) invasive plant species may require more…",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK0DDG4ZFNJAKCEHPAGJ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.20",
                        "commitment": "Hazards to Covered Species",
                        "name": "Prohibit Pets, Campfires, and Firearms at Construction Sites",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not permit pets, campfires, or firearms in Project construction sites and site access\nroutes, except firearms carried by authorized security personnel or local, state, or federal law\nenforcement officials.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK0E6ZRR9CKPYAD4WQJF": {
                        "code": "COA 11.20",
                        "commitment": "Hazards to Covered Species",
                        "name": "Store Food-Related Trash in Enclosed Containers",
                        "text": "To avoid attracting predators, Permittee shall ensure Project personnel\ndispose of all food-related trash items such as packaging, cans, bottles, and food scraps in enclosed\ncontainers.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK0E6ZRR9CKPYAD4WQJG": {
                        "code": "COA 11.20",
                        "commitment": "Hazards to Covered Species",
                        "name": "Remove Trash from Site Weekly",
                        "text": "Permittee shall ensure trash is removed from the construction site and taken to an\nappropriate facility at least once a week from the construction or Project site (see Condition of\nApproval 9.6).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK0E6ZRR9CKPYAD4WQJH": {
                        "code": "COA 11.20",
                        "commitment": "Hazards to Covered Species",
                        "name": "Include Litter Compliance Language in Contractor Contracts",
                        "text": "All contracts with contractors shall include language reminding them of the\nobligations to abide by the laws related to litter within work areas and while traveling along public\nroads within Project construction sites and/or Project maintenance areas.",
                        "type": "Other",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3KFHG8TXPSP55F7CZQA",
                            "name": "Incorporate Litter and Erosion Control Language in Contractor Contracts"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK0E6ZRR9CKPYAD4WQJJ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.20",
                        "commitment": "Hazards to Covered Species",
                        "name": "Cover and Secure Loads on Trash-Hauling Vehicles",
                        "text": "Vehicles carrying trash\nshall have loads covered and secured to prevent trash and debris from falling onto roads and\nadjacent properties.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK264B6YJSTX7W90NN3M": {
                        "code": "COA 11.21",
                        "commitment": "Hazardous Materials Management Plans",
                        "name": "Develop Hazardous Materials Management Plan Before Covered Activities",
                        "text": "Permittee shall develop and implement a hazardous materials management plan (HMMP) prior to\ninitiating Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NK6K0BZ6XYWCKNWKN0",
                            "name": "Develop Hazardous Materials Management Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK264B6YJSTX7W90NN3N": {
                        "code": "COA 11.21",
                        "commitment": "Hazardous Materials Management Plans",
                        "name": "Maintain Historic Contamination and Inspection Database",
                        "text": "A database on known historic instances of contamination and results of any field inspections regarding the\npresence of hazardous materials shall be maintained.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK264B6YJSTX7W90NN3P": {
                        "code": "COA 11.21",
                        "commitment": "Hazardous Materials Management Plans",
                        "name": "Designate Storage Sites for Fuel, Oil, and Petroleum Products",
                        "text": "storage of fuel, oil, and other petroleum products at designated sites for\nhazardous materials",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK27YFM5RYJ58JMWJ8R9": {
                        "code": "COA 11.21",
                        "commitment": "Hazardous Materials Management Plans",
                        "name": "Label Hazardous Material Containers",
                        "text": "clear labeling, handling, and safety instructions, and emergency contact\ninformation on hazardous material containers",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK27YFM5RYJ58JMWJ8RA": {
                        "code": "COA 11.21",
                        "commitment": "Hazardous Materials Management Plans",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Permission for Hazardous Material Use Near Streams",
                        "text": "use or transfer of hazardous materials near wet or\ndry streams consistent with Fish and Game Code section 5650 and with permission from CDFW",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34WE7XE98281ZXQVPK9",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Permission for Hazardous Material Use Near Streams"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK27YFM5RYJ58JMWJ8RB": {
                        "code": "COA 11.21",
                        "commitment": "Hazardous Materials Management Plans",
                        "name": "Provide Material Safety Data Sheets to Site Personnel",
                        "text": "Material Safety Data Sheets provided to all Project site personnel",
                        "type": "Training & Education",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK27YFM5RYJ58JMWJ8RC": {
                        "code": "COA 11.21",
                        "commitment": "Hazardous Materials Management Plans",
                        "name": "Limit Temporary Hazardous Materials Storage to 90 Days",
                        "text": "prohibition of the accumulation\nand temporary storage of hazardous materials exceeding 90 days",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK27YFM5RYJ58JMWJ8RD": {
                        "code": "COA 11.21",
                        "commitment": "Hazardous Materials Management Plans",
                        "name": "Segregate, Contain, and Remove Contaminated Soils",
                        "text": "segregation, containment, and\nremoval of contaminated soils to the approved disposal site",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK27YFM5RYJ58JMWJ8RE": {
                        "code": "COA 11.21",
                        "commitment": "Hazardous Materials Management Plans",
                        "name": "Stage Spill Containment and Kits at Every Work Site",
                        "text": "site-specific emergency spill\ncontainment and spill kits at every work site",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK27YFM5RYJ58JMWJ8RF": {
                        "code": "COA 11.21",
                        "commitment": "Hazardous Materials Management Plans",
                        "name": "Submit HMMP to CDFW with Construction Phase Authorization Package",
                        "text": "Permittee shall submit the HMMPs to CDFW as part of the appropriate Construction Phase\nAuthorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.2) for CDFW’s review and confirmation of\nconsistency with this ITP prior to initiating Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34WE7XE98281ZXQVPKA",
                            "name": "Submit Hazardous Materials Management Plan to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK3YTNATKZ8DGM1P6DTC": {
                        "code": "COA 11.22",
                        "commitment": "Spill Prevention, Control, and Countermeasure Plans",
                        "name": "Develop SPCCP and Ensure Stormwater Permit Compliance",
                        "text": "Permittee shall ensure compliance with all construction stormwater permitting requirements and\nshall develop and implement a Spill Prevention, Control, and Countermeasure Plan (SPCCP) at each\nProject construction site to control short-term and long-term effects associated with construction-\ngenerated stormwater runoff.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NK6K0BZ6XYWCKNWKN1",
                            "name": "Develop Spill Prevention, Control, and Countermeasure Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK3ZJQ9BHNEKAKFQY2VB": {
                        "code": "COA 11.22",
                        "commitment": "Spill Prevention, Control, and Countermeasure Plans",
                        "name": "Address Site-Specific Spill Prevention and Notification Actions",
                        "text": "Each SPCCP shall address site-specific actions used to prevent spills\nand actions that will be taken should any spills occur, including emergency notification procedures.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NK6K0BZ6XYWCKNWKN1",
                            "name": "Develop Spill Prevention, Control, and Countermeasure Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK3ZJQ9BHNEKAKFQY2VC": {
                        "code": "COA 11.22",
                        "commitment": "Spill Prevention, Control, and Countermeasure Plans",
                        "name": "Scope SPCCP to Oil and Petroleum-Based Products",
                        "text": "The SPCCPs shall be developed and implemented to minimize effects from spills of oil or oil-\ncontaining products (i.e., gasoline, diesel fuel, motor oil, hydraulic fluid, aviation fuel, oil-based\npaint, oil-based paint thinner, roofing tar, and petroleum-based solvents) during Project\nconstruction and operation.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NK6K0BZ6XYWCKNWKN1",
                            "name": "Develop Spill Prevention, Control, and Countermeasure Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK3ZJQ9BHNEKAKFQY2VD": {
                        "code": "COA 11.22",
                        "commitment": "Spill Prevention, Control, and Countermeasure Plans",
                        "name": "Train Personnel in Emergency Response and Spill Containment",
                        "text": "personnel training in emergency response and spill containment\ntechniques",
                        "type": "Training & Education",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y40SJ78J9AJM2D416MYN",
                            "name": "Conduct Spill Response and Containment Training"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK3ZJQ9BHNEKAKFQY2VE": {
                        "code": "COA 11.22",
                        "commitment": "Spill Prevention, Control, and Countermeasure Plans",
                        "name": "Store Petroleum Products at Impervious Storage Sites",
                        "text": "storage of petroleum products in non-leaking containers at impervious storage sites\nfrom which an accidental spills cannot escape",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK3ZJQ9BHNEKAKFQY2VF": {
                        "code": "COA 11.22",
                        "commitment": "Spill Prevention, Control, and Countermeasure Plans",
                        "name": "Contain Concrete and Wash Water in Watertight Structures",
                        "text": "storage of concrete, wash water, and other\ncontaminants in watertight containment structures",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK3ZJQ9BHNEKAKFQY2VG": {
                        "code": "COA 11.22",
                        "commitment": "Spill Prevention, Control, and Countermeasure Plans",
                        "name": "Maintain Spill Containment Materials in Sealed Containers",

                        "commitment": "Spill Prevention, Control, and Countermeasure Plans",

                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",

The\nGroundwater Testing and Monitoring Plan shall include but not be limited to the number and\nlocation of proposed…",

Permittee shall\nsubmit the Underground Well Detection Plan to CDFW as part of the Pre-implementation Phase\nAuthorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.1) for CDFW’s review and confirmation of\nconsistency with this ITP prior to the initiation of preconstruction Covered Activities. The\nUnderground Well Detection Plan…",
                        "type": "Plan",

                      "req_01M2ESMK7PAVW5TD19TE9Z6C2T": {
                        "code": "COA 11.24",
                        "commitment": "Detection of Underground and Natural Gas Wells",
                        "name": "Disclose Detected Wells in Construction Phase Authorization Package",
                        "text": "Any buried or abandoned wells identified through\nimplementation of the Underground Well Detection Plan shall be disclosed within the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.2).",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [

                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RA6HTPQEBMJTM46QTR",
                            "name": "Disclose Detected Wells in the Construction Phase Package"
