                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK9EW9X7X4YSN8VHGYXC": {
                        "code": "COA 11.25",
                        "commitment": "Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plans",
                        "name": "Ensure Stormwater Permit Compliance and Prepare SWPPP",
                        "text": "Permittee and its contractors shall ensure compliance with all construction stormwater permitting\nrequirements and shall prepare a stormwater pollution prevention plan (SWPPP) to control short-\nterm and long-term effects associated with construction-generated stormwater runoff to Covered\nSpecies, prevent sediment from entering sensitive habitats, and reduce erosion, dust, and other\ndeleterious aspects of Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NK6K0BZ6XYWCKNWKN4",
                            "name": "Prepare Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK9F910VNEH5Y3ZKSX7Z": {
                        "code": "COA 11.25",
                        "commitment": "Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plans",
                        "name": "Meet SWRCB and Central Valley RWQCB Stormwater Requirements",
                        "text": "The SWPPP shall include all applicable SWRCB and Central\nValley RWQCB requirements regarding construction-generated stormwater collection, detention,\ntreatment, and discharge that will be in place throughout the duration of Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NK6K0BZ6XYWCKNWKN4",
                            "name": "Prepare Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK9F910VNEH5Y3ZKSX80": {
                        "code": "COA 11.25",
                        "commitment": "Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plans",
                        "name": "Address Core SWPPP Control Measure Categories",
                        "text": "The\nSWPPP shall include measures that address erosion and sediment control (Condition of Approval\n11.26), management of construction materials, waste management measures, water pollution\ncontrol measures, site dewatering and pipeline testing, accidental spill prevention and response,\nhazardous materials management plan (Condition of Approval 11.21), site inspection and monitoring,\nand measures to prevent non-stormwater discharges from reaching surface waters.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NK6K0BZ6XYWCKNWKN4",
                            "name": "Prepare Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK9F910VNEH5Y3ZKSX81": {
                        "code": "COA 11.25",
                        "commitment": "Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plans",
                        "name": "Prevent Non-Stormwater Discharges to Surface Waters",
                        "text": "measures to prevent non-stormwater discharges from reaching surface waters. Non-stormwater\ndischarge examples include washing vehicles, cleaning streets, or applying erodible landscape\nmaterial during rain.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK9F910VNEH5Y3ZKSX82": {
                        "code": "COA 11.25",
                        "commitment": "Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plans",
                        "name": "Describe Site Conditions, Schedules, Materials, and Training in SWPPP",
                        "text": "The SWPPP shall also describe site topographic, soil, and hydrologic\ncharacteristics; construction activities and schedules; construction materials to be used, including\nsources of imported fill material and other potential polluting sources; housekeeping BMPs; BMP\nsite, implementation, and inspection schedules; and ongoing personnel training requirements.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NK6K0BZ6XYWCKNWKN4",
                            "name": "Prepare Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK9F910VNEH5Y3ZKSX83": {
                        "code": "COA 11.25",
                        "commitment": "Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plans",
                        "name": "Specify SMARTS Reporting Forms and Records",
                        "text": "The\nSWPPP shall also specify the forms and records that must be uploaded to the State Water Board\nonline [Stormwater Multiple Application and Report Tracking System (SMARTS)] at\nhttps://smarts.waterboards.ca.gov, such as quarterly non-stormwater inspection and annual\ncompliance reports.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RB67EQDRWNDJBKFW6W",
                            "name": "Upload Stormwater Forms and Records to SMARTS"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMK9F910VNEH5Y3ZKSX84": {
                        "code": "COA 11.25",
                        "commitment": "Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plans",
                        "name": "Submit SWPPP to CDFW with Construction Phase Authorization Package",
                        "text": "Permittee shall submit the SWPPP to CDFW as part of the appropriate\nConstruction Phase Authorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.2) for CDFW’s review and\nconfirmation of consistency with this ITP prior to initiating Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34WE7XE98281ZXQVPKC",
                            "name": "Submit Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plan to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKB7XTCSNNGN1FT760N3": {
                        "code": "COA 11.26",
                        "commitment": "Erosion and Sediment Control Plans",
                        "name": "Submit and Implement Site-Specific Erosion and Sediment Control Plan",
                        "text": "Permittee shall submit the erosion and sediment control plans to CDFW as part of the appropriate\nConstruction Phase Authorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.2) for CDFW’s review and\nconfirmation of consistency with this ITP prior to initiating Covered Activities. Permittee shall\nimplement erosion and sediment control measures during Covered Activities to facilitate visibility\nduring monitoring of the Covered Species by the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological\nMonitor(s). Each…",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NMGVH2VJSMJC7KKSH7",
                            "name": "Submit Erosion and Sediment Control Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKB8BZD2X5Z1JJH7FZCM": {
                        "code": "COA 11.26",
                        "commitment": "Erosion and Sediment Control Plans",
                        "name": "Maintain Emergency Erosion Control Supplies",
                        "text": "maintaining emergency erosion control supplies at all times during construction and replacing used emergency materials within 48 hours",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },

                        "code": "COA 11.26",
                        "commitment": "Erosion and Sediment Control Plans",
                        "name": "Minimize Disturbance of Terrain and Natural Land Features",
                        "text": "minimal disturbance of the terrain and natural\nland features",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKB8BZD2X5Z1JJH7FZCP": {
                        "code": "COA 11.26",
                        "commitment": "Erosion and Sediment Control Plans",
                        "name": "Divert Runoff Away from Steep or Denuded Slopes",
                        "text": "diverting runoff away from steep, denuded slopes or other critical areas with barriers,\nberms, ditches, or other facilities",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKB8BZD2X5Z1JJH7FZCQ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.26",
                        "commitment": "Erosion and Sediment Control Plans",
                        "name": "Retain Trees and Vegetation to Stabilize Hillsides",
                        "text": "retaining trees and vegetation where practicable to stabilize\nhillsides, retain moisture, and reduce erosion",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKB8BZD2X5Z1JJH7FZCR": {
                        "code": "COA 11.26",
                        "commitment": "Erosion and Sediment Control Plans",
                        "name": "Limit Ground Disturbance to Stable Areas",
                        "text": "limiting ground disturbance to areas of proven\nstability",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKB8BZD2X5Z1JJH7FZCS": {
                        "code": "COA 11.26",
                        "commitment": "Erosion and Sediment Control Plans",
                        "name": "Sequence Clearing to Minimize Soil Disturbance Time",
                        "text": "using sequence clearing of native vegetation and soil disturbance to minimize overall time\nof soil disturbance",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKB95CSAHR95M0TPRXZT": {
                        "code": "COA 11.26",
                        "commitment": "Erosion and Sediment Control Plans",
                        "name": "Inspect Erosion Controls and Schedule Around Rain Events",
                        "text": "implementing construction management and site inspections before, during,\nand after rain events; scheduling measures to mitigate erosion from rainfall events, runoff, or\nflooding at construction sites",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKB95CSAHR95M0TPRXZV": {
                        "code": "COA 11.26",
                        "commitment": "Erosion and Sediment Control Plans",
                        "name": "Install Runoff and Drainage Control Features",
                        "text": "installing runoff and drainage control features (e.g., berms and\nswales, slope drains)",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKB95CSAHR95M0TPRXZW": {
                        "code": "COA 11.26",
                        "commitment": "Erosion and Sediment Control Plans",
                        "name": "Install Wind Erosion Control Features",
                        "text": "installing wind erosion control features (e.g., application of hydraulic mulch or\nbonded fiber matrix)",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKB95CSAHR95M0TPRXZX": {
                        "code": "COA 11.26",
                        "commitment": "Erosion and Sediment Control Plans",
                        "name": "Contain Concrete and Wash Water to Protect Surface Waters",
                        "text": "use of watertight forms and other containment structures to prevent\nspills or discharge of raw concrete, wash water, and other contaminants from entering surface\nwaters and other sensitive habitats.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKB95CSAHR95M0TPRXZY": {
                        "code": "COA 11.26",
                        "commitment": "Erosion and Sediment Control Plans",
                        "name": "Control On-Site Sediment Transport and Turbidity",
                        "text": "Sediment control measures shall include measures to retain sediment transported by on-site run-on\nor runoff; collect and direct surface runoff at non-erosive velocities to common drainage courses for\nstorage and reuse; use sediment and turbidity areas where ground disturbance is adjacent to surface\nwaters or wetlands; prevent mud tracking;",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKB95CSAHR95M0TPRXZZ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.26",
                        "commitment": "Erosion and Sediment Control Plans",
                        "name": "Cover Stockpiled Excavated Materials Away from Drainage Courses",
                        "text": "deposit or store excavated materials away from\ndrainage courses and keep them covered when stored over five days or within 48 hours of a\nforecasted rain event.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKB95CSAHR95M0TPRY00": {
                        "code": "COA 11.26",
                        "commitment": "Erosion and Sediment Control Plans",
                        "name": "Replace or Upgrade Drainage Facilities to Minimize Erosion",
                        "text": "Additional replacement of or upgrades to drainage facilities shall be\nimplemented to avoid and minimize erosion.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKB95CSAHR95M0TPRY01": {
                        "code": "COA 11.26",
                        "commitment": "Erosion and Sediment Control Plans",
                        "name": "Repave Construction-Damaged Pavement to Prevent Erosion",
                        "text": "Paved areas damaged by construction activities shall be\nrepaved to avoid erosion due to pavement damage.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKCZB1AQW6B43EGM7WRB": {
                        "code": "COA 11.27",
                        "commitment": "Erosion Control Stabilization Prohibitions",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval for Erosion Control Stabilization Measures",
                        "text": "Permittee shall submit proposed erosion control stabilization measures to CDFW as part of the\nErosion and Sediment Control Plan (Condition of Approval 11.26) or separately within the\nappropriate Construction Phased Authorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.2) for review and\nwritten approval prior to initiating Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34WE7XE98281ZXQVPKD",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval of Erosion Control Stabilization Measures"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKD0JHB00RJNR3WFEE54": {
                        "code": "COA 11.27",
                        "commitment": "Erosion Control Stabilization Prohibitions",
                        "name": "Prohibit Monofilament and Synthetic Netting for Erosion Control",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not use plastic monofilament\nnetting or similar material such as nylon or netting with cross joins that are bound or stitched (such\nas straw wattles, fiber rolls, or erosion-control blankets) in the Project Area for erosion control to\navoid entanglement, strangling, or entrapment of Covered Species. Permittee shall not use products\nthat use photodegradable or biodegradable synthetic netting.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKD0JHB00RJNR3WFEE55": {
                        "code": "COA 11.27",
                        "commitment": "Erosion Control Stabilization Prohibitions",
                        "name": "Use Approved Erosion Control Material Composition and Installation",
                        "text": "Any geo-textile material or filter fabric\nused within Project construction sites shall not contain any petroleum-based products without prior\nwritten approval from CDFW. Acceptable materials include natural fibers such as jute matting,\ncoconut, twine, or other similar fibers or tackified hydroseeding compounds with native seed mix. All\nmaterial used within or adjacent to Project construction sites shall be free of invasive plant\npropagules. No geotextile fabrics shall be placed where they may…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKD0JHB00RJNR3WFEE56": {
                        "code": "COA 11.27",
                        "commitment": "Erosion Control Stabilization Prohibitions",
                        "name": "Include Erosion Control Material Standard in Contractor Bid Specifications",
                        "text": "Permittee shall communicate this measure to Project contractor(s) throughout specifications or\nspecial provisions included in the construction bid solicitation package.",
                        "type": "Other",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3KFHG8TXPSP55F7CZQA",
                            "name": "Incorporate Litter and Erosion Control Language in Contractor Contracts"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKD1149R8RFXNQY4H35H": {
                        "code": "COA 11.27",
                        "commitment": "Erosion Control Stabilization Prohibitions",
                        "name": "Consult 72-Hour Weather Forecasts Before Sediment-Risk Activities",
                        "text": "Permittee shall consult 72-\nhour weather forecasts from the National Weather Service prior to startup of Covered Activities\nwithin a construction site that may result in sediment runoff to any source of water.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKD1149R8RFXNQY4H35J": {
                        "code": "COA 11.27",
                        "commitment": "Erosion Control Stabilization Prohibitions",
                        "name": "Delay Sediment-Risk Activities Until Erosion Controls Are Complete",
                        "text": "Permittee may\nnot start Covered Activities within a construction site that may cause the introduction of sediments\ninto a waterway if the erosion control measures applicable to that construction site cannot be\ncompleted prior to the onset of a rain event (rainfall exceeding 0.25 inches during a 24-hour period).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37TC7ZSR7P81QYD2TH8",
                            "name": "Install erosion and sediment controls ahead of storms"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKD1149R8RFXNQY4H35K": {
                        "code": "COA 11.27",
                        "commitment": "Erosion Control Stabilization Prohibitions",
                        "name": "Monitor and Repair Erosion Controls Around Rain Events",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall monitor erosion control measures\nbefore, during, and after each rain event, and Permittee shall repair and/or replace ineffective\nmeasures immediately.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKERYGPK854VAVG6EA2F": {
                        "code": "COA 11.28",
                        "commitment": "Monofilament Netting Prohibition",
                        "name": "Prohibit Monofilament Netting Site-Wide",
                        "text": "Permittee shall prohibit the use of plastic monofilament netting (erosion control matting) or similar\nmaterial on the Project Site for exclusionary fencing, non-disturbance buffers, environmentally\nsensitive areas (ESAs), erosion control (see Condition of Approval 11.27), or any other purpose, to\navoid entanglement hazards to Covered Species.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKGHYQC5TH3EPKATNKAS": {
                        "code": "COA 11.29",
                        "commitment": "Fugitive Dust Control",
                        "name": "Submit Fugitive Dust Control and Monitoring Plan",
                        "text": "Permittee shall identify measures within a Fugitive Dust Control and Monitoring Plan and\nsubmit the Plan to CDFW as part of the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization Package(s)\n(Condition of Approval 6.2).",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NMGVH2VJSMJC7KKSH8",
                            "name": "Submit Fugitive Dust Control and Monitoring Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKGJBCK65KGGWNK6WZX8": {
                        "code": "COA 11.29",
                        "commitment": "Fugitive Dust Control",
                        "name": "Implement Construction-Area Fugitive Dust BMPs",
                        "text": "Permittee shall implement fugitive dust control measures and enhanced dust control measures at all\nconstruction and staging areas to reduce construction-related fugitive dust.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKGJBCK65KGGWNK6WZX9": {
                        "code": "COA 11.29",
                        "commitment": "Fugitive Dust Control",
                        "name": "Plant Vegetative Ground Cover After Construction",
                        "text": "planting and watering vegetative ground cover (native\ngrass/plant seed) in disturbed areas (including stockpiles) after construction is completed",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6YKM817BXJNTVA76DKTZ5",
                            "name": "Plant Vegetative Ground Cover on Disturbed Areas"
                          }
                        ]
                      },

                        "name": "Limit Vehicle Speed on Unpaved Roads to 10 MPH",
                        "text": "limiting vehicle speeds on unpaved roads\nto 10 miles per hour",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKJ962P3Z8GXN62B4VFD": {
                        "code": "COA 11.30",
                        "commitment": "Construction Mercury Management and Monitoring Plan",
                        "name": "Finalize and Obtain CDFW Approval of MMMP",
                        "text": "Permittee shall work collaboratively with CDFW to\nincorporate comments into the draft plan and submit the final MMMP to CDFW for review and\napproval a minimum of one year prior to initiating any in-water Covered Activity.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NMGVH2VJSMJC7KKSH9",
                            "name": "Submit Mercury Management and Monitoring Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKJ962P3Z8GXN62B4VFE": {
                        "code": "COA 11.30",
                        "commitment": "Construction Mercury Management and Monitoring Plan",
                        "name": "Conduct Baseline and Annual In-Water Mercury Monitoring",
                        "text": "The MMMP shall include but\nnot be limited to methodology to evaluate baseline water quality conditions prior to construction to\ncharacterize mercury sources and concentrations of mercury, methylmercury, organic carbon, iron,\nand sulfate at the Project construction site and include mercury monitoring measures to be\nimplemented during in-water Covered Activities to evaluate any changes resulting from Covered\nActivities.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H41AKKXC7WAC4X6PQQ",
                            "name": "Conduct Baseline and Annual In-Water Mercury Monitoring"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKJAAEK7P784Z3NXA5NK": {
                        "code": "COA 11.30",
                        "commitment": "Construction Mercury Management and Monitoring Plan",
                        "name": "Report Mercury Monitoring Results to CDFW",
                        "text": "Information obtained through\nimplementation of the MMMP shall be reported in the Monthly Compliance Report (Condition of\nApproval 10.12) and summarized in the Annual Status Report (Condition of Approval 10.13).",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R99JZNVA7RWDTVTCW4",
                            "name": "Report Mercury Monitoring Results to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKM0VEBTJPRJMCT61J08": {
                        "code": "COA 11.31.1",
                        "commitment": "Preconstruction Geotechnical Exploration Work Windows",
                        "name": "Submit Over-Water Geotechnical Exploration Description for CDFW Approval",
                        "text": "Permittee shall submit a description of all over-\nwater geotechnical exploration activities to CDFW as part of the Pre-implementation Phase\nAuthorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.1) to be reviewed and approved prior to the\ninitiation of preconstruction activities. Information provided to CDFW shall include the\ndescription of the activities to be undertaken, number of exploratory sites, spatial extent of over-\nwater activities, exploration depth for each exploration, and minimization…",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34WE7XE98281ZXQVPKE",
                            "name": "Submit Over-Water Geotechnical Exploration Description to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKM1QM5KYNMAGYR6THA6": {
                        "code": "COA 11.31.1",
                        "commitment": "Preconstruction Geotechnical Exploration Work Windows",
                        "name": "Restrict Geotechnical Exploration to Aug 1–Oct 31 Window",
                        "text": "Permittee shall only conduct over-water geotechnical exploration from August 1 –\nOctober 31.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKM1QM5KYNMAGYR6THA7": {
                        "code": "COA 11.31.1",
                        "commitment": "Preconstruction Geotechnical Exploration Work Windows",
                        "name": "Enforce Daily Sunset-to-Sunrise In-Water Work Curfew",
                        "text": "Permittee shall terminate all in-water exploratory activities 30 minutes before sunset and\nshall not resume until 30 minutes after sunrise, consistent with Condition of Approval\n11.32.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKNRCMV0V8XY1Q4V7P6R": {
                        "code": "COA 11.31.2",
                        "commitment": "Construction In-Water Work Windows and Pile Driving Limits",
                        "name": "Restrict In-Water Construction to June 1–Oct 31 Window",
                        "text": "Permittee shall only conduct in-water Covered Activities associated with construction or\nmodification of bridges over Snodgrass Slough at Hood-Franklin Road and at Burns Cut\nnear Port of Stockton from June 1 – October 31",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKNRCMV0V8XY1Q4V7P6S": {
                        "code": "COA 11.31.2",
                        "commitment": "Construction In-Water Work Windows and Pile Driving Limits",
                        "name": "Cap Impact Pile Driving Within Table 4–6 Limits",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not exceed the limits on pile driving identified in Tables 4 - 6 below and as\napproved by CDFW in the pile driving plan (Condition of Approval 11.34).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKNSX5WPNMGT57793V97": {
                        "code": "COA 11.31.2",
                        "commitment": "Construction In-Water Work Windows and Pile Driving Limits",
                        "name": "Allow Year-Round Pile Driving Inside Cofferdams or Training Walls",
                        "text": "Permittee may conduct in-water impact pile installation at any time of year if it occurs 1)\nwithin a cofferdam, or 2) behind the sheet pile training walls, and in either case, only if\nPermittee conducts in-channel acoustic monitoring to verify that generated sound\nthresholds do not exceed the 150-decibel (dB) behavioral criterion at 10 meters from the\ncofferdam or sheet pile training walls, as described in the CDFW-approved underwater\nsound abatement plan provided in Condition of Approval…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37SEW3JD5E67FT3BE0T",
                            "name": "Conduct hydroacoustic monitoring during in-water pile driving"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKNSX5WPNMGT57793V98": {
                        "code": "COA 11.31.2",
                        "commitment": "Construction In-Water Work Windows and Pile Driving Limits",
                        "name": "Permit Shoulder-Season Pile Driving With Noise Attenuation",
                        "text": "Permittee may conduct in-water impact pile driving (i.e., outside of a cofferdam or sheet pile\nwalls) at the north Delta intakes from May 16 – May 31 and November 1 – November 15 if\nbubble curtains or other measures for noise attenuation demonstrate that an equivalent level\nof protection can be achieved as during the June 1 – October 31 work window and real-time\nmonitoring of Covered Species demonstrates absence in the work area, and as approved in\nwriting by CDFW.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKNSX5WPNMGT57793V99": {
                        "code": "COA 11.31.2",
                        "commitment": "Construction In-Water Work Windows and Pile Driving Limits",
                        "name": "Verify Sound Below 150 dB Outside the Work Window",
                        "text": "In-channel acoustic monitoring is required to verify that generated sound\nthresholds do not exceed the disturbance threshold of 150 dB at 10 meters from source.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKNSX5WPNMGT57793V9A": {
                        "code": "COA 11.31.2",
                        "commitment": "Construction In-Water Work Windows and Pile Driving Limits",
                        "name": "Submit In-Water Pile Driving Plan for CDFW Approval",
                        "text": "Permittee shall provide information regarding planned in-water pile driving, including the site\nlocation(s), schedules, work activities, anticipated effects to water quality or Covered Species, and\ncommunications with other agencies and organizations with site-specific details regarding any\ntemporary partial channel closures within the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization\nPackage (Condition of Approval 6.2) for CDFW review and written approval, prior to initiating in-\nwater Covered…",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34X89RDDJZVZVMK8Y0B",
                            "name": "Submit In-Water Pile Driving Information to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKNSX5WPNMGT57793V9B": {
                        "code": "COA 11.31.2",
                        "commitment": "Construction In-Water Work Windows and Pile Driving Limits",
                        "name": "Notify CDFW 60 Days Before In-Water Maintenance",
                        "text": "After construction, Permittee shall notify CDFW 60 days before\nbeginning any in-water maintenance activities and provide information including the site\nlocation(s), schedules, work activities, anticipated effects to water quality or Covered Species, and\ncommunications with other agencies and organizations with site-specific details regarding any\ntemporary partial channel closures, and obtain CDFW’s written approval before proceeding.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RB67EQDRWNDJBKFW6X",
                            "name": "Notify CDFW 60 Days Before In-Water Maintenance"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKQJF35M22DBMHN9PNW7": {
                        "code": "COA 11.32",
                        "commitment": "Daily In-Water Work Restriction",
                        "name": "Enforce Daily Sunset-to-Sunrise In-Water Work Curfew",
                        "text": "Permittee shall terminate all in-water Covered Activities during all Project phases (i.e.,\npreconstruction, construction, and maintenance) 30 minutes before sunset and shall not resume until 30 minutes after sunrise.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKQKE1D1BZDS4B33EYMB": {
                        "code": "COA 11.32",
                        "commitment": "Daily In-Water Work Restriction",
                        "name": "Restrict Pile Driving to 7 AM–7 PM",
                        "text": "Additionally, pile driving\nshall not occur before 7:00 a.m. or after 7:00 p.m.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKSA5B31E9JAZ7XQPKZF": {
                        "code": "COA 11.33",
                        "commitment": "Underwater Sound Abatement Plan",
                        "name": "Develop and Implement Underwater Sound Abatement Plan",
                        "text": "Permittee shall coordinate with CDFW to develop an underwater sound abatement plan outlining\nspecific measures to avoid and minimize the effects of underwater construction noise on Covered\nFish Species. The underwater sound abatement plan shall be provided to CDFW as part of the\nappropriate Construction Phase Authorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.2) for review and\nwritten approval prior to initiating Covered Activities. Permittee shall not initiate in-water Covered\nActivities until the…",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NNJMTS3JZDQQZNRKEM",
                            "name": "Submit Underwater Sound Abatement Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKSA5B31E9JAZ7XQPKZG": {
                        "code": "COA 11.33",
                        "commitment": "Underwater Sound Abatement Plan",
                        "name": "Deploy Noise-Attenuation Equipment for Impact Pile Driving",
                        "text": "Equipment to minimize underwater noise generated by impact pile\ndriving shall include using vibratory rather than impact pile driving equipment where feasible; noise\nattenuation with pile caps (e.g., wood or micarta), bubble curtains, air-filled fabric barriers, or\nisolation piles; or installation of piling-specific cofferdams.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKSA5B31E9JAZ7XQPKZH": {
                        "code": "COA 11.33",
                        "commitment": "Underwater Sound Abatement Plan",
                        "name": "Monitor Work Area for Distressed or Injured Fish",
                        "text": "Monitoring the in-water work area for fish that may be showing signs of distress or injury as a\nresult of pile driving activities and stopping work when distressed or injured fish are observed,\nfor example, if injured fish are seen floating near the surface.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKSB96CWQM0DXWY5AQH0": {
                        "code": "COA 11.33",
                        "commitment": "Underwater Sound Abatement Plan",
                        "name": "Apply Soft-Start Sequence to Impact Pile Driving",
                        "text": "Initiating impact pile driving with a “soft-start” where feasible, such that pile strikes are\ninitiated at reduced impact and increase to full impact over several strikes to provide fish an\nopportunity to move out of the area. Specifically, “soft-start” requires Permittee to initiate\npile driving at less than full impact force for a period of 15 seconds followed by 30 seconds of\nno activity for all in-water piles or piles that occur within 200 linear feet of the water’s edge.\nThis action shall…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKSB96CWQM0DXWY5AQH1": {
                        "code": "COA 11.33",
                        "commitment": "Underwater Sound Abatement Plan",
                        "name": "Provide Fish Escape Route for Multiple Pile Driving Rigs",
                        "text": "If more than one pile driving rig is employed, ensuring pile driving activities are initiated in a\nway that provides an escape route to avoid “trapping” fish between pile drivers in waters\nexposed to underwater noise levels that could potentially cause injury.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKSB96CWQM0DXWY5AQH2": {
                        "code": "COA 11.33",
                        "commitment": "Underwater Sound Abatement Plan",
                        "name": "Report Hydroacoustic Threshold Exceedances Within One Business Day",
                        "text": "Reporting exceedances of hydroacoustic thresholds to CDFW within one business day of any\nexceedance and implementing corrective actions as determined through coordination with\nCDFW.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R99JZNVA7RWDTVTCW6",
                            "name": "Report Hydroacoustic Threshold Exceedances to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKSB96CWQM0DXWY5AQH3": {
                        "code": "COA 11.33",
                        "commitment": "Underwater Sound Abatement Plan",
                        "name": "Report Hydroacoustic Results in Compliance and Status Reports",
                        "text": "The results of\nhydroacoustic monitoring shall be made available to CDFW upon request and submitted in the\nappropriate Monthly Compliance Report (Condition of Approval 10.12) and Annual Status Report\n(Condition of Approval 10.13).",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R99JZNVA7RWDTVTCW5",
                            "name": "Report Hydroacoustic and Pile Driving Monitoring Results"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKSB96CWQM0DXWY5AQH4": {
                        "code": "COA 11.33",
                        "commitment": "Underwater Sound Abatement Plan",
                        "name": "Conduct Two-Hydrophone Hydroacoustic Monitoring Per Site",
                        "text": "Procedures for hydroacoustic monitoring shall be consistent with the California Department of\nTransportation 2020 Technical Guidance for the Assessment of Hydroacoustic Effects of Pile Driving\non Fish. Hydroacoustic monitoring shall at a minimum consist of two hydrophones used at each site\nto monitor in-water Covered Activities. Hydrophones shall be calibrated prior to deployment and\nmaintained with best management practices. All hydrophones shall be placed at least 1 meter below\nthe water…",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKSB96CWQM0DXWY5AQH5": {
                        "code": "COA 11.33",
                        "commitment": "Underwater Sound Abatement Plan",
                        "name": "Maintain Injury Thresholds During the Construction Work Window",
                        "text": "Injury threshold for fish of all sizes includes a peak sound pressure level (SPL) of 206 dB\nrelative to 1 micropascal; • Injury threshold for fish less than 2 grams is 183 dB relative to 1 micropascal cumulative\nsound exposure level (SELcumulative); and • Injury threshold for fish greater than or equal to 2 grams is 187 dB relative to 1 micropascal\nSELcumulative.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKSB96CWQM0DXWY5AQH6": {
                        "code": "COA 11.33",
                        "commitment": "Underwater Sound Abatement Plan",
                        "name": "Maintain Disturbance Threshold Outside the Work Window",
                        "text": "Disturbance threshold for fish of all sizes is 150 dB root mean square relative to 1 micropascal.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKSB96CWQM0DXWY5AQH7": {
                        "code": "COA 11.33",
                        "commitment": "Underwater Sound Abatement Plan",
                        "name": "Coordinate CDFW/NMFS/USFWS Time-of-Day Pile Driving Restriction",
                        "text": "Restricting impact pile driving activities to specific times of the day and for a specific duration\nto be determined through coordination with CDFW, NMFS, and USFWS and subject to CDFW\napproval.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKV3GT4BZZAA72R61S1X": {
                        "code": "COA 11.34",
                        "commitment": "Pile Driving Plan",
                        "name": "Submit Pile Driving Plan for CDFW Approval",
                        "text": "Permittee shall submit the pile driving plan to CDFW as part of the Pre-implementation\nPhase Authorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.1) for review and written approval prior to\ninitiating Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NNJMTS3JZDQQZNRKEN",
                            "name": "Submit Pile Driving Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKWWFQ2XBV3AV9Z71DHD": {
                        "code": "COA 11.35",
                        "commitment": "Fish Salvage Plan",
                        "name": "Develop and Obtain CDFW Approval of Fish Salvage Plan",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not initiate Covered Activities until the final fish\nsalvage plan is approved in writing by CDFW.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NNJMTS3JZDQQZNRKEP",
                            "name": "Submit Fish Salvage Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKWX75VN6Q904Q7QHHXM": {
                        "code": "COA 11.35",
                        "commitment": "Fish Salvage Plan",
                        "name": "Notify CDFW Before Dewatering or Fish-Isolating Activities",
                        "text": "CDFW at least seven days prior to site-specific dewatering activities that are expected to\nrequire fish salvage or prior to an anticipated activity that could result in isolating fish, such as\ninstallation of a cofferdam.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RB67EQDRWNDJBKFW6Y",
                            "name": "Notify CDFW Before Dewatering or Fish-Isolating Work"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKWX75VN6Q904Q7QHHXN": {
                        "code": "COA 11.35",
                        "commitment": "Fish Salvage Plan",
                        "name": "Exclude, Capture, Hold and Release Fish During Salvage",
                        "text": "Appropriate site-specific procedures for excluding fish from construction zones, removing fish\nfrom construction zones should they become trapped, and preventing fish from reentering\nconstruction zones prior to dewatering based on site-specific conditions and construction\nmethods.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37SEW3JD5E67FT3BE0V",
                            "name": "Complete fish salvage and relocation before in-water work"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKWX75VN6Q904Q7QHHXP": {
                        "code": "COA 11.35",
                        "commitment": "Fish Salvage Plan",
                        "name": "Train and Staff Fish Salvage Teams with a Biologist",
                        "text": "Requirement that each fish salvage team conducting fish salvage efforts have at least one\nDesignated Fisheries Biologist. Safety training for fish rescue workers shall be provided prior\nto accessing the work site.",
                        "type": "Training & Education",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y40SJ78J9AJM2D416MYQ",
                            "name": "Train and Staff Fish Salvage Teams Before Site Access"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKWX75VN6Q904Q7QHHXQ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.35",
                        "commitment": "Fish Salvage Plan",
                        "name": "Preserve and Deliver Dead Covered Fish Specimens to CDFW",
                        "text": "The Designated Fisheries Biologist(s) shall place dead Covered Fish Species in sealed plastic bags with\nlabels indicating species, location, date, and time of collection, store them on ice, freeze as soon as\npossible, and provide the frozen specimens to CDFW.",
                        "type": "Other",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKWX75VN6Q904Q7QHHXR": {
                        "code": "COA 11.35",
                        "commitment": "Fish Salvage Plan",
                        "name": "Report Fish Salvage Results in Annual Status Report",
                        "text": "Permittee shall describe implementation of the fish salvage plan and provide a summary of the\nresults of the fish salvage operations (including date, time, location, comments, method of capture,\nfish species, number of fish, approximate age, condition, release location, and release time) to CDFW\nas part of the Annual Status Report (Condition of Approval 10.13).",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R3GHBSN2G09CZKZQ72",
                            "name": "Deliver Annual Status Report to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKWX75VN6Q904Q7QHHXS": {
                        "code": "COA 11.35",
                        "commitment": "Fish Salvage Plan",
                        "name": "Provide CDFW Site Access During Fish Salvage Activities",
                        "text": "Provide CDFW with unrestricted access to construction sites for the duration of\nimplementation of the fish salvage plan and fish salvage activities.",
                        "type": "Other",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKYNZZAGM46HKFBZYF2R": {
                        "code": "COA 11.36",
                        "commitment": "Barge Operations Plan",
                        "name": "Develop and Obtain CDFW Approval of Barge Operations Plan",
                        "text": "submit the final Barge Operations Plan to CDFW for review and\napproval a minimum of one year prior to initiating any in-water Covered Activity.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NNJMTS3JZDQQZNRKEQ",
                            "name": "Submit Barge Operations Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKYPBG0Z69DC9K48B19H": {
                        "code": "COA 11.36",
                        "commitment": "Barge Operations Plan",
                        "name": "Operate Vessels per Barge Operations BMPs",
                        "text": "Limit vessel speeds to maintain wake heights of less than two feet at shore to minimize\nthe potential for vessel wakes to strand Covered Species and the effects of wakes on\nunarmored or vegetated banks.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKYPBG0Z69DC9K48B19J": {
                        "code": "COA 11.36",
                        "commitment": "Barge Operations Plan",
                        "name": "Train Tugboat and Barge Operators",
                        "text": "Ensure that tugboat and barge operators are trained to minimize impacts on Covered\nSpecies’ habitats such as reducing the effects of wake on vegetated banks.",
                        "type": "Training & Education",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y40SJ78J9AJM2D416MYP",
                            "name": "Train Tugboat and Barge Operators on Habitat Impacts"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKYPBG0Z69DC9K48B19K": {
                        "code": "COA 11.36",
                        "commitment": "Barge Operations Plan",
                        "name": "Inspect In-Water Equipment for Invasive Species Before Deployment",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) or Fisheries Biologist(s) shall conduct visual inspections for\ninvasive aquatic species on all in-water equipment, such as barges and small work boats,\nprior to equipment deployment into a waterway.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKYPBG0Z69DC9K48B19M": {
                        "code": "COA 11.36",
                        "commitment": "Barge Operations Plan",
                        "name": "Report Detected Invasive Species to CDFW Within 24 Hours",
                        "text": "If the Designated Biologist(s) or Fisheries\nBiologist(s) detects the presence of invasive aquatic species on equipment, the Permittee\nshall report the presence to CDFW within 24 hours and follow quarantine guidelines as\nprovided by CDFW prior to the equipment entering a waterway.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RC1N589S9ETAS5HQJN",
                            "name": "Report Invasive Aquatic Species Detections to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKYQ8AM5AR4SCE24X1JB": {
                        "code": "COA 11.36",
                        "commitment": "Barge Operations Plan",
                        "name": "Monitor Barge Loading, Unloading and Geotechnical Activities",
                        "text": "Observe barge operation activities including loading and unloading.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKYQ8AM5AR4SCE24X1JC": {
                        "code": "COA 11.36",
                        "commitment": "Barge Operations Plan",
                        "name": "Report Vessel Groundings and Plan Deviations Within 24 Hours",
                        "text": "Report to CDFW within 24 hours any vessel grounding and deviations from the\nbarge operations plan, and barge operations that could have resulted in the\ndisturbance of bottom sediments, damage to riverbanks, loss of submerged,\nemergent, or riparian vegetation or impacts to Covered Species.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RB67EQDRWNDJBKFW70",
                            "name": "Report Vessel Groundings and Barge Plan Deviations to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKYQ8AM5AR4SCE24X1JD": {
                        "code": "COA 11.36",
                        "commitment": "Barge Operations Plan",
                        "name": "Summarize Annual Barge Monitoring in the Annual Status Report",
                        "text": "Provide summary information on monitoring observations over the course of each\nyear, including an evaluation of the plan performance measures.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R3GHBSN2G09CZKZQ72",
                            "name": "Deliver Annual Status Report to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKYQ8AM5AR4SCE24X1JE": {
                        "code": "COA 11.36",
                        "commitment": "Barge Operations Plan",
                        "name": "Survey Riverbank and Vegetation Conditions at Barge Sites",
                        "text": "Visit each site requiring barges to determine the extent of emergent and riparian\nvegetation, bank conditions, and general site conditions during the growing season\nprior to initiation of construction activities, during construction, and then annually\nfor up to five years after construction.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H41AKKXC7WAC4X6PQR",
                            "name": "Survey Riverbank and Vegetation Conditions at Barge Sites"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKYQ8AM5AR4SCE24X1JF": {
                        "code": "COA 11.36",
                        "commitment": "Barge Operations Plan",
                        "name": "Restore Riverbanks Eroded by Barge Operations",
                        "text": "If barge operations result in 20% or more of a bank eroding, Permittee shall hire a qualified\nrestoration specialist to restore the eroding bank.",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3V2EGJHQX6564T66395",
                            "name": "Restore Riverbank Eroded by Barge Operations"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMKYQ8AM5AR4SCE24X1JG": {
                        "code": "COA 11.36",
                        "commitment": "Barge Operations Plan",
                        "name": "Report Vessel Fuel Spills to CDFW Spill Prevention Office",
                        "text": "In the event of fuel spill, vessel operators shall contact the CDFW\nOffice of Spill Prevention and Response immediately at 800-852-7550 or 800-OILS-911\n(800-645-7911) to report the spill.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RB67EQDRWNDJBKFW6V",
                            "name": "Report Vessel Fuel Spills to CDFW OSPR"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMM0EM81PTXW51E1T9ERW": {
                        "code": "COA 11.37",
                        "commitment": "Dewatering Plan",
                        "name": "Develop and Obtain CDFW Approval of Dewatering Plan",
                        "text": "Permittee shall submit the\ndewatering plan to CDFW as part of the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization Package\n(Condition of Approval 6.2) for review and approval prior to initiation Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NNJMTS3JZDQQZNRKER",
                            "name": "Submit Dewatering Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMM0FVKV7MZMMSVC11NPA": {
                        "code": "COA 11.37",
                        "commitment": "Dewatering Plan",
                        "name": "Screen Dewatering Pump Intakes to Prevent Fish Entrainment",
                        "text": "Permittee shall screen dewatering pump intakes to prevent\nentrainment of fish in accordance with screening criteria for salmonid fry found in the NMFS 1997\nFish Screening Criteria for Anadromous Salmonids.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMM0FVKV7MZMMSVC11NPB": {
                        "code": "COA 11.37",
                        "commitment": "Dewatering Plan",
                        "name": "Station Fisheries Biologist Onsite to Rescue Fish During Dewatering",
                        "text": "During dewatering activities at the north Delta intakes or during any other dewatering activity that could potentially impact Covered Fish Species, a\nFisheries Biologist(s) shall remain onsite to observe the process and remove Covered Species that\nwere not successfully salvaged prior to dewatering (see Condition of Approval 11.35).",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMM0FVKV7MZMMSVC11NPC": {
                        "code": "COA 11.37",
                        "commitment": "Dewatering Plan",
                        "name": "Halt Dewatering When Water Levels Drop Too Quickly for Salvage",
                        "text": "Permittee shall temporarily stop dewatering if the Fisheries Biologist(s) or CDFW personnel\ndetermine that water levels may drop too quickly to allow successful fish salvage.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMM0FVKV7MZMMSVC11NPD": {
                        "code": "COA 11.37",
                        "commitment": "Dewatering Plan",
                        "name": "Notify CDFW When Fish Salvage Is Complete",
                        "text": "The Fisheries Biologist(s) shall notify Permittee\nand CDFW within one business day when the fish salvage has been completed and construction can\nrecommence.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RB67EQDRWNDJBKFW6Z",
                            "name": "Notify CDFW When Fish Salvage Is Complete"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMM256F0RRDSBCNM9S5G4": {
                        "code": "COA 11.38",
                        "commitment": "Preconstruction Survey Protocols for Covered Species",
                        "name": "Develop and Obtain CDFW-Approved Species Survey Protocols",
                        "text": "Protocols shall be finalized and approved in writing by CDFW\nprior to initiation of any Covered Activity including but not limited to preconstruction field\ninvestigation activities or preconstruction species site surveys necessary for Construction Phase\nAuthorization.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NNJMTS3JZDQQZNRKES",
                            "name": "Submit Species and Habitat Survey Protocols to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMM3WQAYANXSHWPZZ1BSW": {
                        "code": "COA 11.39",
                        "commitment": "CTS Habitat Avoidance and Encounter Response",
                        "name": "Avoid Suitable CTS Habitat and Confine the Work Footprint",
                        "text": "suitable CTS habitat identified and delineated in accordance with\nCDFW-approved protocols (Condition of Approval 11.38) shall be completely avoided.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMM3X13N0WRNT88R8CVN6": {
                        "code": "COA 11.39",
                        "commitment": "CTS Habitat Avoidance and Encounter Response",
                        "name": "Maintain No-Activity Buffer Around CTS Refuge Sites",
                        "text": "Permittee shall prohibit Covered\nActivities within a 75-foot radius of that refuge (no-activity buffer) until the Designated Biologist(s) is\ncontacted and on-site.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMM3X13N0WRNT88R8CVN7": {
                        "code": "COA 11.39",
                        "commitment": "CTS Habitat Avoidance and Encounter Response",
                        "name": "Notify Designated Biologist of CTS Encounters",
                        "text": "All Project personnel shall inform the Designated Biologist(s) if they encounter CTS, or\na salamander resembling CTS, within the Project construction site or 75 feet beyond the Project\nconstruction site, or on access roads during, all phases of Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMM5NN7ECM6KBA3FW2T7C": {
                        "code": "COA 11.39.1",
                        "commitment": "Vehicle Speed Limits in CTS Habitat",
                        "name": "Observe 10 MPH Speed Limits in CTS Habitat and Near Burrows",
                        "text": "Project-related vehicles shall observe a speed limit of 10 miles per hour\nwithin suitable CTS habitat prior to ground clearance. After ground clearance, the speed limit\nshall be observed within 300 feet of suitable aquatic habitat or 75 feet from a flagged burrow,\nexcept on roads where 10 miles per hour would unsafely impede the normal flow of traffic.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMM5PJ68M2M1KZ3RW9HGJ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.39.1",
                        "commitment": "Vehicle Speed Limits in CTS Habitat",
                        "name": "Post 10 MPH Speed Limit Signage on Nonpublic Project Roads",
                        "text": "A\nvehicle speed limit of 10 miles per hour shall be posted on all nonpublic construction and access\nroads where the speed limit is required.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCR4",
                            "name": "Install wildlife under-crossing culverts and speed limit signage"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMM7D459TJFVVKTJEAM9C": {
                        "code": "COA 11.40",
                        "commitment": "CTS Breeding Habitat Avoidance Near Conserved Lands",
                        "name": "Demarcate 300-Foot No-Activity Buffer Around CTS Breeding Habitat",
                        "text": "Permittee shall demarcate a no-activity buffer of at\nleast 300 feet around the suitable aquatic breeding habitat and avoid Covered Activities within the\nsuitable aquatic breeding habitat and no-activity buffer.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMM7EFFY55TCP0J01VJ85": {
                        "code": "COA 11.40",
                        "commitment": "CTS Breeding Habitat Avoidance Near Conserved Lands",
                        "name": "Restrict Unavoidable Breeding-Habitat Work to the Dry Season",
                        "text": "Permittee shall restrict Covered\nActivities to the dry season of July 15 – October 15 (Condition of Approval 11.44).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMM7EFFY55TCP0J01VJ86": {
                        "code": "COA 11.40",
                        "commitment": "CTS Breeding Habitat Avoidance Near Conserved Lands",
                        "name": "Coordinate with CDFW on Breeding Habitat Buffer Encroachment",
                        "text": "Where suitable\naquatic breeding habitat cannot be avoided by 300 feet, Permittee shall notify and coordinate with\nCDFW to implement site-specific avoidance and minimization measures through the appropriate\nPhase Authorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.2). Permittee shall consult with CDFW to develop further habitat protection measures at the Bethany Complex site to maintain connectivity\nbetween breeding habitat and suitable upland habitat and ensure impacts to breeding habitat are\nfully…",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34X89RDDJZVZVMK8Y0D",
                            "name": "Coordinate with CDFW on Breeding Habitat Buffer Encroachment"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMM94TH79BEBAWHWR9EE0": {
                        "code": "COA 11.41",
                        "commitment": "CTS Measures for Preconstruction, SCADA, Transmission and Access Road Work",
                        "name": "Station Biologist During Site Selection, Access and Set-Up",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall be present during selection\nof the preconstruction activity sites, construction sites, and maintenance areas, ingress\nand egress to these sites, and during set-up activities to guide workers to avoid visible\nburrows, cracks, crevices, vegetation, or other suitable habitat features until avoidance\nroutes are clearly established.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMM95JM93STV0ZS9872BN": {
                        "code": "COA 11.41",
                        "commitment": "CTS Measures for Preconstruction, SCADA, Transmission and Access Road Work",
                        "name": "Flag Occupied Burrows With 75-Foot No-Activity Buffers",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall flag potentially occupied\nburrows to be avoided by a 75-foot radius no-activity buffer or shall designate and flag\nareas within the site and ingress/egress routes that avoid potentially occupied burrows.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMM95JM93STV0ZS9872BP": {
                        "code": "COA 11.41",
                        "commitment": "CTS Measures for Preconstruction, SCADA, Transmission and Access Road Work",
                        "name": "Conduct Daily Preconstruction Burrow Surveys",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall conduct daily surveys prior\nto the start of Covered Activities each day to check for burrows within the work site.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMM95JM93STV0ZS9872BQ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.41",
                        "commitment": "CTS Measures for Preconstruction, SCADA, Transmission and Access Road Work",
                        "name": "Confine Heavy Equipment to Approved Access Routes",
                        "text": "Permittee shall confine movement of heavy equipment to existing or CDFW-approved\naccess roads or to locations at least 75 feet from flagged burrows. Vehicles shall follow the\nshortest possible routes from existing roads to the work site and shall follow speed limits\nconsistent with Condition of Approval 11.11.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMM95JM93STV0ZS9872BR": {
                        "code": "COA 11.41",
                        "commitment": "CTS Measures for Preconstruction, SCADA, Transmission and Access Road Work",
                        "name": "Restore Temporarily Disturbed CTS Habitat With Native Vegetation",
                        "text": "Permittee shall restore temporarily disturbed habitat with appropriate native vegetation\nin accordance with the Restoration and Revegetation Plan (see Condition of Approval\n12.3.3).",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3V103NJ75GYQV09GB8T",
                            "name": "Restore Temporarily Impacted Habitat to Pre-Project Conditions"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMAY0PGV8V7Z8ACMASBF": {
                        "code": "COA 11.42",
                        "commitment": "CTS Preconstruction and Construction-Phase Surveys",
                        "name": "Submit CTS Preconstruction Survey Results to CDFW for Approval",
                        "text": "Permittee\nshall submit the CTS preconstruction survey results to CDFW as part of the appropriate Construction\nPhase Authorization Package for written approval.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34V8WHD9WZSVEXW30W8",
                            "name": "Submit Preconstruction Survey Results for CDFW Approval"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMAY0PGV8V7Z8ACMASBG": {
                        "code": "COA 11.42",
                        "commitment": "CTS Preconstruction and Construction-Phase Surveys",
                        "name": "Report Annual Construction-Phase CTS Surveys to CDFW",
                        "text": "Subsequent survey efforts conducted during the\nconstruction phase(s) shall occur each year Covered Activities are expected to occur in CTS habitat or\nwithin 75 feet of the habitat, unless otherwise approved by CDFW, and shall be reported to CDFW by\nthe Permittee within the Monthly Compliance Reporting (Condition of Approval 10.12) and\nsummarized within each Annual Status Report (Condition of Approval 10.13).",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3XZ7WK0185QGKR01862",
                            "name": "Conduct and Report Annual CTS Surveys"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMAY0PGV8V7Z8ACMASBH": {
                        "code": "COA 11.42",
                        "commitment": "CTS Preconstruction and Construction-Phase Surveys",
                        "name": "Complete Walking Clearance Survey Before Clearing or Ground Disturbance",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological monitor(s) shall complete walking surveys of the Project\nconstruction site for CTS before the start of any vegetation clearing or ground disturbing Covered\nActivities (e.g., soil deposition areas; preconstruction activities such as field investigations; SCADA,\ntransmission line, or access road construction, maintenance, or improvement sites; or exclusion\nfence installation and repair sites) by completing nocturnal walking or cover-board surveys in…",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3XZ7WK0185QGKR01861",
                            "name": "Conduct CTS Walking Clearance Survey Before Ground Disturbance"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMAY0PGV8V7Z8ACMASBJ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.42",
                        "commitment": "CTS Preconstruction and Construction-Phase Surveys",
                        "name": "Monitor Initial Grading and Excavation for CTS",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological\nMonitor(s) shall follow earthmoving equipment to look for CTS during initial site grading. All ruts and\nholes near root structures, foundations, abutments, etc. shall be inspected for CTS prior to and during\nexcavation or removal.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMCQ2FHMYR575BA568WT": {
                        "code": "COA 11.42.1",
                        "commitment": "CTS Preconstruction Watering Protocol",
                        "name": "Prepare CDFW-Consulted Preconstruction Watering Protocol",
                        "text": "Permittee shall prepare in consultation with CDFW a\npreconstruction watering protocol and submit the protocol as part of the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.2) describing the\nmethodology to be used to stimulate CTS emergence from burrows on permanently impacted\nProject construction sites.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NNJMTS3JZDQQZNRKEV",
                            "name": "Submit Preconstruction CTS Burrow Watering Protocol"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMCQ2FHMYR575BA568WV": {
                        "code": "COA 11.42.1",
