                        "commitment": "CTS Preconstruction Watering Protocol",
                        "name": "Conduct Morning Survey and Relocate CTS After Burrow Watering",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological\nMonitor(s) shall survey the area each morning following watering. The Designated Biologist(s)\nshall relocate any CTS according to the CTS Relocation Plan (Condition of Approval 11.51).",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMEFBX4WFR4CPK6HQKWB": {
                        "code": "COA 11.42.2",
                        "commitment": "CTS Mowing Restrictions",
                        "name": "Avoid Removing Vegetation Within Burrows and Refugia",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not remove vegetation within avoidable burrows, burrow\ncomplexes, and suitable refugia to the greatest extent practicable.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMEG0R2D5MWTTDJMHNAB": {
                        "code": "COA 11.42.2",
                        "commitment": "CTS Mowing Restrictions",
                        "name": "Mow in a Non-Concentrating Pattern During Dry Daytime Conditions",
                        "text": "Mowing shall occur in rows in a pattern that would not concentrate animals in the\ncenter of the construction site and shall only occur during the day in dry conditions (no rain\nwithin the past 24 hours) when the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s)\ndetermines CTS is unlikely to be aboveground.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMEG0R2D5MWTTDJMHNAC": {
                        "code": "COA 11.42.2",
                        "commitment": "CTS Mowing Restrictions",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval for Non-String-Trimmer Mowing Equipment",
                        "text": "Any request by Permittee to use other mowing equipment shall be subject to\nCDFW written approval (e.g., in locations that are not near refugia and burrow\ncomplexes).",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34WE7XE98281ZXQVPK8",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval of Mowing or Clearing Equipment"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMEG0R2D5MWTTDJMHNAD": {
                        "code": "COA 11.42.2",
                        "commitment": "CTS Mowing Restrictions",
                        "name": "Monitor Mowing Operations for Emerging CTS",
                        "text": "The\nDesignated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall walk in front of the mower and monitor\nfor CTS escaping out of burrows. If CTS is found, mowing shall cease until the CTS is relocated by\nthe Designated Biologist(s) only in accordance with the CTS Relocation Plan (Condition of\nApproval 11.51).",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMG8S1HWB1AND39KY4G7": {
                        "code": "COA 11.43",
                        "commitment": "CTS Exclusion Barrier Installation and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Submit Site-Specific Exclusion Barrier Design for CDFW Approval",
                        "text": "Permittee shall submit site-specific CTS exclusion barrier design and location details to CDFW as part\nof the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization Package based on preconstruction survey\nresults (see Condition of Approval 11.42).",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34X89RDDJZVZVMK8Y0E",
                            "name": "Submit Exclusion Barrier Design and Locations to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMG8S1HWB1AND39KY4G8": {
                        "code": "COA 11.43",
                        "commitment": "CTS Exclusion Barrier Installation and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Install and Maintain High-Visibility CTS Exclusion Barrier",
                        "text": "Permittee shall install a high visibility exclusion barrier to prevent CTS from dispersing into the Project\nconstruction site. Permittee shall place the barrier along the perimeter of the construction footprint for any site within\nor 300 feet of any suitable CTS upland or aquatic habitat, or as approved by CDFW. The barrier shall\nbe maintained by the Permittee throughout all construction activities.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMG8S1HWB1AND39KY4G9": {
                        "code": "COA 11.43",
                        "commitment": "CTS Exclusion Barrier Installation and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Build Exclusion Barrier to Required Fencing Specifications",
                        "text": "The barrier shall consist of taut wildlife exclusion fencing supported by stakes at least 24 inches tall\nabove the soil surface and buried to a depth of 6-12 inches below the soil surface; and shall be\nconstructed with a top climber barrier lip so that CTS cannot scale and go over the barrier into the\nProject construction site. Fencing that is overlapped to connect different sections of material shall be\nsealed in a manner that does not allow CTS to become entrapped. Permittee shall design the…",
                        "type": "Design",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMG9385GQ6TSP4A11WCH": {
                        "code": "COA 11.43",
                        "commitment": "CTS Exclusion Barrier Installation and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Prohibit Plastic Monofilament Netting in the Exclusion Barrier",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not use plastic monofilament netting for the exclusion barrier (see Condition of\nApproval 11.28).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMG9385GQ6TSP4A11WCJ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.43",
                        "commitment": "CTS Exclusion Barrier Installation and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Keep Exclusion Barrier Access Gates Closed When Not in Use",
                        "text": "Permittee shall instruct Project personnel to ensure access gates are securely closed when not in use. If access gates are left open and unattended, the Designated\nBiologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall have the authority to stop Covered Activities until CTS\nsurveys are repeated (Condition of Approval 11.42), any CTS found are relocated from the\nconstruction site (Condition of Approval 11.51), and additional burrows are checked and the\nentrances blocked by the designated Biologist(s)…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMG9385GQ6TSP4A11WCK": {
                        "code": "COA 11.43",
                        "commitment": "CTS Exclusion Barrier Installation and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Monitor Exclusion Barrier Installation and Ongoing Integrity",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s)\nand/or Biological Monitor(s) shall inspect the area prior to and during installation of exclusion\nfencing, including during trenching, vehicular access, erecting fencing material, installing posts, and\nany other activity requiring vehicle or foot traffic in suitable habitat. If CTS or new burrows are\ndiscovered during installation of the exclusion barrier, the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological\nMonitor(s) shall have the authority to stop construction until new…",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMG9385GQ6TSP4A11WCM": {
                        "code": "COA 11.43",
                        "commitment": "CTS Exclusion Barrier Installation and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Repair Exclusion Barrier Defects Within 24 Hours",
                        "text": "Permittee shall maintain and\nrepair the barrier immediately (within 24 hours) to ensure that it is functional and without defects.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMG9385GQ6TSP4A11WCN": {
                        "code": "COA 11.43",
                        "commitment": "CTS Exclusion Barrier Installation and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Conduct Clearance Survey Before Reinitiating Activities After Barrier Repair",
                        "text": "After the barrier is repaired, the Designated Biologist(s) shall conduct a survey using CDFW-approved\nprotocol (see Condition of Approval 11.38) within 24 hours (1 calendar day) prior to reinitiation of\nCovered Activities and carefully search potential hiding spots, such as along exclusion fence and in\npipes, culverts, or other similar structures, trenches, large downed woody debris, and beneath\nvehicles or equipment before they are moved (see Conditions of Approval 9.12, 11.14, and 11.15).",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMGAXNN0F9PTZR9D531Y": {
                        "code": "COA 11.43",
                        "commitment": "CTS Exclusion Barrier Installation and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Provide Refuge Cover and Maintain Vegetation Along the Barrier",
                        "text": "Permittee shall provide refuge opportunities such\nas natural cover objects (such as fallen logs and branches), artificial cover boards, or leaf litter along\nor near both sides of the barrier. Permittee shall avoid damage to burrows to the maximum extent\npossible during installation and monitoring of the exclusion fencing (see Condition of Approval\n11.49). Permittee shall maintain vegetation within three feet of the edge of the exclusion barrier\naway from the Project construction site at a…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMJ1ZJBJE406FTY5NWYV": {
                        "code": "COA 11.44",
                        "commitment": "CTS Seasonal Work Window",
                        "name": "Limit Ground-Disturbing Work to CTS Dry-Season Window",
                        "text": "Permittee shall limit ground-disturbing Covered Activities in suitable upland habitat and aquatic\nhabitat involving construction and heavy equipment use (such as excavation, road construction,\ngrading, trenching, pipe and culvert installation) to the period of July 15 to October 15 of each year\n(dry season).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMMG5744RQ9XYPGCYB2J": {
                        "code": "COA 11.45",
                        "commitment": "Rain Forecast Work Stoppage Near CTS Breeding Sites",
                        "name": "Monitor NWS 72-Hour Rain Forecast Before Site Work",
                        "text": "Permittee and Designated Biologist(s) and/or\nBiological Monitor(s) shall monitor the 72-hour weather forecasts from the National Weather Service\n(NWS) prior to the start of work at any Project construction site.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMMH0D7BAQ0QJ0GX0MM6": {
                        "code": "COA 11.45",
                        "commitment": "Rain Forecast Work Stoppage Near CTS Breeding Sites",
                        "name": "Cease Construction on 30% Rain Forecast Near CTS Breeding Sites",
                        "text": "Construction activities, including all\nground disturbance or vegetation clearing, shall cease 24 hours prior to a 30 percent (30%) or greater\nforecast of rain from the NWS. Construction activities may continue 24 hours after the rain ceases\nand once there is a zero percent chance of precipitation in the 72-hour forecast.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMMH0D7BAQ0QJ0GX0MM7": {
                        "code": "COA 11.45",
                        "commitment": "Rain Forecast Work Stoppage Near CTS Breeding Sites",
                        "name": "Survey Project Site Before Work on Rain-Forecast Days",
                        "text": "The Designated\nBiologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall survey each Project site before construction begins on\neach day any rain is forecasted.",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMPK3754MVG37HGJJK0X": {
                        "code": "COA 11.46",
                        "commitment": "CTS Time of Day Work Restriction",
                        "name": "Assess CTS Active Season Yearly at Each Construction Site",
                        "text": "CTS active season is defined as the period of time during which CTS are aboveground. The period is\ngeographically and temporally variable and shall be assessed by the Designated Biologist(s) and/or\nBiological Monitor(s) on each Project construction site and on a yearly basis.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMPK3754MVG37HGJJK0Y": {
                        "code": "COA 11.46",
                        "commitment": "CTS Time of Day Work Restriction",
                        "name": "Restrict Covered Activities to Daylight Hours in CTS Active Season",
                        "text": "During the CTS active\nseason or within 300 feet of suitable CTS aquatic habitat, Permittee shall terminate all Covered\nActivities not encircled by an exclusion barrier, including use and/or construction of access roads for\npreconstruction activities, SCADA and transmission line construction and maintenance, and facility\nmaintenance no less than 30 minutes before sunset and shall not resume Covered Activities until 30\nminutes after sunrise. Permittee shall use sunrise and sunset times…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMRAVC9JDF9WNS47SGKG": {
                        "code": "COA 11.47",
                        "commitment": "Night Work Lighting Near CTS Habitat",
                        "name": "Restrict Night-Work Lighting to Worker Safety Uses",
                        "text": "If night work is required within a Project construction site after exclusion barriers have been installed,\nPermittee shall not use artificial lighting unless it is needed for worker safety. Where artificial lighting\nis required for worker safety, Permittee shall follow night lighting provisions in Condition of Approval 11.8.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMRAVC9JDF9WNS47SGKH": {
                        "code": "COA 11.47",
                        "commitment": "Night Work Lighting Near CTS Habitat",
                        "name": "Survey Burrows and Halt Work on Night-Lighting Spillover",
                        "text": "If light spillover occurs within 300 feet of suitable CTS habitat during night work, the Designated\nBiologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall be present to survey CTS burrows in portions of the 75-\nfoot no-activity buffer (see Condition of Approval 11.39) to ensure CTS movement is not inhibited by\nartificial lighting. If CTS is found aboveground, the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological\nMonitor(s) shall have the authority to stop Covered Activities until the light is directed away…",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMT11DAME30TN5AWMQ91": {
                        "code": "COA 11.48",
                        "commitment": "Initial Site Clearing and CTS Monitoring",
                        "name": "Confine Clearance Work to Minimal Disturbance Area",
                        "text": "Permittee shall confine ground disturbance activities that could result in take of CTS (clearance work)\nto the most minimal area necessary to conduct Covered Activities and shall not initiate clearance\nwork until after exclusion fencing is installed (Condition of Approval 11.43).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMT2ZR1740F4HF6BZW5V": {
                        "code": "COA 11.48",
                        "commitment": "Initial Site Clearing and CTS Monitoring",
                        "name": "Monitor CTS Hiding Spots Onsite During Clearance Work",
                        "text": "The Designated\nBiologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall be onsite during clearance work and shall check\npotential CTS hiding spots (see Condition of Approval 11.49).",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMT2ZR1740F4HF6BZW5W": {
                        "code": "COA 11.48",
                        "commitment": "Initial Site Clearing and CTS Monitoring",
                        "name": "Conduct CTS Surveys Before and During Each Workday",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or\nBiological Monitor(s) shall conduct CTS surveys prior to initiation of any Covered Activity within a\nProject construction site and regularly throughout the workday when Covered Activities are occurring\nwithin CTS habitat. If clearance work is conducted at night, the Designated Biologist(s) and/or\nBiological Monitor(s) shall conduct an additional CTS survey no more than two hours after sunrise on\nthe subsequent day using the CDFW-approved protocol (Condition of…",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMT2ZR1740F4HF6BZW5X": {
                        "code": "COA 11.48",
                        "commitment": "Initial Site Clearing and CTS Monitoring",
                        "name": "Stop Work on CTS Discovery Inside Exclusion Fencing",
                        "text": "If CTS is discovered inside the exclusion fencing along the\nProject site boundary, the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall have the\nauthority to stop Covered Activities until the CTS is relocated in accordance with the CTS Relocation Plan (Condition of Approval 11.51) and appropriate corrective measures are implemented to ensure\nCTS cannot enter the construction site.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37QZY1A3K7JAYVP7ZEA",
                            "name": "Conduct daily clearance surveys before work begins"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMVTFGK3FTZ4Y74GEMF3": {
                        "code": "COA 11.49",
                        "commitment": "CTS Burrow Avoidance or Treatment",
                        "name": "Avoid Disturbing Burrows Outside Direct-Disturbance Areas",
                        "text": "Permittee shall avoid disturbing any known or potential CTS burrows unless they are in an area of\ndirect disturbance (e.g., grading or excavation areas) or their location poses a risk of direct harm to\nCTS individuals.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMVVR3CR1BGCKGCBA0DF": {
                        "code": "COA 11.49",
                        "commitment": "CTS Burrow Avoidance or Treatment",
                        "name": "Monitor and Temporarily Block Vacant Burrows",
                        "text": "Burrows in an area of temporary disturbance shall remain intact and the Designated\nBiologist(s) shall monitor to determine vacancy, then block the entrance by installing an object\napproved in advance, in writing by CDFW, to prevent CTS from entering and using the burrow during\nCovered Activities. The Designated Biologist(s) shall remove the object immediately after Covered\nActivities are completed in that work site when the Designated Biologist(s) has determined that\npotential resumed use of…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCR2",
                            "name": "Block burrows after confirming vacancy"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMVVR3CR1BGCKGCBA0DG": {
                        "code": "COA 11.49",
                        "commitment": "CTS Burrow Avoidance or Treatment",
                        "name": "Hand Excavate Unavoidable Burrows Before Trenching",
                        "text": "When the\nPermittee cannot avoid burrows in areas of direct ground disturbance or in a location posing a risk of\ndirect harm to CTS, they shall be hand excavated by the Designated Biologist(s) prior to trenching\nactivities (see condition of Approval 11.49.2) and any CTS found during excavation shall be relocated\naccording to the CTS Relocation Plan (see Condition of Approval 11.51).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCR1",
                            "name": "Excavate and collapse burrows ahead of trenching"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMVVR3CR1BGCKGCBA0DH": {
                        "code": "COA 11.49",
                        "commitment": "CTS Burrow Avoidance or Treatment",
                        "name": "Monitor Exclusion Fencing Installation and Block Extending Burrows",
                        "text": "Following excavation, the\nDesignated Biologist(s) shall block holes or burrows which appear to extend under exclusion fencing\n(see Condition of Approval 11.43) to minimize CTS movement into the Project construction site. The\nDesignated Biologist(s) shall be on-site during installation of fencing to relocate any CTS outside of\nthe work area following the CTS Relocation Plan (Condition of Approval 11.51).",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMXNW06J2K6JTX9DFAKH": {
                        "code": "COA 11.49.1",
                        "commitment": "Flagging CTS Burrows and No-Activity Buffers",
                        "name": "Flag Burrows and Habitat Features Before Earthmoving",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall identify and\nflag all potential burrows, soil cracks, crevices, or other habitat features that are outside of the area\nplanned for direct disturbance (e.g., grading, excavation, etc.) and within the Project construction\nsite no less than five days prior to earthmoving activities in those areas.",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3Y008XT5YC8FTSZY6J5",
                            "name": "Flag Burrows and Habitat Features Before Earthmoving"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMXNW06J2K6JTX9DFAKJ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.49.1",
                        "commitment": "Flagging CTS Burrows and No-Activity Buffers",
                        "name": "Establish 75-Foot No-Activity Buffer Around Flagged Burrows",
                        "text": "Permittee shall establish a 75-foot\nradius no-activity buffer around flagged burrows to be avoided, as feasible.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMXNW06J2K6JTX9DFAKK": {
                        "code": "COA 11.49.1",
                        "commitment": "Flagging CTS Burrows and No-Activity Buffers",
                        "name": "Monitor and Block Burrows That Cannot Be Buffered",
                        "text": "If burrows cannot be avoided by a no-activity buffer and are within suitable\nupland habitat, Permittee shall monitor to determine vacancy and block burrows for the duration\nof Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCR2",
                            "name": "Block burrows after confirming vacancy"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMMZDEG0FSF04VK5A9TBP": {
                        "code": "COA 11.49.2",
                        "commitment": "CTS Burrow Excavation by Designated Biologist",
                        "name": "Hand Excavate Refuge Features by Designated Biologist Only",
                        "text": "All excavation of potential refuge features, including burrows,\nindividual rocks and rock piles, and other accessible features with an entrance diameter of greater\nthan or equal to 0.5 inches, as well as gopher digging piles and mounds, shall be carried out by the Designated Biologist(s). Burrows shall be excavated by hand to the terminus of each burrow branch\nor until the burrow diameter is less than 0.5 inches.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCR1",
                            "name": "Excavate and collapse burrows ahead of trenching"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMN15BVV0FGVSPSSTJ8RS": {
                        "code": "COA 11.50",
                        "commitment": "CTS Capture and Handling Protocols",
                        "name": "Capture, Handle, and Transport CTS Under CDFW Protocols",
                        "text": "Prior to handling and relocation, the Designated Biologist(s) and Biological Monitor(s) shall take\nprecautions to prevent introduction of amphibian diseases in accordance with the 2003 Interim\nGuidance on Site Assessment and Field Surveys for Determining Presence or a Negative Finding of the\nCalifornia Tiger Salamander,40 or the most recent guidance approved by CDFW. If any person\ndiscovers a CTS in the Project construction site that cannot move away from Covered Activities on its\nown, only the…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMN2YQ60Y2FFS086MKP75": {
                        "code": "COA 11.51",
                        "commitment": "CTS Mortality Reduction and Relocation Plan",
                        "name": "Prepare and Submit CTS Mortality Reduction and Relocation Plan",
                        "text": "Permittee shall prepare a CTS Mortality Reduction and Relocation Plan (CTS Relocation Plan) and\nsubmit it to CDFW for written approval as part of the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization\nPackage (see Condition of Approval 6.2) prior to initiating Covered Activities. The Relocation Plan\nshall include, but is not limited to, the name(s) of the Designated Biologist(s) who will relocate CTS\nindividuals, methods for hand excavation of burrows that cannot be avoided during Covered\nActivities;…",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NNJMTS3JZDQQZNRKEW",
                            "name": "Submit CTS Relocation Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMN4NKSK6C4P5V4Y0W5R5": {
                        "code": "COA 11.51.1",
                        "commitment": "CTS Relocation From Construction Site Buffer",
                        "name": "Notify Designated Biologist of CTS Found in Site or Buffer",
                        "text": "If CTS is found within a\nconstruction site or 75 feet beyond the construction site (75-foot boundary), Project personnel\nshall notify the Designated Biologist(s) immediately.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R8HSR7K069ZM5EZCXR",
                            "name": "Report MALI and CTS Finds to the Designated Biologist"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMN4PPRTWBTNBYA3CN13C": {
                        "code": "COA 11.51.1",
                        "commitment": "CTS Relocation From Construction Site Buffer",
                        "name": "Relocate Threatened CTS Under Numbered Placement Parameters",
                        "text": "If CTS is encountered within a Project\nconstruction site, it is directly threatened by Covered Activities, and it is unable to move to a safe\narea of its own volition, the Designated Biologist(s) shall relocate CTS to a safe area using the\nfollowing parameters: (1) CTS shall not be relocated to sites that already contain populations of\nCTS; (2) CTS shall not be relocated to areas where non-native tiger salamanders or hybrids are\nwithin the maximum CTS migration distance (i.e., ≤ 1.3 miles); (3)…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMN6EK7YFDGGENE53D2NC": {
                        "code": "COA 11.51.2",
                        "commitment": "Capture, Handling and Release of CTS Into Burrows",
                        "name": "Release Relocated CTS Into Suitable Burrows One at a Time",
                        "text": "No Project personnel shall capture and/or handle CTS\nexcept the Designated Biologist(s). The Designated Biologist(s) shall determine whether the CTS\nshould be captured and handled and shall relocate any CTS within the Project construction site\nimpacted by Covered Activities to an active ground squirrel or other rodent burrow system or\nappropriate breeding pond as soon as possible. If burrow density allows, the Designated\nBiologist(s) shall only release one animal per burrow, and shall not…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMN87B9MY447Z0HMPG8MV": {
                        "code": "COA 11.51.3",
                        "commitment": "CDFW Notification of CTS Relocation",
                        "name": "Notify CDFW Within One Business Day of Each CTS Relocation",
                        "text": "Permittee’s Designated Representative or the Designated\nBiologist(s) shall notify CDFW within one business day each time CTS is relocated. Notification to\nCDFW shall be via telephone and email, followed by a written incident report. Notifications shall\ninclude the date, time, location, and circumstances of the incident. The written incident report\nshall also be included in the Monthly Compliance Report (see Condition of Approval 10.12).",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R8HSR7K069ZM5EZCXV",
                            "name": "Report CTS and MALI Relocations to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMN9ZQ8CS1KWBNS6BJ4PM": {
                        "code": "COA 11.52",
                        "commitment": "Notification of CTS Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Immediately Notify Biologist of Injured or Dead CTS",
                        "text": "Permittee shall immediately notify the Designated Biologist(s) if a CTS is injured or killed by a Covered\nActivity, or if a CTS is otherwise found dead or injured within the vicinity of the Project\npreconstruction activity, construction site, or maintenance area.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R8HSR7K069ZM5EZCXP",
                            "name": "Notify the Designated Biologist of CBB, CTS or SWHA Take or Injury"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNA0BX5FD2QMF1667XY4": {
                        "code": "COA 11.52",
                        "commitment": "Notification of CTS Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Handle and Transport Injured CTS to Rehabilitation Facility",
                        "text": "Live injured CTS shall be handled\nand assessed according to the Restraint and Handling of Live Amphibians43 or the most recent CDFW-\napproved guidance for handling CTS. If an injured CTS is found during Covered Activities, the\nindividual shall be evaluated by the Designated Biologist(s) who shall immediately take the injured\nCTS to a CDFW-approved wildlife rehabilitation or veterinary facility identified in the CTS Relocation\nPlan (see Condition of Approval 11.51)",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNA0BX5FD2QMF1667XY5": {
                        "code": "COA 11.52",
                        "commitment": "Notification of CTS Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Contact CDFW Representative Within One Business Day of Injury",
                        "text": "contact the CDFW Representative, via email and\ntelephone, within one business  day to discuss the next steps. The notification to CDFW’s\nRepresentative shall include information regarding the location, species, number of animals taken or\ninjured, the name of the facility where the animal was taken, and the ITP tracking number.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R8HSR7K069ZM5EZCXM",
                            "name": "Report CBB, CTS and SWHA Take or Injury Incidents to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNBS2HF5M30P3MV0FTH4": {
                        "code": "COA 11.52.1",
                        "commitment": "Release of CTS With Minor Injury",
                        "name": "Release CTS With Minor, Survivable Injury",
                        "text": "If the injury is minor or healing and the salamander is likely to survive as\ndetermined by the Designated Biologist(s), the salamander shall be released immediately in\naccordance with the CTS Relocation Plan (Condition of Approval 11.51).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNDJ1BPHFJMBQ19Q4267": {
                        "code": "COA 11.52.2",
                        "commitment": "Treatment of Seriously Injured CTS",
                        "name": "Transport Seriously Injured CTS to Rehabilitation Facility",
                        "text": "If it is determined that the CTS individual has major or serious\ninjuries as a result of Project-related activities, the Designated Biologist(s) shall immediately take\nit to the nearest CDFW-approved wildlife rehabilitation or veterinary facility. If taken into\ncaptivity, the individual shall remain in captivity and not be released into the wild unless it has\nbeen kept in quarantine and the release is authorized by CDFW and USFWS. Permittee shall bear\nany costs associated with the care or…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNDKAXN4DY312N8QFX49": {
                        "code": "COA 11.52.2",
                        "commitment": "Treatment of Seriously Injured CTS",
                        "name": "Document Injury Circumstances in Written Incident Report",
                        "text": "The circumstances of the\ninjury, the procedure followed, and the final disposition of the injured animal shall be\ndocumented in the written incident report as described in Condition of Approval 11.52.4).",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R8HSR7K069ZM5EZCXM",
                            "name": "Report CBB, CTS and SWHA Take or Injury Incidents to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNF9RQGB3NF81P111Q8H": {
                        "code": "COA 11.52.3",
                        "commitment": "Handling of Recently Deceased CTS",
                        "name": "Preserve and Label Tissue Sample and Carcass of Deceased CTS",
                        "text": "a 0.5-inch portion of the tail tip shall be removed and placed in a labeled tissue\ntube with 95% ethanol. The carcass shall be immediately bagged, labeled, and preserved in a freezer. The label shall include time and date, GPS location, circumstances surrounding death (if\nknown), and ITP tracking number.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNFAW6P5NJ8QT7ASJVXX": {
                        "code": "COA 11.52.3",
                        "commitment": "Handling of Recently Deceased CTS",
                        "name": "Consult CDFW on Disposal of Deceased CTS Specimen",
                        "text": "CDFW shall be consulted regarding specimen disposal.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34X89RDDJZVZVMK8Y0F",
                            "name": "Consult CDFW on Deceased CTS Specimen Disposal"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNH15YZ4G05ST577QXV5": {
                        "code": "COA 11.52.4",
                        "commitment": "Written Incident Report for CTS Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Submit Written CTS Take/Injury Incident Report to CDFW",
                        "text": "Permittee shall send CDFW a written\nincident report within two business days of the discovery. The report shall include the date and\ntime of the finding or incident, GPS location of the CTS, photographs of the location and the CTS,\ncircumstances around the cause of take or injury, and any other pertinent information.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R7PYV1TN3PG7JYE8R1",
                            "name": "Report Covered Species Take or Injury to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNJTV6GZ0WKJRR39T85N": {
                        "code": "COA 11.53",
                        "commitment": "Invasive Species Prohibition Near CTS Habitat",
                        "name": "Prohibit Introduction of Predatory Fish and Amphibians Near CTS Habitat",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not introduce predatory fishes (including but not limited to largemouth bass, redear\nsunfish, bluegill, catfish, mosquitofish, and fathead minnows) or amphibians (including but not\nlimited to bullfrogs, barred tiger salamanders, and Arizona tiger salamanders) within 1.3 miles of\nsuitable aquatic/breeding CTS habitat.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNJVZV958WPXE76E9J5R": {
                        "code": "COA 11.53",
                        "commitment": "Invasive Species Prohibition Near CTS Habitat",
                        "name": "Notify CDFW of Barred Tiger Salamander or Hybrid Detection",
                        "text": "Permittee shall notify CDFW if a barred tiger salamander\n(Ambystroma tigrinum mavortium) or CTS-non-native salamander hybrids are found within the\nProject construction site within one business day of detection.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RC1N589S9ETAS5HQJP",
                            "name": "Report Barred Tiger Salamander or Hybrid Detections to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNJVZV958WPXE76E9J5S": {
                        "code": "COA 11.53",
                        "commitment": "Invasive Species Prohibition Near CTS Habitat",
                        "name": "Consult CDFW on Non-Native or Hybrid Salamander Measures",
                        "text": "Permittee shall consult with CDFW to\ndetermine measures to address non-native or hybrid populations.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34X89RDDJZVZVMK8Y0G",
                            "name": "Consult CDFW on Non-Native or Hybrid Salamander Measures"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNMKZ2CXZM89538YV5TQ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.54",
                        "commitment": "Environmentally Sensitive Areas for GGS Habitat",
                        "name": "Establish and Maintain ESA Fencing Around GGS Habitat",
                        "text": "Permittee shall establish Environmentally Sensitive Areas (ESAs) in each Project construction site to\nminimize disturbance of GGS habitat from construction-related activities to the greatest extent\npracticable. Permittee shall erect ESA fencing around suitable GGS habitat as directed by the\nDesignated Biologist(s). ESAs shall be demarcated by tying high visibility poly wire to stakes placed\nevery six feet along the ESA boundary. The high visibility poly wire shall be raised at least four…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCQY",
                            "name": "Install ESA fencing and identification signage"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNMMW9SG3Q6Z79Q52X05": {
                        "code": "COA 11.54",
                        "commitment": "Environmentally Sensitive Areas for GGS Habitat",
                        "name": "Post and Maintain ESA Identification Signage",
                        "text": "Permittee shall also post and\nmaintain signs identifying the ESAs every 50 feet along the edge of suitable GGS habitat and ensure\nsigns are clearly visible and recognizable to Project personnel.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCQY",
                            "name": "Install ESA fencing and identification signage"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNMMW9SG3Q6Z79Q52X06": {
                        "code": "COA 11.54",
                        "commitment": "Environmentally Sensitive Areas for GGS Habitat",
                        "name": "Identify and Flag Avoidable Burrows Before Ground Disturbance",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall\nidentify and flag all potential burrows within the Project construction site that can be avoided.",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3Y008XT5YC8FTSZY6J5",
                            "name": "Flag Burrows and Habitat Features Before Earthmoving"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNMMW9SG3Q6Z79Q52X07": {
                        "code": "COA 11.54",
                        "commitment": "Environmentally Sensitive Areas for GGS Habitat",
                        "name": "Avoid Environmentally Sensitive Areas During Construction",
                        "text": "All construction personnel shall avoid ESAs.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNMMW9SG3Q6Z79Q52X08": {
                        "code": "COA 11.54",
                        "commitment": "Environmentally Sensitive Areas for GGS Habitat",
                        "name": "Inspect ESA Stakes and Poly Wire Before Each Workday",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological\nMonitor(s) shall inspect the stakes and high visibility poly wire before the start of each workday\nduring ground disturbance activities",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNPBE1S42WVDR6P44YNA": {
                        "code": "COA 11.55",
                        "commitment": "GGS Habitat Avoidance and Encounter Response",
                        "name": "Avoid Suitable GGS Habitat and Confine Work to Disturbed Areas",
                        "text": "To the greatest extent practicable, suitable GGS habitat identified and delineated in accordance with\nthe CDFW-approved GGS survey protocol (Condition of Approval 11.38) shall be completely avoided.\nWhere possible, Permittee shall conduct Covered Activities within paved roads, farm roads, road\nshoulders, and similarly disturbed and compacted areas.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNPC70G96ND7GGB3PC49": {
                        "code": "COA 11.55",
                        "commitment": "GGS Habitat Avoidance and Encounter Response",
                        "name": "Keep Staging, Parking and Stockpiles Away from Suitable Habitat",
                        "text": "Permittee shall restrict stockpiling of\nconstruction materials including portable equipment, vehicles, and supplies away from GGS suitable\nhabitat including any ESAs (see Condition of Approval 11.54). Permittee shall confine all Project-\nrelated parking, staging areas, storage areas, laydown sites, equipment storage, and any other\nsurface-disturbing activities to the Project Site using, to the extent possible, previously disturbed\nareas.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNPC70G96ND7GGB3PC4A": {
                        "code": "COA 11.55",
                        "commitment": "GGS Habitat Avoidance and Encounter Response",
                        "name": "Submit Habitat Disturbance Footprint for CDFW Approval",
                        "text": "Permittee\nshall identify suitable GGS habitat, locations of proposed surface-disturbing activities, proposed areas\nfor ground disturbance, and habitat removal within the appropriate Phase Authorization Package\n(Condition of Approval 6.1 and 6.2) for CDFW review and approval prior to initiation of Covered\nActivities.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34X89RDDJZVZVMK8Y0H",
                            "name": "Submit Habitat Disturbance Footprint and ESAs for CDFW Approval"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNPC70G96ND7GGB3PC4B": {
                        "code": "COA 11.55",
                        "commitment": "GGS Habitat Avoidance and Encounter Response",
                        "name": "Biologist Guides Project Access and Work Around ESAs",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall help guide Project access and\nconstruction work around ESAs (e.g., wetlands, active rice fields, and other sensitive habitats capable\nof supporting GGS) to minimize habitat disturbance and risk of take of GGS.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNPC70G96ND7GGB3PC4C": {
                        "code": "COA 11.55",
                        "commitment": "GGS Habitat Avoidance and Encounter Response",
                        "name": "Implement Dust Control to Preserve GGS Monitoring Visibility",
                        "text": "Permittee shall implement dust control measures during Covered Activities to\nfacilitate visibility for monitoring of GGS by the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNPDV7QXCBYW8DDTXVYZ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.55",
                        "commitment": "GGS Habitat Avoidance and Encounter Response",
                        "name": "Report GGS Encounters and Establish Refuge No-Activity Buffer",
                        "text": "Project personnel shall inform the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) if they\nencounter GGS, or any snake resembling GGS, within or near the Project construction site during all\nphases of Covered Activities. If Project personnel observe GGS, or any snake resembling GGS,\nretreating into an underground burrow, crack, or crevice, including rock riprap for refuge within a\nProject construction site, Permittee shall prohibit Covered Activities within a 50-foot radius of the\nrefuge…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNPDV7QXCBYW8DDTXVZ0": {
                        "code": "COA 11.55",
                        "commitment": "GGS Habitat Avoidance and Encounter Response",
                        "name": "Stop Work and Relocate GGS Unearthed During Ground Disturbance",
                        "text": "If Permittee unearths or uncovers a GGS while conducting\nground disturbing activities, the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall have the\nauthority to stop Covered Activities and allow it to escape the Project construction site of its own\nvolition or the Designated Biologist(s) may relocate it in accordance with Condition of Approval\n11.67.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNR4G0SVH144QWV0HBM2": {
                        "code": "COA 11.55.1",
                        "commitment": "Vehicle Access and Speed in GGS Habitat",
                        "name": "Confine Project Vehicles to Existing Routes",
                        "text": "Project-related vehicles shall access the Project\nconstruction site(s) during Covered Activities using existing routes and shall not cross GGS habitat\noutside of the Project construction site(s) unless otherwise authorized by CDFW.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNR53ZMKFRBNXWPVN05H": {
                        "code": "COA 11.55.1",
                        "commitment": "Vehicle Access and Speed in GGS Habitat",
                        "name": "Observe Vehicle Speed Limits in GGS Upland Habitat",
                        "text": "Project-related\nvehicle traffic shall observe speed limits consistent with Condition of Approval 11.11 in Project\nconstruction sites and access roads within suitable GGS upland habitat.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNR53ZMKFRBNXWPVN05J": {
                        "code": "COA 11.55.1",
                        "commitment": "Vehicle Access and Speed in GGS Habitat",
                        "name": "Allow or Relocate GGS Found on a Roadway",
                        "text": "If GGS, or any snake resembling GGS, is found on or traversing a roadway, Project personnel shall allow the snake to\nsafely move off the road on its own, maneuver to avoid striking it, or shall notify the Designated\nBiologist(s) to move the snake off the road",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNSWCZGT0M3FST201ZGF": {
                        "code": "COA 11.56",
                        "commitment": "GGS Preconstruction and Clearance Surveys",
                        "name": "Conduct GGS Preconstruction Survey and Submit Results to CDFW",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if needed) from the Biological Monitor(s) shall conduct\nCDFW approved preconstruction surveys (Condition of Approval 11.38) within the boundaries of each\nProject site and include a three-foot buffer zone around the Project site, prior to initiation of any\nCovered Activities, including preconstruction activities, during the GGS active season (May 1 to\nOctober 1). Permittee shall submit the GGS preconstruction survey results to CDFW as part of…",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3XZ7WK0185QGKR01863",
                            "name": "Conduct Preconstruction GGS Survey"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNSXG45H0H0SE68K0EPD": {
                        "code": "COA 11.56",
                        "commitment": "GGS Preconstruction and Clearance Surveys",
                        "name": "Conduct and Report Annual GGS Surveys During Construction",
                        "text": "Subsequent\nsurvey efforts conducted after submittal of the Construction Phased Authorization Package, shall\noccur each year Covered Activities are expected to occur in GGS habitat or within three feet of the\nhabitat, or as otherwise approved by CDFW, and shall be reported to CDFW by the Permittee within\nthe Monthly Compliance Reporting (Condition of Approval 10.12) and summarized within each\nAnnual Status Report (Condition of Approval 10.13).",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3XZ7WK0185QGKR01864",
                            "name": "Conduct and Report Annual GGS Surveys"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNSXG45H0H0SE68K0EPE": {
                        "code": "COA 11.56",
                        "commitment": "GGS Preconstruction and Clearance Surveys",
                        "name": "Survey Within 24 Hours Before Exclusion Fencing Installation",
                        "text": "Additional GGS surveys shall occur within 24 hours (one calendar day) preceding exclusion fencing\ninstallation (see Condition of Approval 11.62) and shall provide 100% visual coverage of the Project\nconstruction site and three-foot buffer.",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3Y008XT5YC8FTSZY6J3",
                            "name": "Conduct GGS Survey Before Exclusion Fencing Installation"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNSXG45H0H0SE68K0EPF": {
                        "code": "COA 11.56",
                        "commitment": "GGS Preconstruction and Clearance Surveys",
                        "name": "Resurvey After a Lapse in Covered Activities",
                        "text": "The survey shall be repeated prior to reinitiating Covered\nActivities if a lapse in Covered Activities of 14 calendar days or greater occurs at the Project\nconstruction site during the aestivation period (October 2 to April 30) or if the lapse in Covered\nActivities is more than 12 hours during the active season (May 1 to October 1).",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNSXG45H0H0SE68K0EPG": {
                        "code": "COA 11.56",
                        "commitment": "GGS Preconstruction and Clearance Surveys",
                        "name": "Investigate Burrows for GGS Occupancy",
                        "text": "Within the Project construction site and three-foot boundary, the Designated Biologist(s) with\nassistance (if needed) from the Biological Monitor(s) shall investigate all burrows within suitable\nupland habitat outside of established ESAs using a CDFW-approved methodology (see Condition of\nApproval 11.62.2) to determine whether the burrows are occupied by GGS.",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNSXG45H0H0SE68K0EPH": {
                        "code": "COA 11.56",
                        "commitment": "GGS Preconstruction and Clearance Surveys",
                        "name": "Block Vacant Burrows and Relocate Any GGS Found",
                        "text": "The Designated\nBiologist(s) shall monitor to determine vacancy, then block unoccupied burrows (e.g., less than three\nfeet long with dead ends) by installing an object approved in advance, in writing by CDFW, to prevent\nGGS from entering and using the burrow during Covered Activities. The Designated Biologist(s) shall\nremove the object immediately after Covered Activities are completed in that work site when they\nhave determined that potential resumed use of the burrow will not result in harm to…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCR2",
                            "name": "Block burrows after confirming vacancy"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNSXG45H0H0SE68K0EPJ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.56",
                        "commitment": "GGS Preconstruction and Clearance Surveys",
                        "name": "Avoid Disturbing Known or Potentially Occupied Burrows",
                        "text": "Permittee shall avoid disturbing any known or\npotentially occupied burrows unless they are in an area of direct ground disturbance (e.g., grading\nareas, excavation areas) or their location poses a risk of direct harm to GGS. Permittee shall not\ndestroy or modify burrows or exclude GGS from burrows that are beyond the direct footprint of\nground disturbance.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNSY95MBB3815AW1HPQ4": {
                        "code": "COA 11.56",
                        "commitment": "GGS Preconstruction and Clearance Surveys",
                        "name": "Hand Excavate Unavoidable Burrows Before Trenching",
                        "text": "Where the Permittee cannot avoid burrows (e.g., within footprint of ground\ndisturbing activities), they shall be carefully hand excavated by the Designated Biologist prior to\ntrenching activities consistent with Condition of Approval 11.62.2 and any GGS found during\nexcavation that does not leave of their own volition shall be relocated according to the GGS\nRelocation Plan (see Condition of Approval 11.67).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCR1",
                            "name": "Excavate and collapse burrows ahead of trenching"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNVNRM56GDXBV3B5RXSF": {
                        "code": "COA 11.57",
                        "commitment": "Mowing Restrictions in GGS Habitat",
                        "name": "Avoid Vegetation Removal in ESAs, Burrows and Refugia",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not remove vegetation within established ESAs, avoidable burrows, burrow\ncomplexes, and suitable refugia to the greatest extent practicable.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNVPGQNZ1HSC42V2SN9P": {
                        "code": "COA 11.57",
                        "commitment": "Mowing Restrictions in GGS Habitat",
                        "name": "Limit Mowing to July–September Window After Clearance Survey",
                        "text": "If Covered Activities require the\nremoval or maintenance of vegetation, Permittee shall limit mowing to occur only between July 1 to\nSeptember 30 in suitable GGS habitat and after a Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s)\nhas performed clearance surveys to ensure absence of GGS. Within 24 hours (one calendar day)\nfollowing the clearance survey (see Condition of Approval 11.56) in Project construction sites or\nProject maintenance areas with high grass cover or vegetation, Permittee…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNVPGQNZ1HSC42V2SN9Q": {
                        "code": "COA 11.57",
                        "commitment": "Mowing Restrictions in GGS Habitat",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval for Non-String-Trimmer Mowing Equipment",
                        "text": "Any Permittee request to use other mowing equipment (e.g., for locations away from refugia and burrow complexes) shall be subject to CDFW approval.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34WE7XE98281ZXQVPK8",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval of Mowing or Clearing Equipment"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNVPGQNZ1HSC42V2SN9R": {
                        "code": "COA 11.57",
                        "commitment": "Mowing Restrictions in GGS Habitat",
                        "name": "Maintain Vegetation Height at Minimum Six Inches When Mowing",
                        "text": "Permittee shall maintain vegetation at a minimum of six inches to avoid injuring\nGGS and to retain grassy cover and that allows the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological\nMonitor(s) to see and survey for snakes and burrows.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNVPGQNZ1HSC42V2SN9S": {
                        "code": "COA 11.57",
                        "commitment": "Mowing Restrictions in GGS Habitat",
                        "name": "Biologist Monitors Mowing and Halts Work on GGS Detection",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological\nMonitor(s) shall be onsite during all mowing and trenching activities. The Designated Biologist(s)\nand/or Biological Monitor(s) shall walk in front of the mower and monitor for GGS emerging from the\nvegetation or burrows. If GGS is found, Permittee shall cease mowing until GGS moves out of the way\non its own or, if needed, is relocated by the Designated Biologist(s) (see Condition of Approval 11.67).",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNVPGQNZ1HSC42V2SN9T": {
                        "code": "COA 11.57",
                        "commitment": "Mowing Restrictions in GGS Habitat",
                        "name": "Mow in Rows Directed Away From Concentrating Animals",
                        "text": "Permittee shall mow in rows and not in a\ncircular pattern that would concentrate animals in the center of a construction site. Permittee shall\nstart mowing farthest from the water to force snakes toward the water when mowing fields near\nstreams or canals. By cutting the swath along the water last, the snakes will be allowed to maintain\ncover and escape.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNVPGQNZ1HSC42V2SN9V": {
                        "code": "COA 11.57",
                        "commitment": "Mowing Restrictions in GGS Habitat",
                        "name": "Limit Channel Bank Mowing to One Side Per Year",
                        "text": "Permittee shall limit mowing on banks to one side of the channel per year to\nmaintain cover and escape.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNVPGQNZ1HSC42V2SN9W": {
                        "code": "COA 11.57",
                        "commitment": "Mowing Restrictions in GGS Habitat",
                        "name": "Avoid Mowing Emergent Vegetation",
                        "text": "Permittee shall avoid mowing emergent vegetation (i.e., tule, cattail,\nsedge, rush) to the maximum extent feasible.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNVPGQNZ1HSC42V2SN9X": {
                        "code": "COA 11.57",
                        "commitment": "Mowing Restrictions in GGS Habitat",
                        "name": "Prohibit Discing or Tilling of Upland GGS Habitat",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not disc or till upland vegetation as\ndisking is more hazardous to GGS that are underground than mowing.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNXF8Y5A3Q47BDSYDRSE": {
                        "code": "COA 11.58",
                        "commitment": "GGS Seasonal Work Window",
                        "name": "Confine Ground-Disturbing Work to the GGS Active Period",
                        "text": "Permittee shall confine all fill, vegetation removal, and other ground disturbing Covered Activities\nduring preconstruction and construction activities or Project maintenance areas within suitable GGS\naquatic and upland habitat (areas within 200 feet of aquatic habitat) to the GGS active period\nbetween May 1 and October 1 unless otherwise approved by CDFW per Condition of Approval 11.59.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNZAYEXA85ZFZK0QSTVT": {
                        "code": "COA 11.58.1",
                        "commitment": "Low Rainfall and Dry Weather Work Period in GGS Habitat",
                        "name": "Restrict Work Period to Low Rainfall and Dry Weather",
                        "text": "The work period for Covered Activities\nwithin suitable GGS habitat shall be restricted to periods of low rainfall (less than 0.25 inch per\n24-hour period) and periods of dry weather (with less than a 40 percent chance of rain) unless\notherwise approved by CDFW.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMNZAYEXA85ZFZK0QSTVV": {
                        "code": "COA 11.58.1",
                        "commitment": "Low Rainfall and Dry Weather Work Period in GGS Habitat",
                        "name": "Monitor 72-Hour Forecast and Observe Post-Rain Dry-Out Period",
                        "text": "Permittee shall monitor the National Weather Service 72-hour\nforecast for all Project Phases of Covered Activities within the Project Site. No work shall occur\nduring a dry-out period of 24 hours after the above referenced wet weather. Weather forecasts\nshall be provided to CDFW upon request.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP13NA9T96QAKVJHBMPP": {
                        "code": "COA 11.59",
                        "commitment": "GGS Seasonal Work Restriction Exception",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval for Early-Season Work Before May 1",
                        "text": "Permittee may conduct Covered Activities within suitable GGS habitat prior to May 1 during the GGS\ninactive season only after consultation with and obtaining written approval from CDFW, which\napproval may require additional measures to minimize and/or avoid potential impacts to GGS during\nactivities prior to May 1. Permittee shall provide evidence from the National Weather Service that\nambient daytime temperature has remained within a minimum range of 45°F (±5°F) and 65°F (±3°F)\nfor two weeks.…",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34X89RDDJZVZVMK8Y0J",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval to Work Outside the Seasonal Window"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP1408Q3PX5ZFQRD41HX": {
                        "code": "COA 11.59",
                        "commitment": "GGS Seasonal Work Restriction Exception",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval to Work Outside the Window via Early Ground Disturbance",
                        "text": "Permittee may also conduct Covered Activities\nwithin suitable GGS habitat outside of the seasonal work restriction if initial ground disturbance\nremoving suitable habitat within a construction site has been conducted prior to September 15 and\nthe construction site already has an exclusion barrier in place (see Condition of Approval 11.62).\nPermittee shall submit these requests in writing for review and approval by CDFW. Requests shall\ninclude a justification for the request and any additional…",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34X89RDDJZVZVMK8Y0J",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval to Work Outside the Seasonal Window"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP2T4KRS4836CF7YNNNX": {
                        "code": "COA 11.60",
                        "commitment": "In-Channel Work and GGS Seasonal Restriction",
                        "name": "Confine In-Channel Work to the Inactive-Season Window and Scope",
                        "text": "Permittee shall conduct all in-channel Covered Activities only between October 2 and April 30 (GGS\ninactive period). In-channel work shall be limited to removal of accumulated sediments, acoustic\nmonitoring, and aquatic vegetation removal in canals or other areas where GGS may be\noverwintering within 200 feet of the activity, until CDFW-approved surveys (Condition of Approval 11.38) have occurred and absence of overwintering GGS has been confirmed by the Designated\nBiologist(s). Permittee shall…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP2VS2KH28B9FRJ498K8": {
                        "code": "COA 11.60",
                        "commitment": "In-Channel Work and GGS Seasonal Restriction",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval and Survey for In-Channel Work in Active Season",
                        "text": "If in-channel work needs to occur within the GGS active season, Permittee shall request\nwritten approval by CDFW and have the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) survey\nfollowing CDFW-approved protocols (Condition of Approval 11.38) for GGS prior to initiating work\nand monitor throughout the duration of Covered Activities for GGS.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34X89RDDJZVZVMK8Y0M",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval for In-Channel Work in the GGS Active Season"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP2VS2KH28B9FRJ498K9": {
                        "code": "COA 11.60",
                        "commitment": "In-Channel Work and GGS Seasonal Restriction",
                        "name": "Leave Canal Banks Undisturbed",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not disturb canal banks as many GGS overwinter very close to (i.e., within three to six\nfeet of) canals.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP2VS2KH28B9FRJ498KA": {
                        "code": "COA 11.60",
                        "commitment": "In-Channel Work and GGS Seasonal Restriction",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval for Non-String-Trimmer Canal Mowing Equipment",
                        "text": "Hand clearing of canals or light mowing equipment limited to string trimmers (e.g.,\nweed whackers), shall be used for removal of excessive vegetation or debris if such removal is\nneeded. Other mowing equipment requested by the Permittee shall be subject to CDFW approval.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34WE7XE98281ZXQVPK8",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval of Mowing or Clearing Equipment"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP2VS2KH28B9FRJ498KB": {
                        "code": "COA 11.60",
                        "commitment": "In-Channel Work and GGS Seasonal Restriction",
                        "name": "Place Canal-Clearing Spoils Away from Bank Tops",
                        "text": "Permittee shall place any spoils from canal clearing in a designated location, rather than along bank\ntops, to prevent burying or crushing snakes basking on the banks or trapping snakes taking cover in\nburrows or bank-top soil crevices.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP2VS2KH28B9FRJ498KC": {
                        "code": "COA 11.60",
                        "commitment": "In-Channel Work and GGS Seasonal Restriction",
                        "name": "Operate Equipment from Bank Top and Limit Excavation to One Side Per Year",
                        "text": "Any equipment shall be operated from the bank top and Permittee\nshall excavate from only one side of the canal during a given year so emergent vegetation and bank\nside cover is left in place.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP2VS2KH28B9FRJ498KD": {
                        "code": "COA 11.60",
                        "commitment": "In-Channel Work and GGS Seasonal Restriction",
                        "name": "Haul or Place Dredged Material Away from GGS Cover Features",
                        "text": "Permittee shall haul any dredged or excavated material off site or place it in areas lacking rodent\nburrows, riprap, or other materials that might provide dormant period cover for GGS.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP2WVD08ZN1ZQFKCJS5Z": {
                        "code": "COA 11.60",
                        "commitment": "In-Channel Work and GGS Seasonal Restriction",
                        "name": "Prohibit Discing of Upland GGS Habitat",
                        "text": "Upland habitat\nshall not be disced.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP2WVD08ZN1ZQFKCJS60": {
                        "code": "COA 11.60",
                        "commitment": "In-Channel Work and GGS Seasonal Restriction",
                        "name": "Retain Vegetation on Levees and Canal Sides",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not remove vegetation on levees and canal sides to the maximum\nextent feasible.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP4JFYT5C3WF6QC3PDCX": {
