                        "code": "COA 11.61",
                        "commitment": "Dewatering of GGS Aquatic Habitat",
                        "name": "Dewater Unavoidable GGS Aquatic Habitat Before Work Begins",
                        "text": "If Permittee cannot avoid conducting Covered Activities in suitable GGS aquatic habitat, Permittee\nshall dewater the habitat within the Project construction site prior to starting the Covered Activity.\nPermittee shall limit dewatering to the immediate Project construction site and shall ensure that\nalternative aquatic habitat is available.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCR3",
                            "name": "Dewater aquatic habitat and hold the dry period"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP4K7W5XYW0R2Z17AQ13": {
                        "code": "COA 11.61",
                        "commitment": "Dewatering of GGS Aquatic Habitat",
                        "name": "Station Biologist to Salvage GGS During Dewatering",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) shall be on site during all\ndewatering activities, particularly when dewatering begins and when the level of water reaches the\nlevel of the intake, to salvage and relocate any GGS that cannot swim away from the suction cups and\nescape on its own.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP4K7W5XYW0R2Z17AQ14": {
                        "code": "COA 11.61",
                        "commitment": "Dewatering of GGS Aquatic Habitat",
                        "name": "Shut Down Pump and Contact Biologist if GGS Seen at Intake Screen",
                        "text": "If Project personnel see GGS at the screen during dewatering, they shall shut\ndown the pump and contact the Designated Biologist(s) to relocate the snake (see Condition of\nApproval 11.67).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP4K7W5XYW0R2Z17AQ15": {
                        "code": "COA 11.61",
                        "commitment": "Dewatering of GGS Aquatic Habitat",
                        "name": "Maintain 15-Day Dry Period Before Excavating or Filling Dewatered Habitat",
                        "text": "Permittee shall ensure that habitat remains dry for at least 15 consecutive days\nafter April 15 prior to excavating or filling aquatic habitat.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCR3",
                            "name": "Dewater aquatic habitat and hold the dry period"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP4K7W5XYW0R2Z17AQ16": {
                        "code": "COA 11.61",
                        "commitment": "Dewatering of GGS Aquatic Habitat",
                        "name": "Limit Dewatering to the April 15–October 1 Window",
                        "text": "Permittee shall limit dewatering to April 15 – October 1 unless otherwise approved by CDFW.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP4K7W5XYW0R2Z17AQ17": {
                        "code": "COA 11.61",
                        "commitment": "Dewatering of GGS Aquatic Habitat",
                        "name": "Survey for GGS Following Dewatering",
                        "text": "Following dewatering of aquatic habitat, the\nDesignated Biologist(s) shall survey for GGS in all suitable GGS aquatic or upland habitat within the Project construction site that is not within the established ESAs. If GGS is observed, the Designated\nBiologist(s) shall follow the GGS Relocation Plan (Condition of Approval 11.67).",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3Y008XT5YC8FTSZY6J4",
                            "name": "Conduct Post-Dewatering GGS Clearance Survey"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP4K7W5XYW0R2Z17AQ18": {
                        "code": "COA 11.61",
                        "commitment": "Dewatering of GGS Aquatic Habitat",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval for Deviations from the Dewatering Measure",
                        "text": "Permittee and the\nDesignated Biologist(s) shall obtain written approval from CDFW for any deviation from this measure\nand shall coordinate alternative actions with CDFW.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34X89RDDJZVZVMK8Y0N",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval of Dewatering Measure Deviations"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP4MX65TNY0B89G46JP2": {
                        "code": "COA 11.61",
                        "commitment": "Dewatering of GGS Aquatic Habitat",
                        "name": "Install Exclusion Fencing Once Habitat Is Confirmed GGS-Free",
                        "text": "Once habitat is deemed free of potential GGS,\nexclusion fencing shall be installed around the Project construction site (see Condition of Approval 11.62) so no snakes or other wildlife may reenter prior to or during construction.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCQZ",
                            "name": "Install exclusion barriers at work areas and shaft openings"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP6B09YEGB5XD12TN3G2": {
                        "code": "COA 11.62",
                        "commitment": "GGS Exclusion Barrier Installation and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Submit Exclusion Barrier Design and Location to CDFW",
                        "text": "The Permittee shall submit the fencing design and\nlocations as part of the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization Package.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34X89RDDJZVZVMK8Y0E",
                            "name": "Submit Exclusion Barrier Design and Locations to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP6B09YEGB5XD12TN3G3": {
                        "code": "COA 11.62",
                        "commitment": "GGS Exclusion Barrier Installation and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Erect Exclusion Barrier Before Ground-Disturbing Activities",
                        "text": "Prior to initiation of ground disturbing Covered Activities (e.g., staging, vegetation removal) and\nwithin 24 hours after preconstruction surveys and burrow excavations are completed (see Conditions\nof Approval 11.56 and 11.62.2), Permittee shall erect a high visibility exclusion barrier to exclude GGS\nfrom entering the Project construction site. Permittee shall place the barrier along the perimeter of\nthe Project construction site within all suitable GGS habitat where ground disturbing…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCQZ",
                            "name": "Install exclusion barriers at work areas and shaft openings"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP6CF3YRTR62KB5BMKWA": {
                        "code": "COA 11.62",
                        "commitment": "GGS Exclusion Barrier Installation and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Monitor Biologically During Barrier Installation",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall inspect the area prior to and\nduring installation, including trenching, vehicular access, erecting fencing material, installing stakes,\nand any other activity requiring vehicle or foot traffic in suitable habitat.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP6CF3YRTR62KB5BMKWB": {
                        "code": "COA 11.62",
                        "commitment": "GGS Exclusion Barrier Installation and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Inspect Barrier Daily and After Rain Events",
                        "text": "After installation, the\nDesignated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall inspect the barrier daily and during and\nafter rain events (rainfall predicted to exceed 0.25 inches during a 24-hour period).",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP6CF3YRTR62KB5BMKWC": {
                        "code": "COA 11.62",
                        "commitment": "GGS Exclusion Barrier Installation and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Maintain and Immediately Repair Barrier Defects",
                        "text": "Permittee shall\nmaintain the barrier throughout the entire duration of Covered Activities and repair it immediately to\nensure that it is functional and without defects, that fencing material is taut so snakes are unable to\nclimb over, and that the bottom edge of the fencing material remains buried. If a defect is identified,\nthe Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall have authority to stop Covered\nActivities within 50 feet of the defect.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP6CF3YRTR62KB5BMKWD": {
                        "code": "COA 11.62",
                        "commitment": "GGS Exclusion Barrier Installation and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Survey and Re-Search the Barrier Line After Repair",
                        "text": "After the barrier is repaired, the Designated Biologist(s) shall\nconduct a survey using CDFW-approved protocol (see Condition of Approval 11.38) within 24 hours\n(one calendar day) prior to re-initiation of Covered Activities and carefully search within and along\nexclusion fencing and in pipes, culverts, or other potential places of hiding and entrapment (see\nConditions of Approval 11.14 and 11.15) and beneath vehicles and equipment immediately before\nthey are moved (see Condition of Approval…",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP6CF3YRTR62KB5BMKWE": {
                        "code": "COA 11.62",
                        "commitment": "GGS Exclusion Barrier Installation and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Avoid or Hand-Excavate Burrows During Barrier Installation",
                        "text": "Permittee shall avoid damage to burrows to the maximum extent possible during installation of the\nexclusion fencing. When Permittee cannot avoid burrows, burrows shall be hand excavated by the\nDesignated Biologist(s) prior to trenching activities. The Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if\nneeded) from the Biological Monitor(s) shall watch for burrows on either side of the barrier during\ntrenching.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP6CF3YRTR62KB5BMKWF": {
                        "code": "COA 11.62",
                        "commitment": "GGS Exclusion Barrier Installation and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Stop Barrier Construction When GGS Is Discovered and Block Undermined Burrows",
                        "text": "If GGS are discovered during barrier construction, the Designated Biologist(s) and/or\nBiological Monitor(s) shall have the authority to stop barrier construction until the GGS leaves the construction site on its own volition, is relocated in accordance with Condition of Approval 11.67, and\nunoccupied burrows that appear to extend under the fencing are blocked or excavated by the\nDesignated Biologist (see Condition of Approval 11.62.2).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCR2",
                            "name": "Block burrows after confirming vacancy"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP6CF3YRTR62KB5BMKWG": {
                        "code": "COA 11.62",
                        "commitment": "GGS Exclusion Barrier Installation and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Maintain Low Vegetation Along the Barrier's Outer Side",
                        "text": "Permittee shall maintain vegetation within\nthree feet on the side of the fence away from the Project construction site, unless otherwise\napproved by CDFW, at a maximum height of six inches to discourage GGS from using vegetation\nalong the barrier fencing and to increase visibility of GGS near the barrier. Permittee shall use hand\ntools to trim or remove vegetation. The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall\nmonitor all vegetation removal to minimize impacts to GGS.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP6CF3YRTR62KB5BMKWH": {
                        "code": "COA 11.62",
                        "commitment": "GGS Exclusion Barrier Installation and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Construct the Barrier to Specification",
                        "text": "Fencing shall be buried a\nminimum of six inches below ground and soil shall be compacted against both sides of the fence for\nits entire length to prevent animals from passing under the fence. Fencing shall extend at least 24\ninches above the ground and shall be constructed with a top climber barrier lip so that GGS cannot\nscale and go over the barrier into the Project construction site. Fencing that is overlapped to connect\ndifferent sections of material shall be sealed in a manner that does…",
                        "type": "Design",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP6D71ETMFGEBPMJCEPZ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.62",
                        "commitment": "GGS Exclusion Barrier Installation and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Prohibit Plastic Monofilament Netting in the Exclusion Barrier",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not use plastic monofilament\nnetting for the exclusion barrier (see Condition of Approval 11.28).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP6D71ETMFGEBPMJCEQ0": {
                        "code": "COA 11.62",
                        "commitment": "GGS Exclusion Barrier Installation and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Keep Access Gates Closed and Stop Work if Left Open",
                        "text": "Permittee shall instruct\nProject personnel to ensure access gates are securely closed when not in use. If access gates are left\nopen and unattended, the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall have the\nauthority to stop Covered Activities until GGS surveys are repeated consistent with Condition of\nApproval 11.56, GGS found are relocated from the Project construction site (see Condition of\nApproval 11.67), and additional burrows are checked and blocked or excavated in…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP6D71ETMFGEBPMJCEQ1": {
                        "code": "COA 11.62",
                        "commitment": "GGS Exclusion Barrier Installation and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Keep Barrier in Place Until Completion and Remove It Afterward",
                        "text": "The barrier shall remain in place until the Permittee completes all\nCovered Activities, and all construction equipment has been removed from the Project construction\nsite. Permittee shall remove the barrier and all barrier materials upon completion of construction-\nrelated Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCR0",
                            "name": "Remove exclusion barriers after covered activities end"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP86ZDJDW04YY8YTW5QH": {
                        "code": "COA 11.62.1",
                        "commitment": "GGS Refugia Flagging and No-Activity Buffers",
                        "name": "Flag Burrows and Habitat Features Outside the Disturbance Footprint",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall identify\nand flag all potential burrows, soil cracks, crevices, or other habitat features that are outside of\nthe area planned for direct disturbance (e.g., grading, excavation, etc.) and within the Project\nconstruction site, no less than five days prior to earthmoving activities in those areas.",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3Y008XT5YC8FTSZY6J5",
                            "name": "Flag Burrows and Habitat Features Before Earthmoving"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP86ZDJDW04YY8YTW5QJ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.62.1",
                        "commitment": "GGS Refugia Flagging and No-Activity Buffers",
                        "name": "Establish and Respect No-Activity Buffers Around Flagged Burrows",
                        "text": "Permittee shall establish a 50-foot radius no-activity buffer around flagged burrows that can be avoided\nwithin the preconstruction activity sites, constructions sites, access roads, SCADA and\ntransmission line construction, and maintenance sites, and the three-foot buffer zone. Permittee\nshall avoid flagged locations during Covered Activities to the maximum extent feasible.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP86ZDJDW04YY8YTW5QK": {
                        "code": "COA 11.62.1",
                        "commitment": "GGS Refugia Flagging and No-Activity Buffers",
                        "name": "Monitor for GGS On Site During Ground-Disturbing Activities",
                        "text": "In areas\nplanned for direct disturbance, the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall be\nonsite to monitor for potential GGS during ground disturbing activities.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP86ZDJDW04YY8YTW5QM": {
                        "code": "COA 11.62.1",
                        "commitment": "GGS Refugia Flagging and No-Activity Buffers",
                        "name": "Demarcate High-Burrow-Concentration Areas as ESAs",
                        "text": "Areas with a high\nconcentration of suitable burrows or refugia spots shall be demarcated as ESAs consistent with\nCondition of Approval 11.54 and avoided to the greatest extent possible.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCQY",
                            "name": "Install ESA fencing and identification signage"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP86ZDJDW04YY8YTW5QN": {
                        "code": "COA 11.62.1",
                        "commitment": "GGS Refugia Flagging and No-Activity Buffers",
                        "name": "Submit Proposed ESAs and Burrow-Bearing Areas to CDFW for Approval",
                        "text": "Proposed ESAs and any\narea containing suitable burrows or refugia shall be identified as part of the appropriate Phase\nAuthorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.1 and 6.2) for CDFW review and approval prior to\nthe initiation of any Covered Activity.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34X89RDDJZVZVMK8Y0H",
                            "name": "Submit Habitat Disturbance Footprint and ESAs for CDFW Approval"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP86ZDJDW04YY8YTW5QP": {
                        "code": "COA 11.62.1",
                        "commitment": "GGS Refugia Flagging and No-Activity Buffers",
                        "name": "Determine Vacancy and Block or Excavate Burrows That Cannot Be Buffered",
                        "text": "If burrows cannot be avoided by a no-activity buffer\nand are within suitable upland habitat, Permittee shall monitor to determine vacancy and block\nthe burrows or excavate occupied burrows as described in Condition of Approval 11.62.2.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCR2",
                            "name": "Block burrows after confirming vacancy"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP9YA0W4A4Q9V4P970E3": {
                        "code": "COA 11.62.2",
                        "commitment": "GGS Burrow Excavation by Designated Biologist",
                        "name": "Avoid Disturbing Known or Potentially Occupied Burrows",
                        "text": "Permittee shall avoid disturbing any known or potentially occupied\nburrows unless they are in an area of direct ground disturbance (e.g., grading areas, excavation\nareas) or their location poses a risk of direct harm to GGS.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP9ZV6NV1G1EA1KK4YJB": {
                        "code": "COA 11.62.2",
                        "commitment": "GGS Burrow Excavation by Designated Biologist",
                        "name": "Determine Burrow Vacancy, Block Unoccupied Burrows, and Remove Blocks After Work",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist shall first\nmonitor to determine vacancy and attempt to expose and identify any snakes found in burrows,\nthen block the entrance of unoccupied burrows (e.g., less than three feet long with dead ends) by\ninstalling an object approved in advance in writing by CDFW, to prevent Covered Species from\nentering and using the burrow during Covered Activities. The Designated Biologist(s) shall remove\nthe object immediately after Covered Activities are completed in that work site…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCR2",
                            "name": "Block burrows after confirming vacancy"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMP9ZV6NV1G1EA1KK4YJC": {
                        "code": "COA 11.62.2",
                        "commitment": "GGS Burrow Excavation by Designated Biologist",
                        "name": "Hand Excavate Unavoidable Burrows and Refuge Features Before Trenching",
                        "text": "Where the Permittee cannot avoid burrows (e.g., within footprint of ground disturbing activities),\nthey shall be carefully excavated prior to any trenching activities and any GGS found during\nexcavation that does not leave of its own volition shall be relocated according to Condition of\nApproval 11.67. All excavation of potential refuge features, including identified burrows, soil\ncracks, crevices, individual rocks and rock piles, and other accessible features for GGS, shall be\ncarried out by…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCR1",
                            "name": "Excavate and collapse burrows ahead of trenching"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPBQEHX1ATS8PGJM8C33": {
                        "code": "COA 11.63",
                        "commitment": "Initial Site Clearing and GGS Monitoring",
                        "name": "Confine Clearance Work to Minimal Disturbance Footprint",
                        "text": "Permittee shall confine ground disturbance that could result in take of GGS (clearance work) to the\nmost minimal area necessary to conduct Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPBRY7DF2GSN7K01R43J": {
                        "code": "COA 11.63",
                        "commitment": "Initial Site Clearing and GGS Monitoring",
                        "name": "Monitor Clearing Site Daily for Emerging and Sheltering GGS",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) with\nassistance (if needed) from Biological Monitor(s) shall be onsite during initial ground disturbing\nactivities to assess the Project construction site each morning before construction work begins. The\nDesignated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall monitor burrows that have not been blocked or excavated for emerging GGS. The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s)\nshall also check any potential hiding places in the Project construction…",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPBRY7DF2GSN7K01R43K": {
                        "code": "COA 11.63",
                        "commitment": "Initial Site Clearing and GGS Monitoring",
                        "name": "Halt Work and Apply Corrective Measures on GGS Discovery",
                        "text": "If GGS is discovered,\nthe Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall have the authority to delay construction\nactivities until the GGS leaves the construction site of its own volition or is removed from the\nconstruction site by the Designated Biologist(s) in accordance with Condition of Approval 11.67 and\nPermittee implements appropriate corrective measures to ensure GGS will not enter the construction\nsite through the exclusion barrier.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPDJBZR8PXAQ1TN7D8EC": {
                        "code": "COA 11.64",
                        "commitment": "Disposal of Natural Debris in GGS Habitat",
                        "name": "Dispose of Cleared Natural Debris by an Approved Method",
                        "text": "Permittee shall use one, but not both, of the following methods to handle natural debris (debris\ncomposed of on-site vegetation, usually removed from waterways, not including spoils from\ndredging): (1) Debris shall be placed in piles 200 feet from aquatic habitat and within the exclusion\nbarrier (i.e., outside of fenced habitat). Debris piles shall not be disturbed or removed\nonce placed; or (2) Debris shall be immediately hauled off-site for disposal within 24 hours to avoid GGS…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPFFFN6XA2AYSQDTQAAE": {
                        "code": "COA 11.65",
                        "commitment": "GGS Measures for Preconstruction, SCADA, Transmission and Access Road Work",
                        "name": "Delineate and Avoid Suitable Aquatic GGS Habitat",
                        "text": "Permittee shall delineate suitable GGS aquatic habitat within preconstruction field investigations\nsites and SCADA, transmission line, and access road construction, and maintenance sites with highly\nvisible poly wire or other flagging approved by CDFW to demarcate it as a disturbance-free zone (see\nCondition of Approval 11.55). Permittee shall not conduct these Covered Activities in suitable GGS\naquatic habitat.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPFMQ9ZF5A9KB9VN8CD6": {
                        "code": "COA 11.65",
                        "commitment": "GGS Measures for Preconstruction, SCADA, Transmission and Access Road Work",
                        "name": "Delineate Suitable Upland GGS Habitat at Work Sites",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall delineate suitable\nupland habitat with flagging or other high-visible markers within the Covered Activity sites.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPFPCGNRWFXPM4CGKT4X": {
                        "code": "COA 11.65",
                        "commitment": "GGS Measures for Preconstruction, SCADA, Transmission and Access Road Work",
                        "name": "Restrict Upland Habitat Work to the GGS Active Season",
                        "text": "Permittee\nshall not conduct preconstruction field investigations and SCADA, transmission line, and access road\nconstruction, and maintenance sites in suitable GGS upland habitat during the inactive season from\nOctober 2 – April 30 unless otherwise approved by CDFW.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPFQNWZW6VVJM7QKG2P4": {
                        "code": "COA 11.65",
                        "commitment": "GGS Measures for Preconstruction, SCADA, Transmission and Access Road Work",
                        "name": "Confine Equipment Movement and Limit Vehicle Speed in Upland Habitat",
                        "text": "Permittee shall confine movement of heavy equipment to existing access roads or to locations\noutside of suitable GGS upland habitat to the extent practicable. • Project personnel shall limit vehicle speed to 10 miles per hour within exploration sites and on\nnon-public access roads.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPFQNWZW6VVJM7QKG2P5": {
                        "code": "COA 11.65",
                        "commitment": "GGS Measures for Preconstruction, SCADA, Transmission and Access Road Work",
                        "name": "Guide Site Access and Conduct Daily Burrow Surveys in Upland Habitat",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall be on-site during selection of\nthe field investigation site, ingress and egress, and during set-up activities to guide Project\npersonnel to avoid visible burrows until access routes are clearly established. • The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall conduct daily surveys prior to\nthe start of Covered Activities each day to check for burrows within the exploration site. The\nDesignated Biologist(s) and/or…",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPFQNWZW6VVJM7QKG2P6": {
                        "code": "COA 11.65",
                        "commitment": "GGS Measures for Preconstruction, SCADA, Transmission and Access Road Work",
                        "name": "Respond to GGS Encountered at the Work Site",
                        "text": "If Project personnel find GGS, or any snake resembling GGS, within the site, they shall allow\nGGS to leave the site on its own or notify the Designated Biologist(s) to relocate the GGS\noutside the Project Site, before continuing Covered Activities (see Condition of Approval\n11.67).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPFQNWZW6VVJM7QKG2P7": {
                        "code": "COA 11.65",
                        "commitment": "GGS Measures for Preconstruction, SCADA, Transmission and Access Road Work",
                        "name": "Limit Vegetation Control in Upland Habitat to Approved Mowing Methods",
                        "text": "Permittee shall only use mowing for vegetation control within suitable GGS upland habitat.\nPermittee shall use light mowing equipment limited to string trimmers (e.g., weed whackers)\nthat will not crush burrows or impact the ground.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPFQNWZW6VVJM7QKG2P8": {
                        "code": "COA 11.65",
                        "commitment": "GGS Measures for Preconstruction, SCADA, Transmission and Access Road Work",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval to Use Other Mowing Equipment",
                        "text": "Any request by Permittee to use other\nmowing equipment shall be subject to CDFW approval (e.g., for locations away from refugia\nand burrow complexes).",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34WE7XE98281ZXQVPK8",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval of Mowing or Clearing Equipment"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPFQNWZW6VVJM7QKG2P9": {
                        "code": "COA 11.65",
                        "commitment": "GGS Measures for Preconstruction, SCADA, Transmission and Access Road Work",
                        "name": "Limit Channel Bank Mowing and Preserve Emergent Vegetation Cover",
                        "text": "Permittee shall limit mowing on channel banks to one side of the\nchannel per year to maintain cover for GGS. Permittee shall avoid mowing emergent\nvegetation such as tule, cattail, sedge, or rush to the greatest extent practicable and shall\nkeep grassy vegetation at a minimum height of six inches.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPFRRK7FBN8PGN0GP06F": {
                        "code": "COA 11.65",
                        "commitment": "GGS Measures for Preconstruction, SCADA, Transmission and Access Road Work",
                        "name": "Restore Temporarily Disturbed Upland and Channel Habitat",
                        "text": "Permittee shall restore temporarily disturbed habitat with appropriate native vegetation in\naccordance with the Restoration and Revegetation Plan (see Condition of Approval 12.3.3).",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3V103NJ75GYQV09GB8T",
                            "name": "Restore Temporarily Impacted Habitat to Pre-Project Conditions"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPFRRK7FBN8PGN0GP06G": {
                        "code": "COA 11.65",
                        "commitment": "GGS Measures for Preconstruction, SCADA, Transmission and Access Road Work",
                        "name": "Perform Maintenance Without Crushing or Entombing GGS in Burrows",
                        "text": "Permittee shall ensure maintenance activities do not include ground disturbance activity that\nwould crush burrows or entomb GGS within a burrow.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPHJ9K1JPTSFFKW27FTB": {
                        "code": "COA 11.66",
                        "commitment": "Restoration of Temporary Impacts to GGS Habitat",
                        "name": "Restore Temporarily Impacted GGS Habitat to Pre-Project Conditions",
                        "text": "Permittee shall restore all temporarily impacted GGS habitat onsite to pre-\nProject conditions or better by removing temporary fill, construction debris and stockpiled materials,\nregrading to the pre-existing contour if appropriate or a contour that would improve restoration potential of the site with CDFW consultation and approval, and revegetating upland areas or\nreplanting emergent vegetation in active channels and on banks with CDFW approved and available\nnative plant species (see…",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3V103NJ75GYQV09GB8T",
                            "name": "Restore Temporarily Impacted Habitat to Pre-Project Conditions"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPHJ9K1JPTSFFKW27FTC": {
                        "code": "COA 11.66",
                        "commitment": "Restoration of Temporary Impacts to GGS Habitat",
                        "name": "Monitor Restored GGS Habitat Until Restoration Success",
                        "text": "Permittee shall monitor the restoration for one year or until restoration success is\nachieved as determined by the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) and CDFW.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPKAG6VQ9A1ZV3ZCXR6F": {
                        "code": "COA 11.67",
                        "commitment": "GGS Mortality Reduction and Relocation Plan",
                        "name": "Prepare and Submit GGS Mortality Reduction and Relocation Plan",
                        "text": "Permittee shall prepare a GGS Mortality Reduction and Relocation Plan (GGS Relocation Plan) and\nsubmit it to CDFW as part of the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization Package (Condition of\nApproval 6.2) prior to initiating Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NNJMTS3JZDQQZNRKEY",
                            "name": "Submit GGS Relocation Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPN4JPXNJPSZSQVFG3AB": {
                        "code": "COA 11.67.1",
                        "commitment": "GGS Handling, Relocation and Notification",
                        "name": "Capture and Handle GGS Only Through the Designated Biologist",
                        "text": "GGS may only be captured and handled by the CDFW-approved\nDesignated Biologist(s) (see Condition of Approval 9.2.1). If a GGS, or a snake resembling GGS, is\nfound on the Project construction site or three feet beyond the construction site, the Designated\nBiologist(s) shall be notified immediately and shall determine whether the animal should be\ncaptured and handled. The Designated Biologist(s) shall minimize capture and handling to the\ngreatest extent feasible as most reptiles experience stress…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPN4JPXNJPSZSQVFG3AC": {
                        "code": "COA 11.67.1",
                        "commitment": "GGS Handling, Relocation and Notification",
                        "name": "Relocate GGS Only When Directly Threatened and Unable to Self-Escape",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) shall only relocate GGS if the animal is directly\nthreatened by immediate Covered Activities and the animal is unable to move to a safe area on\nits own. Relocated GGS shall be released as soon as possible. The Designated Biologist(s) shall\nonly relocate GGS to areas identified in the Relocation Plan.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPN5893FF8Q2YE57ZWQA": {
                        "code": "COA 11.67.1",
                        "commitment": "GGS Handling, Relocation and Notification",
                        "name": "Notify CDFW Within 24 Hours of Each GGS Relocation",
                        "text": "The Permittee’s Designated\nRepresentative or the Designated Biologist(s) shall notify CDFW within 24 hours each time GGS is\nrelocated. Notification to CDFW shall be via telephone and email, followed by a written incident\nreport. Notifications shall include the date, time, location, and circumstances of the incident. The written incident report shall also be included in the Monthly Compliance Report (see Condition of\nApproval 10.12).",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R8HSR7K069ZM5EZCXW",
                            "name": "Report GGS Relocations to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPPWZPQPM63D24K68WYR": {
                        "code": "COA 11.68",
                        "commitment": "Notification of GGS Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Notify Designated Biologist Immediately of GGS Take, Injury or Death",
                        "text": "Permittee shall immediately notify the Designated Biologist(s) if a GGS is injured or killed by a\nCovered Activity, or if a GGS is otherwise found dead or injured within the vicinity of the Project\npreconstruction activity, construction site, or maintenance area.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R8HSR7K069ZM5EZCXN",
                            "name": "Notify the Designated Biologist of Covered Species Take or Injury"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPPXXTTV96MGFP9E403B": {
                        "code": "COA 11.68",
                        "commitment": "Notification of GGS Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Transport Injured GGS to a CDFW-Approved Rehabilitation Facility",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) shall\nimmediately take the GGS to a CDFW-approved wildlife rehabilitation or veterinary facility identified\nin the GGS Relocation Plan (see Condition of Approval 11.67) and contact the CDFW Representative,\nvia email and telephone, within one business day to discuss the next steps.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPPXXTTV96MGFP9E403C": {
                        "code": "COA 11.68",
                        "commitment": "Notification of GGS Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Bear Costs of Injured GGS Care and Treatment",
                        "text": "Permittee shall bear any\ncosts associated with the care or treatment of such injured GGS.",
                        "type": "Financial",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3ENYWE6AXT12YDFDJKZ",
                            "name": "Pay Care and Treatment Costs for Injured Covered Species"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPPXXTTV96MGFP9E403D": {
                        "code": "COA 11.68",
                        "commitment": "Notification of GGS Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Provide Initial and Written Incident Reports to CDFW on GGS Take or Injury",
                        "text": "The initial notification to CDFW shall\ninclude information regarding the location, species, and number of animals taken or injured, the\nname of the facility where the animal was taken if applicable, and the ITP number. Following initial\nnotification, Permittee shall send CDFW a written incident report within two business days to the\nCDFW Representative. The incident report shall include the date and time of the finding or incident,\nlocation of the animal or carcass or the name of the facility…",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R7PYV1TN3PG7JYE8R1",
                            "name": "Report Covered Species Take or Injury to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPRPJFZ3021PCVGNTYGF": {
                        "code": "COA 11.68.1",
                        "commitment": "Release of GGS With Minor Injury",
                        "name": "Release GGS With Minor, Survivable Injury Per Relocation Plan",
                        "text": "If the injury is minor or healing and the snake is likely to survive as\ndetermined by the Designated Biologist(s), the snake shall be released immediately in accordance\nwith the GGS Relocation Plan (Condition of Approval 11.67).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPTDWYH9N3QXCAWDTFSR": {
                        "code": "COA 11.68.2",
                        "commitment": "Treatment of Seriously Injured GGS",
                        "name": "Transport Seriously Injured GGS to Nearest Rehabilitation Facility",
                        "text": "If it is determined that the GGS individual has major or serious\ninjuries as a result of Project-related activities, the Designated Biologist(s) shall immediately take\nit to the nearest CDFW-approved wildlife rehabilitation or veterinary facility.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPTEM53MG569201GQDP6": {
                        "code": "COA 11.68.2",
                        "commitment": "Treatment of Seriously Injured GGS",
                        "name": "Restrict Release of Captive GGS to Quarantined, Agency-Authorized Cases",
                        "text": "If taken into\ncaptivity, the individual shall remain in captivity and shall not be released into the wild unless it\nhas been kept in quarantine and the release is authorized by CDFW and USFWS.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPTEM53MG569201GQDP7": {
                        "code": "COA 11.68.2",
                        "commitment": "Treatment of Seriously Injured GGS",
                        "name": "Bear Costs of Seriously Injured GGS Care and Treatment",
                        "text": "Permittee shall\nbear any costs associated with the care or treatment of such injured GGS.",
                        "type": "Financial",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3ENYWE6AXT12YDFDJKZ",
                            "name": "Pay Care and Treatment Costs for Injured Covered Species"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPTEM53MG569201GQDP8": {
                        "code": "COA 11.68.2",
                        "commitment": "Treatment of Seriously Injured GGS",
                        "name": "Document Injury Circumstances and Disposition in the Written Incident Report",
                        "text": "The circumstances of\nthe injury, the procedure followed, and the final disposition of the injured animal shall be\ndocumented in the written incident report as described in Condition of Approval 11.68.4).",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R7PYV1TN3PG7JYE8R1",
                            "name": "Report Covered Species Take or Injury to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPW6XCT9HBQQBPJGZ894": {
                        "code": "COA 11.68.3",
                        "commitment": "Handling of Recently Deceased GGS",
                        "name": "Bag, Label and Freeze a Recently Deceased GGS Carcass",
                        "text": "If the GGS is found recently deceased (as evidenced by lack of odor or\ndecomposition), the carcass shall be immediately bagged, labeled, and preserved in a freezer. The\nlabel shall include time and date, GPS location, circumstances surrounding death (if known), and\nITP tracking number. CDFW shall be consulted regarding specimen disposal.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPXZ8BZZ7N0NNT5MKQFM": {
                        "code": "COA 11.68.4",
                        "commitment": "Written Incident Report for GGS Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Send CDFW Written Incident Report Within Two Business Days",
                        "text": "Following initial notification, Permittee shall send CDFW a written\nincident report within two business days of the discovery. The report shall include the date and\ntime of the finding or incident, GPS location of the GGS, photographs of the location and the GGS,\ncircumstances around the cause of take or injury, and any other pertinent information. The report\nshall also be included in the Monthly Compliance Report (see Condition of Approval 10.12).",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R7PYV1TN3PG7JYE8R1",
                            "name": "Report Covered Species Take or Injury to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPZQ9NN9E3861M5F8KYS": {
                        "code": "COA 11.69",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Habitat Avoidance and Access Restrictions",
                        "name": "Confine Project Access and Vehicle Traffic to Existing Routes",
                        "text": "Project personnel shall access Project construction sites using existing routes and shall not cross\nSWHA habitat outside of or enroute to the Project construction site(s) unless otherwise approved by\nCDFW. Permittee shall restrict Project-related vehicle traffic to established roads, staging, and\nparking areas.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPZQ9NN9E3861M5F8KYT": {
                        "code": "COA 11.69",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Habitat Avoidance and Access Restrictions",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval Before Constructing New Off-Site Travel Routes",
                        "text": "Permittee shall contact CDFW for written approval if the Permittee determines\nconstruction of routes for travel is necessary outside of the Project construction area.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34X89RDDJZVZVMK8Y0P",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval to Construct Off-Site Travel Routes"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPZRHNZ4CD80HJSP67JN": {
                        "code": "COA 11.69",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Habitat Avoidance and Access Restrictions",
                        "name": "Confine Parking, Staging and Surface-Disturbing Activities to the Project Site",
                        "text": "Permittee shall\nconfine all Project-related parking, storage areas, laydown sites, equipment storage, and any other\nsurface-disturbing activities to the Project construction sites using, to the extent possible, previously\ndisturbed areas and as identified within the appropriate Project Phase Authorization Package\n(Condition of Approval 6.1 and 6.2).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMPZRHNZ4CD80HJSP67JP": {
                        "code": "COA 11.69",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Habitat Avoidance and Access Restrictions",
                        "name": "Apply Dust Control to Maintain Visibility for SWHA Monitoring",
                        "text": "Permittee shall implement dust control measures during Covered\nActivities to facilitate visibility for monitoring of SWHA by the Designated Biologist(s) and/or\nBiological Monitor(s).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQ1HMCQ78A08SGPE7Z0F": {
                        "code": "COA 11.70",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Nesting Season Work Restriction",
                        "name": "Restrict Work Near SWHA Nest Trees to Outside Nesting Season",
                        "text": "Permittee shall limit Covered Activities to occur only outside\nthe SWHA nesting season (February 28 – September 15), to the extent practicable.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQ1JCSNP3WDJZSP8BFSQ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.70",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Nesting Season Work Restriction",
                        "name": "Submit CDFW Approval Plan to Work During SWHA Nesting Season",
                        "text": "Permittee shall submit plans to initiate Covered Activities and minimize impacts to SWHA\nspecifically to CDFW for written approval prior to conducting any Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34YSP53SW383CFT2CZE",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval to Work During the SWHA Nesting Season"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQ3AH38XGY89WZCHJ04Q": {
                        "code": "COA 11.71",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Nest Tree Surveys and Survey Schedule",
                        "name": "Conduct and Submit Preconstruction SWHA Nest Tree Survey",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if needed) from the Biological Monitor(s) shall conduct\nCDFW approved SWHA survey protocols (Condition of Approval 11.38) to identify the presence of\nsuitable SWHA nest trees and known nest trees (occupied within one or more years of the past five\nyears) within 0.5 miles of each preconstruction activity site, SCADA, transmission line, and access\nroad sites, construction site, and postconstruction maintenance site, prior to initiation of any Covered…",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3Y008XT5YC8FTSZY6J7",
                            "name": "Conduct Preconstruction SWHA Nest Tree Survey"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQ3AH38XGY89WZCHJ04R": {
                        "code": "COA 11.71",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Nest Tree Surveys and Survey Schedule",
                        "name": "Conduct Recurring Annual SWHA Nest Surveys During Construction",
                        "text": "Subsequent survey efforts conducted during the Project construction phase(s) shall occur each year\nCovered Activities are expected to occur in SWHA habitat and shall be reported to CDFW by the\nPermittee within the Monthly Compliance Reporting (Condition of Approval 10.12) and summarized\nwithin each Annual Status Report (Condition of Approval 10.13).",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3Y008XT5YC8FTSZY6J6",
                            "name": "Conduct and Report Annual SWHA Nest Tree Surveys"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQ3BXJWY2RWRRD34QXXF": {
                        "code": "COA 11.71",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Nest Tree Surveys and Survey Schedule",
                        "name": "Map SWHA Nesting and Foraging Sites for CDFW",
                        "text": "Permittee shall map all existing or\npotential nesting or foraging sites and provide these maps to CDFW (see Condition of Approval 10.3).",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RA6HTPQEBMJTM46QTS",
                            "name": "Map and Submit Nesting, Foraging and Roosting Sites to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQ51T6HN61N27Z6H7119": {
                        "code": "COA 11.72",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Occupied Nest No-Disturbance Buffer",
                        "name": "Establish, Delineate and Maintain SWHA Nest Buffer",
                        "text": "Permittee, the Designated Biologist(s), and the Biological Monitor(s) shall ensure that no\nCovered Activities occur within 656 feet (200 m) of an occupied SWHA nest tree during the nesting\nseason by establishing a 656-foot-radius no-activity buffer around the occupied nest tree.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCR6",
                            "name": "Delineate and sign occupied nest and roost buffers"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQ52X2ZM48TYEMYHBH8F": {
                        "code": "COA 11.72",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Occupied Nest No-Disturbance Buffer",
                        "name": "Submit SWHA Nest Buffer Design and Location to CDFW",
                        "text": "The buffer\nzone design and location shall be submitted to CDFW for approval as part of the appropriate\nConstruction Phase Authorization Package.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34WE7XE98281ZXQVPK4",
                            "name": "Submit Buffer Zone Designs and Locations for CDFW Approval"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQ52X2ZM48TYEMYHBH8G": {
                        "code": "COA 11.72",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Occupied Nest No-Disturbance Buffer",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval to Reduce SWHA Nest Buffer Below 656 Feet",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not conduct any Covered Activity within\nthe 656-foot buffer unless a smaller buffer is approved in writing by CDFW, however, Permittee shall\nnot conduct any Covered Activity within, at minimum, 150 feet of an occupied nest tree.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34YSP53SW383CFT2CZF",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval of a Reduced SWHA Nest Buffer"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQ6TQEK3RDVYVY9E6ZBD": {
                        "code": "COA 11.73",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Nest Monitoring During Covered Activities",
                        "name": "Conduct and Report Baseline SWHA Nest Monitoring",
                        "text": "Five days and three days prior to the initiation of Covered Activities at any Project\nconstruction site where an occupied nest tree is within 0.5 miles of the Covered Activity, the\nDesignated Biologist(s) shall observe the occupied nest(s) for at least one hour or until nest\nstatus can be determined. The Designated Biologist(s) shall document nesting status and behaviors to compare to nesting status and behaviors after Covered Activities begin.\nPermittee shall report the results of…",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H41AKKXC7WAC4X6PQS",
                            "name": "Conduct and Report Preconstruction SWHA Nest Monitoring"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQ6VJGF0K1SVCFFN2SDK": {
                        "code": "COA 11.73",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Nest Monitoring During Covered Activities",
                        "name": "Monitor SWHA Nest Status at Tiered Distances During Construction",
                        "text": "Where an occupied nest tree occurs between 325 and 650 feet of Covered Activities, the\nDesignated Biologist(s) shall observe the nest for at least two hours per day during Covered\nActivities to ensure the SWHA are engaged in normal nesting behavior.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQ6VJGF0K1SVCFFN2SDM": {
                        "code": "COA 11.73",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Nest Monitoring During Covered Activities",
                        "name": "Limit Work to Daylight Hours Near Occupied SWHA Nest",
                        "text": "Permittee shall limit\nCovered Activities to between 30 minutes after sunrise and 30 minutes before sunset.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQ8J2FGTN88B9YQHXWNB": {
                        "code": "COA 11.74",
                        "commitment": "Disturbance of Occupied SWHA Nest Tree",
                        "name": "Prohibit Physical Contact With Occupied SWHA Nest Trees",
                        "text": "Permittee shall prohibit physical contact with an occupied nest tree throughout the breeding season\n(see Condition of Approval 11.70).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQ8KBKTZ8CC3BFJMZ4XG": {
                        "code": "COA 11.74",
                        "commitment": "Disturbance of Occupied SWHA Nest Tree",
                        "name": "Keep Break Areas and Idle Equipment Out of Nest Sightlines",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not designate any employee break, rest, or\nmeeting areas in proximity to active SWHA nests. All Project personnel within 656 feet shall be out of\nthe line of sight of the occupied nest tree during breaks, rests, or meeting areas unless prior approval\nhas been obtained in writing from CDFW. In consultation with the Designated Biologist(s), Permittee\nshall stage stationary, not in-use equipment outside of sight lines from the SWHA nests.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQABV7ZXHTW7CASVJ9Q5": {
                        "code": "COA 11.75",
                        "commitment": "Designated Biologist Authority for Distressed Nesting SWHA",
                        "name": "Stop Work and Notify Designated Representative of SWHA Distress",
                        "text": "If, during Covered Activities, the Designated Biologist(s) determine(s) that nesting SWHA within 0.5\nmiles of the Project construction site are exhibiting distress and/or abnormal nesting behavior from\nCovered Activities (swooping/stooping, excessive vocalization (e.g., distress calls), agitation, failure to\nremain on nest, failure to deliver prey items for an extended time period, failure to maintain nest,\netc.), the Designated Biologist(s) shall have the authority to stop Covered Activities…",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H41AKKXC7WAC4X6PQT",
                            "name": "Notify Designated Representative of SWHA Nest Distress"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQABV7ZXHTW7CASVJ9Q6": {
                        "code": "COA 11.75",
                        "commitment": "Designated Biologist Authority for Distressed Nesting SWHA",
                        "name": "Notify CDFW of SWHA Nesting Distress Within 24 Hours",
                        "text": "The Designated Representative shall contact CDFW\nwithin 24 hours to determine additional protective measures to be implemented.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RC1N589S9ETAS5HQJQ",
                            "name": "Notify CDFW of SWHA Nest Abandonment or Distress"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQABV7ZXHTW7CASVJ9Q7": {
                        "code": "COA 11.75",
                        "commitment": "Designated Biologist Authority for Distressed Nesting SWHA",
                        "name": "Continue Monitoring Until CDFW Confirms Normalized SWHA Behavior",
                        "text": "The Designated\nBiologist(s) shall: (1) Stop Covered Activities until additional protective measures are implemented; (2) Continue monitoring and ensure additional protective measures remain in place until the\nDesignated Biologist(s) in coordination with CDFW determines SWHA behavior has normalized; (3) Determine if additional protective measures are ineffective and stop Covered Activities until the\nadditional protective measures are modified; and (4) Continue monitoring until it has been…",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQACBHVMRN8J6HBT74MK": {
                        "code": "COA 11.75",
                        "commitment": "Designated Biologist Authority for Distressed Nesting SWHA",
                        "name": "Notify CDFW of SWHA Nest or Nestling Abandonment Within 24 Hours",
                        "text": "The Designated Representative or Designated Biologist shall notify CDFW within 24\nhours if nests or nestlings are abandoned and notify CDFW whether abandoned nestlings are\nstill alive.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RC1N589S9ETAS5HQJQ",
                            "name": "Notify CDFW of SWHA Nest Abandonment or Distress"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQACBHVMRN8J6HBT74MM": {
                        "code": "COA 11.75",
                        "commitment": "Designated Biologist Authority for Distressed Nesting SWHA",
                        "name": "Extend Nest Monitoring to Newly Discovered SWHA Nests",
                        "text": "If no occupied\nSWHA nests initially occur at or within 0.5 mile of the Project construction site, any discovery of nests\nshall trigger the monitoring and records required under this Condition of Approval as well as\nConditions of Approval 11.72, 11.73, and 11.74.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQC3YF21DBHG0A648TP7": {
                        "code": "COA 11.76",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Nest Tree Avoidance and Removal Approval",
                        "name": "Avoid Removal of Known and Suitable SWHA Nest Trees",
                        "text": "Permittee shall avoid removal of known SWHA nest trees and suitable\nnest trees to the maximum extent practicable.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQC449CBWAQ4AXX5Q7TB": {
                        "code": "COA 11.76",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Nest Tree Avoidance and Removal Approval",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval Before Removing a Known SWHA Nest Tree",
                        "text": "If a known nest tree must be removed for Covered\nActivities, Permittee shall notify and obtain written approval from CDFW. The notification shall\ninclude the location of the known nest tree, conditions to offset the loss of the nest tree, and the\ntiming of removal, which shall generally be September 16 – February 28.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34YSP53SW383CFT2CZG",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval to Remove or Trim a Known Nest Tree"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQC449CBWAQ4AXX5Q7TC": {
                        "code": "COA 11.76",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Nest Tree Avoidance and Removal Approval",
                        "name": "Prohibit Removal of Occupied SWHA Nest Trees Until Fledging",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not remove\nany occupied nest tree during nesting season, until the last young have left the nest, as verified by\nthe Designated Biologist(s).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQDVJ8AQ6Y0J5881DJ9D": {
                        "code": "COA 11.77",
                        "commitment": "Woody Vegetation Removal Outside SWHA Nesting Season",
                        "name": "Time Woody Vegetation Removal to September 16–February 28",
                        "text": "Permittee shall conduct removal of woody vegetation (trees and shrubs) only between September 16 - February 28 of any construction year to avoid impacts to nesting birds, unless preconstruction\nsurveys are conducted by the Designated Biologist(s) and recently used SWHA nests or active SWHA\nnests are determined to be absent from the trees and/or shrubs to be removed.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQDWQRXTGEXYK0XZGMD8": {
                        "code": "COA 11.77",
                        "commitment": "Woody Vegetation Removal Outside SWHA Nesting Season",
                        "name": "Notify CDFW of Nest Survey Results Before Vegetation Removal",
                        "text": "The Designated\nBiologist(s) shall notify CDFW of survey results prior to any vegetation removal.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RC1N589S9ETAS5HQJR",
                            "name": "Notify CDFW of Nest Survey Results Before Vegetation Removal"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQDWQRXTGEXYK0XZGMD9": {
                        "code": "COA 11.77",
                        "commitment": "Woody Vegetation Removal Outside SWHA Nesting Season",
                        "name": "Delineate and Avoid 656-Foot Buffer Around Active SWHA Nests",
                        "text": "If active or recently\nused SWHA nests are present, the Permittee shall not remove vegetation within 656 feet of SWHA\nnests. The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall delineate, flag, and avoid any\nactive nests until the nesting cycle is complete (refer to Condition of Approval 11.72).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCR6",
                            "name": "Delineate and sign occupied nest and roost buffers"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQFNFZT5HSCXF6R3A3F1": {
                        "code": "COA 11.78",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Nesting Habitat Delineation for Preconstruction Activities",
                        "name": "Delineate and Avoid SWHA Nesting Habitat at Preconstruction Sites",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall delineate suitable nesting habitat with\nflagging or other highly visible markers within each Project preconstruction site(s). Permittee shall\nrestrict preconstruction activities to areas outside of the delineated nesting habitat.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQFNFZT5HSCXF6R3A3F2": {
                        "code": "COA 11.78",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Nesting Habitat Delineation for Preconstruction Activities",
                        "name": "Schedule Preconstruction Field Investigations Outside Nesting Season",
                        "text": "Permittee shall conduct preconstruction activities such as field investigations outside of the nesting season to the\nmaximum extent practicable.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQFNFZT5HSCXF6R3A3F3": {
                        "code": "COA 11.78",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Nesting Habitat Delineation for Preconstruction Activities",
                        "name": "Survey for Nesting SWHA Before In-Season Field Investigations",
                        "text": "If such activities must occur during the nesting season, the Designated\nBiologist(s) shall survey the preconstruction activity site and within 0.5 miles for nesting SWHA.",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3Y008XT5YC8FTSZY6J8",
                            "name": "Conduct Nesting-Season SWHA Survey Before Field Investigations"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQFNFZT5HSCXF6R3A3F4": {
                        "code": "COA 11.78",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Nesting Habitat Delineation for Preconstruction Activities",
                        "name": "Keep Field Investigations 0.5 Miles From Occupied SWHA Nests",
                        "text": "Permittee shall limit field investigation activities to at least 0.5 miles away from any occupied nest\ntree, unless otherwise approved by CDFW in writing.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQHCTEMZ0TEGRQKFWZFT": {
                        "code": "COA 11.79",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Measures for SCADA and Transmission Line Work",
                        "name": "Prohibit Helicopter Line Stringing Near Occupied SWHA Nests",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not use helicopters to string SCADA or transmission lines within 0.5 miles of an\noccupied nest tree.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQHDSWYB94XYC24TQNXJ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.79",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Measures for SCADA and Transmission Line Work",
                        "name": "Prohibit Occupied Nest Tree Removal for Transmission Line Work",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not remove or trim occupied nest trees for transmission line\nconstruction until after the breeding season has ended and the last of the young have left the nest.\nPermittee shall not remove or trim occupied nest trees during transmission line maintenance.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQHDSWYB94XYC24TQNXK": {
                        "code": "COA 11.79",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Measures for SCADA and Transmission Line Work",
                        "name": "Remove or Trim an Occupied Nest Tree for Safety Per 11.77 or CDFW Approval",
