                        "text": "If\nremoval or trimming of an occupied nest tree needs to occur for human or wildlife safety, Permittee\nshall conduct removal or trimming consistent with Conditions of Approval 11.77, or otherwise with\nwritten approval and guidance from CDFW.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34YSP53SW383CFT2CZG",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval to Remove or Trim a Known Nest Tree"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQHDSWYB94XYC24TQNXM": {
                        "code": "COA 11.79",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Measures for SCADA and Transmission Line Work",
                        "name": "Avoid Nest Tree Removal During SCADA and Transmission Line Work",
                        "text": "Permittee shall avoid removal or trimming of known or\nsuitable nest trees, to the extent practicable, during SCADA and transmission line stringing and\nreconductoring activities and during power and pole placement.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQHDSWYB94XYC24TQNXN": {
                        "code": "COA 11.79",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Measures for SCADA and Transmission Line Work",
                        "name": "Site Poles and Lines Outside Suitable SWHA Nesting Habitat",
                        "text": "Where practicable, Permittee shall\nplace poles and lines outside of suitable nesting habitat, as delineated by the Designated Biologist(s).",
                        "type": "Design",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQK5KXEQT5D15EGCDHXJ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.80",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Mortality Reduction and Relocation Plan",
                        "name": "Develop and Submit SWHA Mortality Reduction and Relocation Plan",
                        "text": "Permittee shall develop a SWHA Mortality Reduction and Relocation Plan (SWHA Relocation Plan)\nand submit it to CDFW as part of the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization Package\n(Condition of Approval 6.2) prior to initiating Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NNJMTS3JZDQQZNRKEZ",
                            "name": "Submit SWHA Relocation Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQK69KMKHCS7SXAF6ZQ7": {
                        "code": "COA 11.80",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Mortality Reduction and Relocation Plan",
                        "name": "Restrict SWHA Capture and Handling to Qualified Designated Biologist",
                        "text": "SWHA\nshall only be captured and handled by the CDFW-approved Designated Biologist(s) with appropriate\nexpertise in handling raptors.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQMYFBJZP5GR352A38DG": {
                        "code": "COA 11.81",
                        "commitment": "Notification of SWHA Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Notify Designated Biologist of SWHA Take, Injury or Death",
                        "text": "Permittee shall immediately notify the Designated Biologist(s) if a SWHA is taken or injured by a\nCovered Activity, or if a SWHA is otherwise found dead or injured within the vicinity of the Project\npreconstruction activity site, construction site, or maintenance area.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R8HSR7K069ZM5EZCXP",
                            "name": "Notify the Designated Biologist of CBB, CTS or SWHA Take or Injury"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQMYFBJZP5GR352A38DH": {
                        "code": "COA 11.81",
                        "commitment": "Notification of SWHA Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Transport Injured SWHA to Rehabilitation Facility at Permittee's Cost",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) shall\nimmediately take the SWHA to a CDFW-approved wildlife rehabilitation or veterinary facility\nidentified in the SWHA Relocation Plan (see Condition of Approval 11.80) and contact the CDFW\nRepresentative, via email and telephone, within one business day to discuss the next steps. Permittee\nshall bear any costs associated with the care or treatment of such injured SWHA.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQMZAZ4ATFDENRZAYK0X": {
                        "code": "COA 11.81",
                        "commitment": "Notification of SWHA Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Notify CDFW Within 24 Hours of SWHA Nest Abandonment or Distress",
                        "text": "The Designated\nBiologist(s) shall immediately notify CDFW (within 24 hours) if nesting SWHA abandon the nest or\nexhibit distress and/or abnormal nesting behavior.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RC1N589S9ETAS5HQJQ",
                            "name": "Notify CDFW of SWHA Nest Abandonment or Distress"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQMZAZ4ATFDENRZAYK0Y": {
                        "code": "COA 11.81",
                        "commitment": "Notification of SWHA Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Provide Initial CDFW Notification With Event Details",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) or Designated\nRepresentative shall provide initial notification to CDFW by contacting the CDFW Representative. The\ninitial notification to CDFW shall include information regarding the location, species, date, and\ncircumstances of the event (e.g., time where the individual was found, number of animals taken or\ninjured, description of abnormal nesting behavior, etc.), the name of the facility where the animal\nwas taken if applicable, and the ITP Number.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R8HSR7K069ZM5EZCXM",
                            "name": "Report CBB, CTS and SWHA Take or Injury Incidents to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQMZAZ4ATFDENRZAYK0Z": {
                        "code": "COA 11.81",
                        "commitment": "Notification of SWHA Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Submit Written Incident Report to CDFW Within Two Business Days",
                        "text": "Following initial notification, Permittee shall send CDFW\na written incident report within two business days to the CDFW offices listed in the Notices section of\nthis ITP. The incident report shall include the date and time of the finding or incident, disposition of\nthe SWHA, location of the animal or carcass or the name of the facility where the animal was taken,\nany photographs of the animal or the site it was found, explanation as to cause of take, injury, or\nnesting disturbance, and any…",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R8HSR7K069ZM5EZCXM",
                            "name": "Report CBB, CTS and SWHA Take or Injury Incidents to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQPP346JX87DN02K8RWW": {
                        "code": "COA 11.82",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Avoidance and Daily Activity Window",
                        "name": "Restrict Work Hours Near Occupied TRBL Colony or Roost",
                        "text": "Permittee shall restrict Covered Activities to 45 minutes after sunrise and 45 minutes before sunset\nwhen Covered Activities occur within 1,300 feet of a breeding colony or roost site occupied by TRBL,\nunless otherwise approved by CDFW.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQPQTBPN9DN4Z6YVY3D8": {
                        "code": "COA 11.82",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Avoidance and Daily Activity Window",
                        "name": "Train Project Personnel on TRBL Avoidance and Buffer Protocols",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) shall train Project personnel on the required avoidance procedures, buffer zones, and protocols in the event that a TRBL flies into an\nactive Project construction site (i.e., outside the buffer zone), as part of the education program\ndescribed in Condition of Approval 9.4.",
                        "type": "Training & Education",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y40SJ78J9AJM2D416MYM",
                            "name": "Conduct Worker Education Program and Annual Refresher Training"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQPQTBPN9DN4Z6YVY3D9": {
                        "code": "COA 11.82",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Avoidance and Daily Activity Window",
                        "name": "Coordinate Timing of Disruptive Activities Away From Vulnerable TRBL Periods",
                        "text": "To the maximum extent feasible, Permittee shall coordinate\nwith the Designated Biologist(s) and CDFW to time the loudest or otherwise most disruptive Covered\nActivities outside periods where the TRBL, their nests/colony, their eggs, or their young are most\nvulnerable to disturbance.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQRFGZFYAMZ3JVECQ9GW": {
                        "code": "COA 11.83",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Preconstruction Habitat Assessment",
                        "name": "Conduct Baseline TRBL Habitat Assessment Each Project Phase",
                        "text": "Prior to the commencement of Covered Activities for each Project Phase, the Designated Biologist(s)\nshall conduct a habitat assessment consistent with CDFW-approved protocols (Condition of Approval 11.38) to determine if existing or potential nesting or foraging sites are present within the Project site\nand include areas within three miles of Project sites, where feasible. The preconstruction (i.e.,\nbaseline) assessment shall be completed during the breeding season (March 1 – September 15)…",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3Y008XT5YC8FTSZY6J9",
                            "name": "Conduct Baseline TRBL Habitat Assessment"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQRFGZFYAMZ3JVECQ9GX": {
                        "code": "COA 11.83",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Preconstruction Habitat Assessment",
                        "name": "Map and Submit Nesting/Foraging Sites in Phase Authorization Package",
                        "text": "Permittee shall map all existing or potential\nnesting or foraging sites and provide these maps to CDFW as part of the appropriate Phase\nAuthorization Package (see Condition of Approval 10.3). Nesting sites, including both currently\noccupied nesting sites and sites known to have been occupied within the last five years, shall be\nnoted on plans that are submitted as a part of a Phase Authorization Package (see Condition of\nApproval 6.1 and 6.2).",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RA6HTPQEBMJTM46QTS",
                            "name": "Map and Submit Nesting, Foraging and Roosting Sites to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQT7T8P4JGZD5SRSA4NQ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.84",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Nesting and Roosting Habitat Surveys",
                        "name": "Survey TRBL Habitat and Acquire Colony Data Before Any Covered Activities",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if needed) from the Biological Monitor(s) shall conduct\nCDFW approved TRBL survey protocols (Condition of Approval 11.38) to identify the presence of\nsuitable nesting habitat and roosting habitat, within each preconstruction activity site, SCADA,\ntransmission line and access road site, construction site, and maintenance area, prior to initiation of\nany Covered Activities. Permittee shall contact the UC Davis Tricolored Blackbird Portal Project…",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3Y008XT5YC8FTSZY6JA",
                            "name": "Conduct Preconstruction TRBL Habitat Survey"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQT8BHA58JZ110V53F5P": {
                        "code": "COA 11.84",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Nesting and Roosting Habitat Surveys",
                        "name": "Submit Preconstruction TRBL Survey Results to CDFW",
                        "text": "Permittee shall submit results of the preconstruction surveys to\nCDFW as part of the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.2) prior to initiating Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RA6HTPQEBMJTM46QTP",
                            "name": "Submit Preconstruction TRBL Survey Results to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQT8BHA58JZ110V53F5Q": {
                        "code": "COA 11.84",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Nesting and Roosting Habitat Surveys",
                        "name": "Conduct and Report Annual TRBL Surveys During Construction and Maintenance",
                        "text": "Subsequent survey efforts conducted during the Project\nconstruction phase(s) or maintenance shall occur each year Covered Activities are expected to occur\nin TRBL habitat and shall be reported to CDFW by the Permittee within the Monthly Compliance\nReporting (Condition of Approval 10.12) and summarized within each Annual Status Report\n(Condition of Approval 10.13).",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H41AKKXC7WAC4X6PQV",
                            "name": "Conduct Annual TRBL Survey During Construction"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQT8BHA58JZ110V53F5R": {
                        "code": "COA 11.84",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Nesting and Roosting Habitat Surveys",
                        "name": "Map and Provide TRBL Nesting/Roosting Sites to CDFW",
                        "text": "Permittee shall map all existing or potential nesting or roosting sites\nand provide these maps to CDFW (see Condition of Approval 10.3).",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RA6HTPQEBMJTM46QTS",
                            "name": "Map and Submit Nesting, Foraging and Roosting Sites to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQW0R26AHJ3VWDQJPY91": {
                        "code": "COA 11.84.1",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Nesting Habitat Preconstruction Surveys",
                        "name": "Conduct Seasonal Preconstruction Surveys for TRBL Breeding Colonies and Nesting Habitat",
                        "text": "Prior to the initiation of Covered Activities in a Project site and within\n1,300 feet of the Project site unless otherwise approved by CDFW, the Designated Biologist(s)\nwith assistance (if needed) from the Biological Monitor(s) shall conduct preconstruction surveys\nto evaluate the presence of TRBL breeding colonies and suitable nesting habitat. Surveys shall be\nconducted during the breeding season (March 1 – September 15) one year prior to, and then\nagain in the year of, the Covered Activities…",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3Y008XT5YC8FTSZY6JB",
                            "name": "Conduct Preconstruction TRBL Breeding-Colony Surveys"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQW1FAGP1AF7EGMEHEG6": {
                        "code": "COA 11.84.1",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Nesting Habitat Preconstruction Surveys",
                        "name": "Delineate Suitable Nesting Habitat and Breeding Colonies With Flagging",
                        "text": "The\nDesignated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall delineate suitable nesting habitat and\nbreeding colonies with flagging or other visible marking.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37DQ86DQQR0DMG43C04",
                            "name": "Delineate habitat, buffers, and construction site boundaries"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQXRJSFK7M57RNRQWDG6": {
                        "code": "COA 11.84.2",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Roosting Habitat Preconstruction Surveys",
                        "name": "Conduct Preconstruction Roosting Habitat Surveys During the Nonbreeding Season",
                        "text": "Prior to initiation of Covered Activities, including nighttime construction\nand postconstruction maintenance activities, in a Project construction site or Project\nmaintenance area and within 300 feet of a Project site, the Designated Biologist(s) with assistance\n(if needed) from the Biological Monitor(s) shall conduct preconstruction surveys to establish the\nexistence and use of roosting habitat by TRBL. Surveys shall be conducted during the nonbreeding\nseason (September 16 – February 28) one…",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3Y008XT5YC8FTSZY6JC",
                            "name": "Conduct Preconstruction TRBL Roosting-Habitat Surveys"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQXS2JVGD9Q9XY1WQM7E": {
                        "code": "COA 11.84.2",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Roosting Habitat Preconstruction Surveys",
                        "name": "Presume TRBL Occupancy for Unclearly Identified Mixed Blackbird Flocks",
                        "text": "Permittee shall consider roosting habitat occupied by\nlarge mixed blackbird flocks to be occupied by TRBL if the Designated Biologist(s) cannot clearly\nidentify TRBL absence within the flock.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQXS2JVGD9Q9XY1WQM7F": {
                        "code": "COA 11.84.2",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Roosting Habitat Preconstruction Surveys",
                        "name": "Check Previously Unoccupied Roost Sites for Later TRBL Occupancy",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if needed)\nfrom the Biological Monitor(s) shall check suitable roost sites within 300 feet of Project sites that\nare not occupied at the time of preconstruction surveys in accordance with the roosting survey\nprotocol approved by CDFW (Condition of Approval 11.38), to determine whether TRBL later\noccupies the roost site.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQXS2JVGD9Q9XY1WQM7G": {
                        "code": "COA 11.84.2",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Roosting Habitat Preconstruction Surveys",
                        "name": "Delineate Occupied TRBL Roost Sites With Flagging",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor shall delineate\noccupied roost sites with flagging or visible markings consistent with Condition of Approval 11.90.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37DQ86DQQR0DMG43C04",
                            "name": "Delineate habitat, buffers, and construction site boundaries"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQZHR8EPFQSHAHGWANV7": {
                        "code": "COA 11.85",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Nest Buffer Zone",
                        "name": "Avoid Suitable TRBL Nesting Habitat Within 1,300 Feet of Construction Sites",
                        "text": "Permittee shall ensure Covered Activities avoid suitable nesting habitat within 1,300 feet of Project\nconstruction sites to the extent practicable.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQZHR8EPFQSHAHGWANV8": {
                        "code": "COA 11.85",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Nest Buffer Zone",
                        "name": "Maintain a 1,300-Foot No-Activity Buffer Around an Unavoidable Active TRBL Colony",
                        "text": "If active nests are found within the Project construction\nsites or within 1,300 feet of any Covered Activity and cannot be avoided, Permittee shall ensure that\nCovered Activities do not occur within a 1,300-foot diameter no-activity buffer zone surrounding the\ncolony and associated suitable habitat during the breeding season (March 1 – September 15), until\nthe young have fledged, or when approved by CDFW.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQZJE9FTSQBMYW339TT7": {
                        "code": "COA 11.85",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Nest Buffer Zone",
                        "name": "Delineate the TRBL Colony No-Activity Buffer",
                        "text": "Permittee shall clearly delineate the buffered\narea using fencing or other high visibility marking. Permittee shall delineate TRBL colonies with\ndifferent materials than those used to delineate the Project construction site and maintain the\nfencing or markings through all weather events.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37DQ86DQQR0DMG43C04",
                            "name": "Delineate habitat, buffers, and construction site boundaries"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQZJE9FTSQBMYW339TT8": {
                        "code": "COA 11.85",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Nest Buffer Zone",
                        "name": "Reduce the TRBL Colony Buffer to 300 Feet With CDFW Approval Where Site Conditions Qualify",
                        "text": "The no-activity buffer zone may be reduced to a\nminimum of 300 feet, with written approval from CDFW, in areas with dense forest, buildings, or\nother features between the Covered Activities and the breeding colony; where there is topographic\nrelief to protect the colony from excessive noise or visual disturbance; or where sound curtains have\nbeen installed.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQZJE9FTSQBMYW339TT9": {
                        "code": "COA 11.85",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Nest Buffer Zone",
                        "name": "Reduce Disturbance When TRBL Colonizes Habitat Adjacent to Ongoing Activities",
                        "text": "If TRBL colonizes habitat adjacent to Covered Activities after they have been initiated,\nPermittee shall reduce the disturbance through establishment of no-activity buffers or sound curtains\nas determined in consultation with CDFW.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMQZJE9FTSQBMYW339TTA": {
                        "code": "COA 11.85",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Nest Buffer Zone",
                        "name": "Submit TRBL Buffer Zone Design and Location to CDFW for Approval",
                        "text": "The buffer zone design and location shall be submitted to\nCDFW for approval as part of the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization Package.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34WE7XE98281ZXQVPK4",
                            "name": "Submit Buffer Zone Designs and Locations for CDFW Approval"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMR1RKWTNP0T22SEAXRFG": {
                        "code": "COA 11.86",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Nest Buffer Monitoring",
                        "name": "Monitor an Active TRBL Colony Daily Through the Nesting Season",
                        "text": "If nesting TRBL is present within the Project construction site or within 1,300 feet of any Project-\nrelated Covered Activity, the Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if needed) from the Biological\nMonitor(s) shall monitor the colony daily for at least six hours per day throughout the nesting season\nto verify the Covered Activities are not disrupting the colony and to determine when the young have\nfledged, unless otherwise approved by CDFW. The Designated Biologist(s) will be on site daily…",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMR1SS863DF2A3NHG04CP": {
                        "code": "COA 11.86",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Nest Buffer Monitoring",
                        "name": "Prohibit Covered Activities Within the Nest Disturbance Buffer",
                        "text": "Work within\nthe nest disturbance buffer shall not be permitted.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMR1SS863DF2A3NHG04CQ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.86",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Nest Buffer Monitoring",
                        "name": "Stop Work When the Biologist Observes Colony Disruption and Agitated Behavior",
                        "text": "If the Designated Biologist determines that\nCovered Activities are disrupting the colony and TRBL are exhibiting agitated behavior, the\nDesignated Biologist(s) shall have the authority to stop Covered Activities until additional protective\nmeasures are implemented and the buffer size is increased to a distance necessary to result in no\nadverse impacts to the TRBL.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMR1SS863DF2A3NHG04CR": {
                        "code": "COA 11.86",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Nest Buffer Monitoring",
                        "name": "Notify CDFW Within 24 Hours of a Colony-Disruption Stop-Work Event",
                        "text": "The Permittee’s Designated Representative and/or Designated\nBiologist(s) shall notify CDFW within 24 hours (one calendar day) to determine additional protective\nmeasures to be implemented.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RC1N589S9ETAS5HQJS",
                            "name": "Notify CDFW of TRBL Colony or Roost Disturbance"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMR1SS863DF2A3NHG04CS": {
                        "code": "COA 11.86",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Nest Buffer Monitoring",
                        "name": "Maintain and Adjust Protective Measures Until TRBL Behavior Normalizes",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall continue\nmonitoring and ensure additional protective measures remain in place for the duration of the\nCovered Activities or until it is determined that TRBL behavior has normalized, as approved by CDFW.\nAdditional protective measures may include, but are not limited to, increasing the size of the buffer,\ndelaying Covered Activities until the colony is finished breeding and the young have fledged,\ntemporarily relocating staging…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMR1SS863DF2A3NHG04CT": {
                        "code": "COA 11.86",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Nest Buffer Monitoring",
                        "name": "Consult CDFW on At-Risk Colonies and Report Nest or Nestling Abandonment",
                        "text": "If the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) determines that the colonies are at risk, CDFW shall be immediately consulted to\ndetermine the best course of action to avoid nest abandonment or take of individuals. The\nDesignated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall notify CDFW within 24 hours (one calendar\nday) if nests or nestlings are abandoned. If the nestlings are still alive, the Designated Biologist(s)\nand/or Biological Monitor(s) shall work with CDFW to determine…",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RC1N589S9ETAS5HQJS",
                            "name": "Notify CDFW of TRBL Colony or Roost Disturbance"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMR3SD02F9Q3Y4KQ0XF8D": {
                        "code": "COA 11.87",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Roosting Site Buffer Zone",
                        "name": "Avoid Suitable TRBL Roosting Habitat and Its 300-Foot Buffer",
                        "text": "Permittee shall ensure Covered Activities avoid suitable roosting habitat and a surrounding buffer\narea of 300 feet to the extent practicable.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMR3TEAHJ2FGX74G0945J": {
                        "code": "COA 11.87",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Roosting Site Buffer Zone",
                        "name": "Maintain a 300-Foot No-Activity Buffer Around an Unavoidable Occupied TRBL Roost",
                        "text": "If occupied roosting habitat is found within the Project\nconstruction site, and the occupied roosting habitat cannot be avoided, Permittee shall not conduct\nCovered Activities within a 300-foot no-activity buffer surrounding the roost site (no-activity buffer).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMR3TEAHJ2FGX74G0945K": {
                        "code": "COA 11.87",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Roosting Site Buffer Zone",
                        "name": "Delineate the TRBL Roost No-Activity Buffer",
                        "text": "Permittee shall clearly delineate the buffered area using fencing or other high visibility marking.\nPermittee shall delineate TRBL roosting sites with different materials than those used to delineate\nthe Project construction site and maintain the fencing or markings throughout all weather events.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37DQ86DQQR0DMG43C04",
                            "name": "Delineate habitat, buffers, and construction site boundaries"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMR3TEAHJ2FGX74G0945M": {
                        "code": "COA 11.87",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Roosting Site Buffer Zone",
                        "name": "Modify the TRBL Roost Buffer Where Site Conditions Qualify, as CDFW Approves",
                        "text": "The no-activity buffer may be modified in areas with dense forest buildings, or other features\nbetween the Covered Activities and the occupied roost site; where there is sufficient topographic\nrelief to protect the roost site from excessive noise and visual disturbance; or where sound curtains\nare installed, as approved by CDFW.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMR3TEAHJ2FGX74G0945N": {
                        "code": "COA 11.87",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Roosting Site Buffer Zone",
                        "name": "Submit TRBL Roost Buffer Zone Design and Location to CDFW for Approval",
                        "text": "The buffer zone design and location shall be submitted to CDFW\nfor approval as part of the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization Package.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34WE7XE98281ZXQVPK4",
                            "name": "Submit Buffer Zone Designs and Locations for CDFW Approval"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMR5RJFQKVNDVNS5EKMCS": {
                        "code": "COA 11.88",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Roosting Site Buffer Monitoring",
                        "name": "Monitor Occupied Roost Sites Within the 300-Foot Buffer Daily",
                        "text": "Occupied roost sites that are within the 300 feet no-activity buffer (Condition of Approval 11.87)\nshall be monitored daily by the Designated Biologist(s), with assistance (if needed) from the Biological\nMonitor(s), for at least four hours each day or until the roost site is no longer occupied and consistent\nwith CDFW-approved TRBL survey protocol (Condition of Approval 11.38) to verify that Covered\nActivities are not disrupting roosting TRBL.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMR5SS20S0A1492D7DQY8": {
                        "code": "COA 11.88",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Roosting Site Buffer Monitoring",
                        "name": "Prohibit Covered Activities Within the Roosting Site",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not conduct Covered Activities within the\nroosting site.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMR5SS20S0A1492D7DQY9": {
                        "code": "COA 11.88",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Roosting Site Buffer Monitoring",
                        "name": "Implement Additional Protective Measures When Roosting TRBL Show Agitated Behavior",
                        "text": "If the Designated Biologist(s) determines that Covered Activities are disrupting roosting\nactivity and TRBL are exhibiting agitated behaviors, Permittee shall put additional protective\nmeasures in place until TRBL behavior normalizes. Additional protective measures may include, but\nare not limited to, increasing the size of the roosting site no-activity buffer, delaying Covered\nActivities until the flock has left the roost site or until the end of the nonbreeding season, temporarily\nrelocating…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMR5SS20S0A1492D7DQYA": {
                        "code": "COA 11.88",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Roosting Site Buffer Monitoring",
                        "name": "Contact CDFW When Roost Protective Measures Are Not Reducing Disruption",
                        "text": "Permittee and/or the Designated Biologist(s) shall contact CDFW if protective measures are\nnot effectively reducing disruption to the roost site to discuss alternative measures.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RC1N589S9ETAS5HQJS",
                            "name": "Notify CDFW of TRBL Colony or Roost Disturbance"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMR7QEP5R4JSR21MA31X4": {
                        "code": "COA 11.89",
                        "commitment": "Disturbance of TRBL Breeding Colonies and Roost Sites",
                        "name": "Prohibit Physical Contact With Active Breeding Colonies and Occupied Roost Sites",
                        "text": "Permittee shall prohibit physical contact with a breeding colony during the breeding season (March 1 – September 15) from the time of nest site selection until after the chicks have fledged or colony is\nno longer active, as determined by a Designated Biologist(s) and approved by CDFW. Permittee shall\nprohibit physical contact with an occupied roost site during the nonbreeding season (September 16 –\nFebruary 28).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMR7RQNJ6YETZAC5DFVV1": {
                        "code": "COA 11.89",
                        "commitment": "Disturbance of TRBL Breeding Colonies and Roost Sites",
                        "name": "Prohibit Personnel From Exiting Vehicles Inside an Occupied No-Activity Buffer",
                        "text": "Project personnel shall not exit vehicles when inside the established no-activity buffer\nfor breeding or roosting when TRBL are present (see Conditions of Approval 11.85 and 11.87).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMR7RQNJ6YETZAC5DFVV2": {
                        "code": "COA 11.89",
                        "commitment": "Disturbance of TRBL Breeding Colonies and Roost Sites",
                        "name": "Prohibit Employee Break, Rest, or Meeting Areas Within or Adjacent to No-Activity Buffers",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not designate any employee break, rest, or meeting areas adjacent to or within the\nno-activity nest and roosting buffers.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMR9PY8F1M7KPA6DD3DDE": {
                        "code": "COA 11.90",
                        "commitment": "Delineation of TRBL Nesting and Roosting Habitat",
                        "name": "Delineate TRBL Nesting/Roosting Habitat and Buffers",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall delineate suitable nesting and roosting\nhabitat and buffers with flagging or other highly visible marking at Project sites for preconstruction\nactivities, construction staging areas, SCADA, transmission line, and access road construction and\nmaintenance sites.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37DQ86DQQR0DMG43C04",
                            "name": "Delineate habitat, buffers, and construction site boundaries"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMR9QBX9TQPQ3P8MZR8Z5": {
                        "code": "COA 11.90",
                        "commitment": "Delineation of TRBL Nesting and Roosting Habitat",
                        "name": "Restrict Activities Outside Delineated Habitat/Buffers",
                        "text": "Permittee shall restrict these Covered Activities to Project Sites outside of the\ndelineated habitat. Permittee shall prohibit conduct of Covered Activities within no-activity buffers\nestablished for breeding colonies or occupied roost sites (see Conditions of Approval 11.85 and\n11.87).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRBEZBF5C77H3XMSSWQK": {
                        "code": "COA 11.91",
                        "commitment": "Helicopter Restrictions Near TRBL Colonies and Roosts",
                        "name": "Maintain Helicopter Distance/Time Buffers Near TRBL Sites",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not use helicopters to string SCADA or transmission lines within 200 horizontal feet or\n150 vertical feet of breeding colonies or occupied roost sites unless the helicopter is small enough to\nonly cause a down draft of 15 to 18 miles per hour at up to 150 feet. Permittee shall only operate\nhelicopters at these distances from the breeding colony or occupied roost site for up to three\nminutes in duration, no more than twice per day, with a minimum of four hours between…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRBEZBF5C77H3XMSSWQM": {
                        "code": "COA 11.91",
                        "commitment": "Helicopter Restrictions Near TRBL Colonies and Roosts",
                        "name": "Restrict Helicopter Use to Daylight Hours",
                        "text": "Helicopters shall not be used\nbetween 45 minutes before sunset to 45 minutes after sunrise.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRD7GNZNESZEXHQR204D": {
                        "code": "COA 11.92",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Mortality Reduction and Relocation Plan",
                        "name": "Prepare and Submit TRBL Mortality/Relocation Plan",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) shall prepare a TRBL Mortality Reduction and Relocation Plan (TRBL\nRelocation Plan) and submit it to CDFW as part of the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization\nPackage prior to commencing Covered Activities (Condition of Approval 6.2).",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NNJMTS3JZDQQZNRKF0",
                            "name": "Submit TRBL Relocation Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRD7GNZNESZEXHQR204E": {
                        "code": "COA 11.92",
                        "commitment": "TRBL Mortality Reduction and Relocation Plan",
                        "name": "Restrict TRBL Handling to CDFW-Approved Biologist",
                        "text": "Only the CDFW-approved Designated Biologist(s) with appropriate expertise in\nhandling blackbirds shall handle and relocate TRBL.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRF0PJK8JBTHZN7TQKZ0": {
                        "code": "COA 11.93",
                        "commitment": "Notification of TRBL Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Notify Designated Biologist of TRBL Take or Injury",
                        "text": "Permittee shall immediately notify the Designated Biologist(s) if TRBL is taken by a Covered Activity,\nor if a TRBL is otherwise found dead or injured within the vicinity of the Project preconstruction\nactivity, construction site, or maintenance area.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R8HSR7K069ZM5EZCXN",
                            "name": "Notify the Designated Biologist of Covered Species Take or Injury"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRF0PJK8JBTHZN7TQKZ1": {
                        "code": "COA 11.93",
                        "commitment": "Notification of TRBL Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Transport Injured TRBL to Approved Care Facility",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) shall immediately take\nthe injured TRBL to a CDFW-approved wildlife rehabilitation or veterinary facility identified in the\nTRBL Relocation Plan (see Condition of Approval 11.92)",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },

                        "text": "contact the CDFW Representative, via\nemail and telephone, within one business day to discuss the next steps.",

                        "commitment": "Notification of TRBL Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Bear Costs of Injured TRBL Care and Treatment",
                        "text": "Permittee shall bear any\ncosts associated with the care or treatment of such injured TRBL.",
                        "type": "Financial",
                        "actions": [

                        "code": "COA 11.93",
                        "commitment": "Notification of TRBL Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Notify CDFW of TRBL Nest/Colony Abandonment or Distress",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) shall\nimmediately notify CDFW (within 24 hours) if TRBL abandon their nests or nestlings are abandoned,\nor nesting or roosting colonies exhibit distress and/or abnormal nesting behavior. The Designated\nBiologist(s) or Permittee’s Designated Representative shall provide initial notification to the CDFW\nRepresentative. The initial notification to CDFW shall include information regarding the location,\nspecies, date, and circumstances of the event (e.g., time where the…",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RC1N589S9ETAS5HQJT",
                            "name": "Notify CDFW of TRBL Nest or Colony Abandonment or Distress"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRF1YW0VN6WV9VMY07ZT": {
                        "code": "COA 11.93",
                        "commitment": "Notification of TRBL Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Submit Written TRBL Incident Report to CDFW",
                        "text": "Following initial notification,\nPermittee shall submit to CDFW a written incident report within two business days to the CDFW\noffices listed in the Notices section of this ITP. The report shall include the date and time of the\nfinding or incident, disposition of the TRBL, location of the animal or carcass or name of facility where\nthe animal was taken, any photographs of the animal or the site it was found, explanation as to cause\nof take, injury, or nesting disturbance, and any other pertinent…",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R7PYV1TN3PG7JYE8R1",
                            "name": "Report Covered Species Take or Injury to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRGSKR1G03BPM15TBD1Q": {
                        "code": "COA 11.94",
                        "commitment": "CBB Habitat Avoidance and Nest Encounter Response",
                        "name": "Avoid CBB Habitat and Confine Ground Disturbance Footprint",
                        "text": "Identified and delineated suitable CBB habitat in accordance with Condition of Approval 10.4 shall be\ncompletely avoided. Permittee shall conduct Covered Activities within paved roads, farm roads, road\nshoulders, and similarly previously disturbed and compacted areas to the greatest extent practicable.\nWhere it is not possible to conduct Covered Activities in already disturbed areas, Permittee shall\nconfine ground disturbance and habitat removal to the most minimal area necessary as…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRGSKR1G03BPM15TBD1R": {
                        "code": "COA 11.94",
                        "commitment": "CBB Habitat Avoidance and Nest Encounter Response",
                        "name": "Halt Activities Within 50 ft of a Discovered CBB Nest",
                        "text": "If\nProject personnel observe CBB or an insect resembling CBB entering or exiting a potential nest, or a\nCBB nest site, Permittee shall prohibit Covered Activities within a 50-foot radius of that nest until the\nDesignated Biologist(s) is contacted and on-site (see Condition of Approval 11.98).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRGT715YPPHA107T5SGN": {
                        "code": "COA 11.94",
                        "commitment": "CBB Habitat Avoidance and Nest Encounter Response",
                        "name": "Relocate Unavoidable CBB Nest via Designated Biologist",
                        "text": "If the Covered\nActivities cannot avoid the nest, only the Designated Biologist(s) shall relocate the nest in accordance\nwith Condition of Approval 11.102.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37TC7ZSR7P81QYD2THA",
                            "name": "Obtain agency approval of designated wildlife handlers"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRGT715YPPHA107T5SGP": {
                        "code": "COA 11.94",
                        "commitment": "CBB Habitat Avoidance and Nest Encounter Response",
                        "name": "Report CBB Sightings to the Designated Biologist",
                        "text": "All Project personnel shall inform the Designated Biologist(s) if\nthey encounter CBB or an insect resembling CBB, within the Project construction site or 50 feet\nbeyond the Project construction site, during all phases of Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R8HSR7K069ZM5EZCXQ",
                            "name": "Report CBB Sightings to the Designated Biologist"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRJKAVP3AM4PZ3QNZ2YG": {
                        "code": "COA 11.95",
                        "commitment": "CBB Seasonal Restriction on Vegetation and Ground Disturbance",
                        "name": "Avoid Vegetation/Ground Disturbance During Colony Active Period",
                        "text": "If feasible, Covered Activities shall avoid vegetation and ground disturbing impacts to CBB and\nsuitable habitat during the Colony Active Period (February 1 – October 31) each year until the\nexpiration of this ITP unless otherwise approved by CDFW after the Designated Biologist(s) has\nconducted CBB surveys (see Condition of Approval 11.97) consistent with CDFW-approved protocols\n(Condition of Approval 11.38). Any work within the Colony Active Period shall be subject to approval\nby CDFW.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRJMEXEW0QW3QQMZJ1HA": {
                        "code": "COA 11.95",
                        "commitment": "CBB Seasonal Restriction on Vegetation and Ground Disturbance",
                        "name": "Time Flowering Vegetation Removal Outside Colony Active Period",
                        "text": "Native or non-native flowering vegetation removal shall occur prior to bloom and before\nthe Colony Active Period to prevent colonization during the active season. If Covered Activities\ncannot be avoided in temporary impact areas intended for on-site restoration during this time and\nvegetation needs to be removed during the bloom period for these species, Permittee shall remove\nflowering vegetation during the Colony Active Period in locations where there are no surveyed\nforaging CBB or active…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRJMEXEW0QW3QQMZJ1HB": {
                        "code": "COA 11.95",
                        "commitment": "CBB Seasonal Restriction on Vegetation and Ground Disturbance",
                        "name": "Avoid Vegetation/Ground Disturbance During Flight Seasons",
                        "text": "Permittee shall avoid conducting Covered Activities involving vegetation and ground disturbance in\nCBB habitat during the Queen and Gyne Flight Seasons, when Queens emerge in the spring searching\nfor nest sites, and during the fall flight period when Gynes mate and search for overwintering habitat.\nThese time periods shift each year due to climatic conditions (drought, temperature, and\nprecipitation).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRJMEXEW0QW3QQMZJ1HC": {
                        "code": "COA 11.95",
                        "commitment": "CBB Seasonal Restriction on Vegetation and Ground Disturbance",
                        "name": "Survey Annually to Set Flight Season Dates",
                        "text": "To determine these time periods each year, the Designated Biologist(s) shall conduct\nCDFW-approved CBB surveys (Condition of Approval 11.38).",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3Y008XT5YC8FTSZY6JD",
                            "name": "Conduct Annual CBB Flight Season Surveys"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRJMEXEW0QW3QQMZJ1HD": {
                        "code": "COA 11.95",
                        "commitment": "CBB Seasonal Restriction on Vegetation and Ground Disturbance",
                        "name": "Avoid Ground Disturbance During Overwintering Period",
                        "text": "During the overwintering period, Permittee shall avoid ground disturbance activities in CBB habitat to\nthe greatest extent possible or develop a site-specific phased approach to implementation of\nactivities, for CDFW approval as part of the appropriate Project Construction Phase Authorization\nPackage (Condition of Approval 6.2).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRJMEXEW0QW3QQMZJ1HE": {
                        "code": "COA 11.95",
                        "commitment": "CBB Seasonal Restriction on Vegetation and Ground Disturbance",
                        "name": "Inspect and Supervise Overwintering Refugia Removal",
                        "text": "During this time, removal of fallen logs, brush piles, woody debris, and other potential refugia for overwintering bees shall be done carefully with prior\ninspection and then supervision from the Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if needed) from the\nBiological Monitor(s).",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRMD5X4C2ZD982W42P4T": {
                        "code": "COA 11.96",
                        "commitment": "CBB Preconstruction Habitat Assessment",
                        "name": "Conduct Preconstruction CBB Habitat Assessment Survey",
                        "text": "Prior to initiation of ground disturbing Covered Activities for each Project Phase, site-level surveys\nshall be conducted consistent with CDFW-approved survey protocols (Condition of Approval 11.38) to\ndetermine whether CBB is present within or adjacent to proposed Covered Activities and submitted\nto CDFW as part of the appropriate Construction Phased Authorization Package (Condition of\nApproval 6.2).",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3Y008XT5YC8FTSZY6JE",
                            "name": "Conduct Preconstruction CBB Habitat Survey"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRP89YS91R7CZY0S628H": {
                        "code": "COA 11.97",
                        "commitment": "CBB Surveys During Construction and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Conduct Pre-Activity CBB Surveys During Construction/Maintenance",
                        "text": "During the Project construction and postconstruction maintenance phases, surveys shall be\nconducted by the Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if needed) from the Biological Monitor(s)\nfollowing the CDFW-approved CBB survey protocol (Condition of Approval 11.38) prior to any\nground-disturbing Covered Activities or vegetation removal within suitable CBB habitat during the\ncolony active period (February 1 – October 31) or until all flowering vegetation is largely desiccated,\nto detect…",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3Y008XT5YC8FTSZY6JF",
                            "name": "Conduct Pre-Activity CBB Foraging and Nest Surveys"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRP9RKKF3TK57F7V1ARZ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.97",
                        "commitment": "CBB Surveys During Construction and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Notify CDFW of a CBB Detection Within 24 Hours",
                        "text": "If a suspected or confirmed CBB is identified during any of\nthese surveys, the Designated Biologist(s) shall notify CDFW within 24 hours.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RC1N589S9ETAS5HQJV",
                            "name": "Notify CDFW of a CBB Detection"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRP9RKKF3TK57F7V1AS0": {
                        "code": "COA 11.97",
                        "commitment": "CBB Surveys During Construction and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Report Survey Results in Compliance and Status Reports",
                        "text": "The three survey efforts\nconducted during the Project construction phase(s) shall occur each year Covered Activities are\nexpected to occur in suitable CBB habitat and shall be reported to CDFW by the Permittee within the\nMonthly Compliance Reporting (Condition of Approval 10.12) and summarized within each Annual\nStatus Report (Condition of Approval 10.13).",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R99JZNVA7RWDTVTCW3",
                            "name": "Report Construction-Phase CBB and MALI Survey Results"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRR1S26EXFBWQDFTE588": {
                        "code": "COA 11.98",
                        "commitment": "CBB Nest No-Activity Buffer Zone",
                        "name": "Enforce No-Activity Buffer Around Discovered CBB Nest",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not conduct any Covered Activity within the buffer unless a smaller\nbuffer is approved by CDFW.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRR1S26EXFBWQDFTE589": {
                        "code": "COA 11.98",
                        "commitment": "CBB Nest No-Activity Buffer Zone",
                        "name": "Submit CBB Buffer Zone Design Plan to CDFW",
                        "text": "A CBB buffer zone design plan shall be submitted to CDFW as part of the\nappropriate Phase Authorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.2).",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NPMSXZQMQNBGV7AENG",
                            "name": "Submit CBB Buffer Zone Design Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRR1S26EXFBWQDFTE58A": {
                        "code": "COA 11.98",
                        "commitment": "CBB Nest No-Activity Buffer Zone",
                        "name": "Delineate and Maintain CBB Nest Buffer Marking",
                        "text": "Utilizing this plan, the buffer\nshall be delineated using high-visibility fencing, flagging, or similar materials along with appropriate\nsignage and be maintained throughout all weather events.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37DQ86DQQR0DMG43C04",
                            "name": "Delineate habitat, buffers, and construction site boundaries"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRR1S26EXFBWQDFTE58B": {
                        "code": "COA 11.98",
                        "commitment": "CBB Nest No-Activity Buffer Zone",
                        "name": "Report GPS-Recorded Nest Location to CDFW Within 24 Hours",
                        "text": "The nest location shall be recorded with\nglobal positioning system (GPS) and be reported to CDFW within 24 hours (one calendar day) of\nfinding the nest.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R8HSR7K069ZM5EZCXT",
                            "name": "Report GPS-Recorded CBB Nest and MALI Locations to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRSSQJYJZ5K02FM5E253": {
                        "code": "COA 11.99",
                        "commitment": "CBB Daily Monitoring",
                        "name": "Survey Undisturbed CBB Habitat Before Activities Begin",
                        "text": "In undisturbed areas of CBB habitat planned for Covered Activities, the Designated Biologist(s) shall\nperform CDFW-approved CBB survey protocols with assistance from the Biological Monitor(s) (if\nneeded) as described in Condition of Approval 11.38.",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3Y008XT5YC8FTSZY6JF",
                            "name": "Conduct Pre-Activity CBB Foraging and Nest Surveys"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRSSQJYJZ5K02FM5E254": {
                        "code": "COA 11.99",
                        "commitment": "CBB Daily Monitoring",
                        "name": "Conduct Daily Visual Sweeps for CBB Flight Activity",
                        "text": "Once Covered Activities within CBB habitat\nhave begun, the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall be onsite and shall conduct\ndaily visual sweeps of the Project construction site for CBB flight activity at the start of the daily work\nwindow and shall intermittently repeat these visual sweeps throughout the daily work window.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRSTR9HY12WTKKXTH440": {
                        "code": "COA 11.99",
                        "commitment": "CBB Daily Monitoring",
                        "name": "Notify CDFW of a CBB Detection Within 24 Hours",
                        "text": "If a\nsuspected or confirmed CBB is detected in the Project construction site, the Designated\nRepresentative or Designated Biologist(s) shall contact CDFW by telephone and email within 24 hours.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RC1N589S9ETAS5HQJV",
                            "name": "Notify CDFW of a CBB Detection"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRSTR9HY12WTKKXTH441": {
                        "code": "COA 11.99",
                        "commitment": "CBB Daily Monitoring",
                        "name": "Search for Active Nest After a CBB Detection",
                        "text": "If a suspected or confirmed CBB individual is detected within the Project construction site,\nevery effort shall be made by the Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if needed) from the\nBiological Monitor(s) to find the active nest.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRVHH73JMGM6XG5397KC": {
                        "code": "COA 11.100",
                        "commitment": "Avoidance or Treatment of CBB Underground Refugia",
                        "name": "Avoid and Buffer Underground CBB Refugia",
                        "text": "Permittee shall establish a 50-foot radius no-activity buffer around refugia that can be avoided\nwithin the Project preconstruction activity area, construction site, access roads, SCADA and\ntransmission line construction areas, and maintenance areas.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRVJYG082T0SAE12EZMA": {
                        "code": "COA 11.100",
                        "commitment": "Avoidance or Treatment of CBB Underground Refugia",
                        "name": "Hold Refugia Vegetation Removal Until Overwintering Absence Confirmed",
                        "text": "Within potential habitat, Permittee\nshall avoid removal of vegetation such as woody plants, tall grasses, leaf litter or loose soils until\nCDFW-approved CBB survey protocols (Condition of Approval 11.38) have been performed by the\nDesignated Biologist(s) and absence of overwintering CBB is confirmed.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRVJYG082T0SAE12EZMB": {
                        "code": "COA 11.100",
                        "commitment": "Avoidance or Treatment of CBB Underground Refugia",
                        "name": "Flag Refugia and Habitat Features Before Earthmoving",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s)\nshall flag these areas, or other habitat features that are outside of the area for direct ground\ndisturbance within the Project construction site prior to initiation of earthmoving activities in those\nareas.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37DQ86DQQR0DMG43C04",
                            "name": "Delineate habitat, buffers, and construction site boundaries"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRVJYG082T0SAE12EZMC": {
                        "code": "COA 11.100",
                        "commitment": "Avoidance or Treatment of CBB Underground Refugia",
                        "name": "Repeat CBB Survey After a 14-Day Work Stoppage",
                        "text": "If Covered Activities stop for\nmore than 14 calendar days, the Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if needed) from the\nBiological Monitor(s) shall repeat CBB surveys within suitable CBB habitat, prior to resuming Covered\nActivities.",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3Y008XT5YC8FTSZY6JF",
                            "name": "Conduct Pre-Activity CBB Foraging and Nest Surveys"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRX9BT746KPVF13B0RAP": {
                        "code": "COA 11.101",
                        "commitment": "Vegetation Management in CBB Habitat",
                        "name": "Minimize Vegetation Disturbance in CBB Habitat",
                        "text": "Disturbance or removal of vegetation shall be kept to the minimum necessary to complete Covered\nActivities in suitable CBB habitat.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRXA7VFWYRC008ABK23F": {
                        "code": "COA 11.101",
                        "commitment": "Vegetation Management in CBB Habitat",
                        "name": "Hand-Trim Protected Vegetation Only",
                        "text": "Vegetation marked for protection shall only be trimmed with hand\ntools limited to string trimmers (e.g., weed whackers) to gain access to work sites unless otherwise\napproved by CDFW.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRXA7VFWYRC008ABK23G": {
                        "code": "COA 11.101",
                        "commitment": "Vegetation Management in CBB Habitat",
                        "name": "Set Mower Blade Height to Four Inches Minimum",
                        "text": "Permittee shall set mower blade heights to no lower than four inches, unless\notherwise approved by CDFW in writing (See Condition of Approval 11.18).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRZ181JYEY65HZ6AD84A": {
                        "code": "COA 11.102",
                        "commitment": "CBB Nest Relocation Plan",
                        "name": "Halt Work Within 50-Foot CBB Nest Buffer",
                        "text": "Permittee shall stop Covered Activities within 50 feet of\nthe nest until the nest senesces or becomes inactive and is no longer in use, as determined by the\nDesignated Biologist(s) in consultation with CDFW.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRZ2SQA04DKYQWZHN3NX": {
                        "code": "COA 11.102",
                        "commitment": "CBB Nest Relocation Plan",
                        "name": "Develop and Submit CBB Nest Relocation Plan",
                        "text": "Permittee shall develop a CBB Nest\nRelocation Plan (CBB Plan) and submit it to CDFW as part of the appropriate Construction Phase\nAuthorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.2) prior to initiating Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NK6K0BZ6XYWCKNWKMT",
                            "name": "Submit CBB Nest Relocation Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRZ2SQA04DKYQWZHN3NY": {
                        "code": "COA 11.102",
                        "commitment": "CBB Nest Relocation Plan",
                        "name": "Relocate Unavoidable CBB Nest as Last Resort",
                        "text": "The CDFW-\napproved Designated Biologist(s) with appropriate expertise in bumble bee capture and handling\nshall attempt to relocate the nest to a suitable location outside of the Project construction site\nfollowing guidance from CDFW.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37TC7ZSR7P81QYD2THA",
                            "name": "Obtain agency approval of designated wildlife handlers"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRZ2SQA04DKYQWZHN3NZ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.102",
                        "commitment": "CBB Nest Relocation Plan",
                        "name": "Monitor Relocated CBB Nest for One Week",
                        "text": "Once relocated, the nest shall be monitored\nfor at least one week by the Designated Biologist(s).",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMRZ2SQA04DKYQWZHN3P0": {
                        "code": "COA 11.102",
                        "commitment": "CBB Nest Relocation Plan",
                        "name": "Notify CDFW Within 24 Hours of Potential Nest Loss",
                        "text": "CDFW shall be contacted\nimmediately (within 24 hours) to determine next steps.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RC1N589S9ETAS5HQJW",
                            "name": "Notify CDFW of Potential CBB Nest Loss"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMS0T2RSRJA03WEQSCC33": {
                        "code": "COA 11.103",
                        "commitment": "Notification of CBB Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Immediately Notify Biologist of CBB Take or Mortality",
                        "text": "Permittee shall immediately notify the Designated Biologist(s) if CBB is taken by a Covered Activity, or\nif a CBB is otherwise found dead or injured within the vicinity of the Project preconstruction activity,\nconstruction site, or maintenance area.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R8HSR7K069ZM5EZCXP",
                            "name": "Notify the Designated Biologist of CBB, CTS or SWHA Take or Injury"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMS0T2RSRJA03WEQSCC34": {
                        "code": "COA 11.103",
                        "commitment": "Notification of CBB Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Provide Initial CDFW Notice of CBB Take Within 1 Day",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) or Permittee’s Designated\nRepresentative shall provide initial notification to the CDFW Representative within one business day\nof finding the injured or killed CBB.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R8HSR7K069ZM5EZCXM",
                            "name": "Report CBB, CTS and SWHA Take or Injury Incidents to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMS0VRXQZQ44TNN5TJ4N0": {
                        "code": "COA 11.103",
                        "commitment": "Notification of CBB Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Submit Written CBB Incident Report Within 2 Days",
                        "text": "Permittee shall send CDFW a written incident report within two business days to the CDFW offices listed in the Notices section of this ITP.",
