                      "req_01M2ESMS0VRXQZQ44TNN5TJ4N1": {
                        "code": "COA 11.103",
                        "commitment": "Notification of CBB Take or Injury",
                        "name": "Salvage and Label CBB Carcass for CDFW Lab",
                        "text": "The carcass shall be photographed, salvaged, and placed in a labeled,\nclean plastic, resealable bag or vial and stored in a freezer by the Designated Biologist(s) for shipment\nto CDFW Wildlife Health Lab.",
                        "type": "Other",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMS2J8K75A6BFAQ1C7V5H": {
                        "code": "COA 11.104",
                        "commitment": "MALI Initial Site Clearing and Monitoring",
                        "name": "Confine MALI Ground Disturbance to Minimal Footprint",
                        "text": "Permittee shall confine ground disturbance activities that could result in take of MALI to the minimal\narea necessary to conduct Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []

                        "code": "COA 11.104",
                        "commitment": "MALI Initial Site Clearing and Monitoring",
                        "name": "Station Biologist Onsite Daily During Initial Ground Disturbance",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) shall be onsite each day\nduring initial ground disturbing activities to assess the Project construction site and no-activity buffer\n(Condition of Approval 11.106).",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMS2KJG72AVTFC3R8HHR4": {

                        "name": "Monitor Covered Activities in Suitable MALI Habitat",

                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMS2KJG72AVTFC3R8HHR5": {
                        "code": "COA 11.104",
                        "commitment": "MALI Initial Site Clearing and Monitoring",
                        "name": "Stop Work Pending MALI Translocation Upon Discovery",
                        "text": "If MALI is discovered within the Project construction site, the Designated\nBiologist(s) and or Biological Monitor(s) shall have the authority to stop Covered Activities until the\nplant is translocated to suitable habitat outside of the Project footprint in accordance with Condition\nof Approval 11.108.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMS4B6RKD5GF8X6CCJ5FR": {

                        "commitment": "MALI Preconstruction Surveys",
                        "name": "Conduct Preconstruction MALI Floristic Survey",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if needed) from the Biological Monitor(s) shall conduct\npreconstruction surveys consistent with CDFW-approved protocols (Condition of Approval 11.38) to\nidentify the presence of MALI and suitable MALI habitat within all Project sites and a 100-foot buffer\naround each Project site, unless otherwise approved by CDFW.",

                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3XZ7WK0185QGKR0185Y",
                            "name": "Conduct Preconstruction MALI Survey"
                          }
                        ]
                      },

                        "code": "COA 11.105",
                        "commitment": "MALI Preconstruction Surveys",
                        "name": "Submit MALI Survey Results for CDFW Approval",
                        "text": "Permittee shall submit the preconstruction survey\nresults to CDFW as part of the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization Package (Condition of\nApproval 6.2) for written approval prior to initiating Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [

                            "name": "Submit Preconstruction Survey Results for CDFW Approval"

                        ]

                        "name": "Repeat MALI Surveys Each Year in Suitable Habitat",
                        "text": "Subsequent survey efforts\nconducted during the Project construction phase(s) shall occur each year Covered Activities are\nexpected to occur in MALI habitat",

                        "code": "COA 11.105",
                        "commitment": "MALI Preconstruction Surveys",
                        "name": "Report MALI Survey Results Monthly and Annually",
                        "text": "shall be reported to CDFW by the Permittee within the\nMonthly Compliance Reporting (Condition of Approval 10.12) and summarized within each Annual\nStatus Report (Condition of Approval 10.13).",

                            "name": "Report Construction-Phase CBB and MALI Survey Results"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMS63S5TJRSKN2D93XX9M": {

                      "req_01M2ESMS63S5TJRSKN2D93XX9N": {
                        "code": "COA 11.106",
                        "commitment": "MALI No-Activity Buffer Zone",
                        "name": "Establish 100-Foot No-Activity Buffer Around MALI",
                        "text": "Permittee shall establish a 100-foot no-activity buffer zone at least ten feet from the edge of\nthe suitable habitat until Covered Activities in the area are completed. If a 100-foot no-activity buffer\nis not feasible, Permittee may reduce the no-activity zone to a minimum of 50 feet from the edge of\nthe suitable habitat with CDFW written approval.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMS63S5TJRSKN2D93XX9P": {
                        "code": "COA 11.106",
                        "commitment": "MALI No-Activity Buffer Zone",
                        "name": "Delineate MALI Buffer With High-Visibility Materials",
                        "text": "The buffer shall be delineated using high-visibility\nsilt fencing, flagging, or similar materials along with appropriate signage.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",

                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37DQ86DQQR0DMG43C04",

                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMS63S5TJRSKN2D93XX9Q": {
                        "code": "COA 11.106",
                        "commitment": "MALI No-Activity Buffer Zone",
                        "name": "Station Biologist Onsite During Buffer Installation",
                        "text": "The Designated Biologist(s)\nand/or Biological Monitor(s) shall be onsite during all buffer installation activities that could result in\ntake, including trenching, vehicular access, erecting fencing material, installing posts, and any other\nactivities that require vehicle or foot traffic in MALI suitable habitat.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },

                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMS64HSCCA956ZZYZCFCT": {

                        "text": "The buffer zone\ndesign plan shall be submitted to CDFW for approval as part of the appropriate Phase Authorization\nPackage.",

                            "name": "Submit Buffer Zone Designs and Locations for CDFW Approval"

                        "code": "COA 11.106",
                        "commitment": "MALI No-Activity Buffer Zone",

                      "req_01M2ESMS7W6E1HTMTD240D0JJN": {

                        "name": "Site SCADA/Transmission Line Maintenance on Levee Landside",

                        "name": "Survey for MALI Before SCADA/Line Maintenance",
                        "text": "Non-disturbance buffers around MALI shall be placed after preconstruction surveys are\nconducted by the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) prior to maintenance activities.",

                      "req_01M2ESMS9N6R3G11B584DPJ5HC": {

                        "commitment": "MALI Translocation Plan",
                        "name": "Prepare and Submit MALI Translocation Plan",
                        "text": "Permittee shall prepare a Mortality Reduction and Translocation Plan (MALI Translocation Plan) for\nMALI and submit it to CDFW as part of the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization Package\n(Condition of Approval 6.2) for written approval prior to the initiation of Covered Activities.",

                      "req_01M2ESMS9N6R3G11B584DPJ5HD": {

                        "commitment": "MALI Translocation Plan",
                        "name": "Notify Biologist Immediately of MALI Found Onsite",
                        "text": "If MALI is found within a Project construction site or maintenance area, Project personnel shall notify\nthe Designated Biologist(s) immediately.",

                        "name": "Collect, Handle and Relocate Threatened MALI Plants",
                        "text": "The Covered Species may only be collected and handled by\nthe CDFW-approved Designated Biologist(s) with expertise in handling plants. The Designated\nBiologist(s) shall determine whether the plant should be collected and handled and shall relocate the\nplant in accordance with the Translocation Plan. Collected plants shall be transplanted as soon as\npossible. The Designated Biologist(s) shall relocate the plant to a CDFW approved translocation site if\nthe plant is directly threatened by Covered…",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMS9PZAA7R0G27BRK7FGT": {
                        "code": "COA 11.108",
                        "commitment": "MALI Translocation Plan",
                        "name": "Call CDFW Within 24 Hours of Each MALI Transplant",
                        "text": "The Designated Representative and/or\nDesignated Biologist(s) shall notify CDFW within 24 hours (one calendar day) of each time a plant is\ntransplanted. Notification to CDFW shall be via telephone and email",

                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R8HSR7K069ZM5EZCXV",
                            "name": "Report CTS and MALI Relocations to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]

                        "code": "COA 11.108",
                        "commitment": "MALI Translocation Plan",

                        "text": "followed by a written incident\nreport submitted to CDFW within two days of the incident.",

                            "name": "Report CTS and MALI Relocations to CDFW"
                          }

                      "req_01M2ESMSBE1S7VRTS2Y8GMEDS7": {
                        "code": "COA 11.109",
                        "commitment": "Velocity Requirements at North Delta Intakes",
                        "name": "Divert Only Within Fish Screen Approach Velocity Limit",
                        "text": "Permittee shall only divert when\nthe north Delta intake B and C fish screens are operating according to the CDFW 2000 Fish Screening\nCriteria and the NMFS 2023 Anadromous Salmonid Passage Design Manual.50, 51 In order to comply\nwith CDFW and NMFS fish screening criteria, Permittee shall operate the north Delta intakes not to\nexceed the maximum uniform approach velocity (Va) of 0.2 feet per second across the wetted surface\nof each individual fish screen.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSBE1S7VRTS2Y8GMEDS8": {
                        "code": "COA 11.109",
                        "commitment": "Velocity Requirements at North Delta Intakes",
                        "name": "Spread Diversion Across Intakes to Minimize Localized Velocity",
                        "text": "During diversions at the north Delta intakes, Permittee shall minimize\nlocalized Va by spreading the diversion as much as possible across intakes and fish screens, and by\nopening more fish screens than would be minimally required to meet the Va criterion.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSBE1S7VRTS2Y8GMEDS9": {
                        "code": "COA 11.109",
                        "commitment": "Velocity Requirements at North Delta Intakes",
                        "name": "Maintain Minimum Fish Screen Sweeping Velocity",
                        "text": "Permittee shall operate the north Delta intakes to maintain a minimum uniform Vs of 0.4 feet per\nsecond across the wetted surface of each individual fish screen.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSBE1S7VRTS2Y8GMEDSA": {
                        "code": "COA 11.109",
                        "commitment": "Velocity Requirements at North Delta Intakes",
                        "name": "Conduct Regular Hydraulic Testing of Screen Velocities",
                        "text": "Permittee shall conduct regular\nhydraulic testing in accordance with Condition of Approval 10.27 (Hydraulic Testing for Velocity\nRequirements) to ensure compliance with Va and Vs requirements identified in this Condition of\nApproval.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H3KQ2JH8QCYXWA8G3R",
                            "name": "Conduct North Delta Intake Fish Screen Hydraulic Tests"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSBE1S7VRTS2Y8GMEDSB": {
                        "code": "COA 11.109",
                        "commitment": "Velocity Requirements at North Delta Intakes",
                        "name": "Develop Hydraulic Data Plan With CDFW",
                        "text": "Permittee shall work collaboratively with\nCDFW to develop a Hydraulic Data Plan to use the data obtained from the new real-time monitoring\nstation, in addition to upstream monitoring stations described in Section 20.2.1 of the Project\nDescription and existing stations, to implement operating criteria described in this Condition of\nApproval and Condition of Approval 11.111. The plan shall take into consideration non-Project\ndiversions that may occur between the north Delta intakes and the…",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NJADVCJBHXD7RXW12F",
                            "name": "Develop Hydraulic Data Plan for Operating Criteria"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSD72ZD3PSG8PQ392H6H": {
                        "code": "COA 11.109.1",
                        "commitment": "No Diversions Without North Delta Intake Screens",
                        "name": "Prohibit Diversion Through Non-Functional Screen Units",
                        "text": "Permittee shall close the gate behind\na screen unit and not divert water through that screen unit at north Delta intake B or C at any\ntime unless the screen unit is fully functional.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSD72ZD3PSG8PQ392H6J": {
                        "code": "COA 11.109.1",
                        "commitment": "No Diversions Without North Delta Intake Screens",
                        "name": "Notify CDFW Within 1 Day of Non-Operational Fish Screens",
                        "text": "Permittee shall notify CDFW within one business\nday in writing if the fish screens are not operational at either north Delta intake.",

                            "name": "Notify CDFW of Non-Operational Fish Screens"

                        "text": "Permittee shall not divert any water through the north\nDelta intakes while it is conducting the Bethany Reservoir Pumping Plant Contractor’s Test (see\nSection 19.2.1 in the Project Description).",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",

                        "commitment": "Phase 1 and Phase 2 Authorized Operations",
                        "name": "Cap Diversion at 500 CFS During Phase 1 Testing",
                        "text": "During Intake B and C Operational Performance Testing\nand Pump Maintenance Activities, Permittee shall not divert more than 500 cfs at any time, the\nmaximum rate needed to conduct Intake B and C Operational Performance Testing and Pump\nMaintenance Activities, during Phase 1 Operations.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []

                        "name": "Cap Phase 2 Operations at One Calendar Year",

                        "code": "COA 11.110",

                        "name": "Evaluate Joint North/South Delta Intake Operations",
                        "text": "Permittee shall evaluate a wide range of potential approaches to operate the\nnorth Delta diversions jointly with existing south Delta export facilities as required by Condition of\nApproval 10.21.8 (Optimization Study to Inform Joint operations of State Water Project North and\nSouth Delta Intakes).",
