                      "req_01M2ESMSGQ0CME08SA39ND031V": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111",
                        "commitment": "Diversion Criteria for North Delta Intakes",
                        "name": "Prohibit Diversion While Delta Cross Channel Gates Are Open",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not divert from the north Delta intakes while the Delta Cross Channel Gates\nare open.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSGRP9DVS55MKS4X5YBD": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111",
                        "commitment": "Diversion Criteria for North Delta Intakes",
                        "name": "Maintain Minimum Bypass Flow Below Intake C (Tidally Dominated)",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not divert from the north Delta intakes unless an instantaneous bypass of\nSacramento River flow of 10,000 cfs is maintained below the north Delta intake C. • Permittee shall not divert from the north Delta intakes unless a minimum bypass 25-hour\nrunning average Sacramento River flow of 6,000 cfs is maintained downstream of the north\nDelta intake C.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSGRP9DVS55MKS4X5YBE": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111",
                        "commitment": "Diversion Criteria for North Delta Intakes",
                        "name": "Cap Diversion at 6% of Flow, Tidally Dominated",
                        "text": "Total Project diversions from the north Delta intakes shall not exceed six percent (6%) of the\nSacramento River instantaneous flow. • Permittee shall not divert from the north Delta intakes from March 1 through May 31.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSGRP9DVS55MKS4X5YBF": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111",
                        "commitment": "Diversion Criteria for North Delta Intakes",
                        "name": "Cap Diversion at 6-10% of Flow, Transitional",
                        "text": "Total Project diversions from the north Delta intakes shall not exceed six percent (6%) of the\n25-hour running average Sacramento River flow at any time, unless otherwise approved\nthrough Condition of Approval 11.111.5. • Total north Delta intake diversions may take between 6% - 10% of the 25-hour running\naverage Sacramento River flow, if approved through Condition of Approval 11.111.5 in\nresponse to a risk assessment (Condition of Approval 11.111.3), demonstrating that increased\ndiversions…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSGRP9DVS55MKS4X5YBG": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111",
                        "commitment": "Diversion Criteria for North Delta Intakes",
                        "name": "Cap Diversion at 10-12% of Flow, Flow Dominated",
                        "text": "Total Project diversions from the north Delta intakes shall not exceed ten percent (10 %) of\nthe 25-hour running average Sacramento River flow at any time. • Total north Delta intake diversions may take between 10% - 12% of the 25-hour running\naverage Sacramento River flow, if approved through Condition of Approval 11.111.5 in\nresponse to a risk assessment (Condition of Approval 11.111.3), demonstrating that increased\ndiversions will not cause Covered Fish Species Biological Criteria to be…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSJH110ZZVFMZ5MD0BV3": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.1",
                        "commitment": "June Operations Diversion Criteria",
                        "name": "Apply Tiered June Diversion Limits by Freeport Flow",
                        "text": "Sacramento River flow at Freeport between 10,900 cfs – 15,000 cfs: Diversions shall not\nexceed 900 cfs. • Sacramento River flow at Freeport between 15,000 – 17,000 cfs: Diversions shall not exceed\n6% of the Sacramento River flow at Freeport. • Sacramento River flow at Freeport between 17,000 – 20,000 cfs: Diversions shall not exceed\n1,020 cfs plus 40% of Sacramento River flow above 17,000 cfs. • Sacramento River flow at Freeport above 20,000 cfs: Diversions shall not reduce Sacramento\nRiver…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSJJ0K3HPN6NC01BTT5M": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.1",
                        "commitment": "June Operations Diversion Criteria",
                        "name": "Apply Post-15-Day High-Bypass June Diversion Limits",
                        "text": "Sacramento River flow at Freeport between 10,900 – 15,000 cfs: Diversions shall not exceed\n900 cfs plus 50% of the Sacramento River flow at Freeport above 11,000 cfs. Diversions shall\nnot reduce Sacramento River bypass flows to less than 10,000 cfs. • Sacramento River flow at Freeport above 15,000 cfs: Diversions shall not exceed 2,000 cfs\nplus 80% of Sacramento River flow at Freeport above 15,000 cfs.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSM9VZGDZ0JXS2Q0H0WH": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.2",
                        "commitment": "Seasonal Operations of the North Delta Intakes",
                        "name": "Coordinate Project Operations With CDFW During Phase 1 and 2",
                        "text": "Permittee shall monitor and manage\nProject operations in close coordination with CDFW staff during Phase 1 and Phase 2 operations\nas described in Condition of Approval 11.110.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSMAA8RVNCHG7JT7CNHX": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.2",
                        "commitment": "Seasonal Operations of the North Delta Intakes",
                        "name": "Apply November Risk-Based Diversion Criteria",
                        "text": "November: Based on real-time operations as described in Conditions of Approval 11.111.3\nand 11.111.5, if CDFW determines it is necessary based on an assessment of risk to Covered\nFish Species, relative to the Covered Fish Species Biological Criteria (Conditions of Approval\n11.115, 11.116, and 11.117), Permittee shall adhere to operating criteria described in\nCondition of Approval 11.111.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSMAA8RVNCHG7JT7CNHY": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.2",
                        "commitment": "Seasonal Operations of the North Delta Intakes",
                        "name": "Apply Default December Through May Operating Criteria",
                        "text": "December – May: Default operations shall adhere to operating criteria described in Condition\nof Approval 11.111. Condition of Approval 11.111 allows for risk assessments and real-time\ndecision-making when flows in the Sacramento River are between 20,000 – 35,000 cfs\n(December – February) or above 35,000 cfs.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSMAA8RVNCHG7JT7CNHZ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.2",
                        "commitment": "Seasonal Operations of the North Delta Intakes",
                        "name": "Apply Default June Operating Criteria Before Salmon Presence Off-Ramp",
                        "text": "Before salmon presence off-ramp (Condition of Approval 11.111.6): Default operations\nshall adhere to operating criteria described in Condition of Approval 11.111.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSMAA8RVNCHG7JT7CNJ0": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.2",
                        "commitment": "Seasonal Operations of the North Delta Intakes",
                        "name": "Apply June Operations Criteria After Salmon Presence Off-Ramp",
                        "text": "After a salmon presence offramp (Condition of Approval 11.111.6): Default operations\nshall adhere to June operations criteria in Condition of Approval 11.111.1. Based on\nreal-time operations as described in Conditions of Approval 11.111.3 and 11.111.5, if\nCDFW determines it is necessary based on an assessment of risk to Covered Fish\nSpecies relative to the Covered Fish Species Biological Criteria (Conditions of Approval\n11.115, 11.116, and 11.117), Permittee shall adhere to Diversion Criteria…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSMAA8RVNCHG7JT7CNJ1": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.2",
                        "commitment": "Seasonal Operations of the North Delta Intakes",
                        "name": "Apply July Risk-Based Diversion Criteria",
                        "text": "July: Based on real-time operations as described in Conditions of Approval 11.111.3 and\n11.111.5, if CDFW determines it is necessary based on an assessment of risk to Covered Fish\nSpecies, relative to the Covered Fish Species Biological Criteria (Conditions of Approval\n11.115, 11.116, and 11.117), Permittee shall adhere to operating criteria described in\nCondition of Approval 11.111.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSMAA8RVNCHG7JT7CNJ2": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.2",
                        "commitment": "Seasonal Operations of the North Delta Intakes",
                        "name": "Maintain Mandatory Bypass Flow November 1 Through July 30",
                        "text": "November 1 – July 30: The following criteria within Condition of Approval 11.111 shall be\nimplemented from November 1 – July 30 without exception: o Permittee shall not divert from the north Delta intakes unless an instantaneous bypass\nof Sacramento River flow of 10,000 cfs is maintained downstream of the north Delta\nintake C at the gage required by Condition of Approval 10.20.1.\no Permittee shall not divert from the north Delta intakes unless a minimum bypass 25-\nhour running average…",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSMAA8RVNCHG7JT7CNJ3": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.2",
                        "commitment": "Seasonal Operations of the North Delta Intakes",
                        "name": "Maintain Minimum Bypass Flow August 1 Through September 30",
                        "text": "August 1 – September 30: o Permittee shall not divert from the north Delta intakes unless a 3-day average bypass\nof Sacramento River flow of 5,000 cfs is maintained downstream of the north Delta\nIntake C at the gage required by Condition of Approval 10.20.1.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSMAA8RVNCHG7JT7CNJ4": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.2",
                        "commitment": "Seasonal Operations of the North Delta Intakes",
                        "name": "Maintain Minimum Bypass Flow October 1 Through October 31",
                        "text": "October 1 - October 31: o Permittee shall not divert from the north Delta intakes unless a 3-day average bypass\nof Sacramento River flow of 7,000 cfs is maintained downstream of the north Delta\nIntake C at the gage required by Condition of Approval 10.20.1.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSMAA8RVNCHG7JT7CNJ5": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.2",
                        "commitment": "Seasonal Operations of the North Delta Intakes",
                        "name": "Implement Year-Round Diversion Conditions of Approval",
                        "text": "Year-round: Permittee shall implement Conditions of Approval 11.109, 11.112, 11.113, and\n11.114.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSP28M32XPN201SKGW5F": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.3",
                        "commitment": "North Delta Diversion Monitoring Team and Risk Assessments",
                        "name": "Establish NDDMT Membership With CDFW and Optional Federal Partners",
                        "text": "The NDDMT shall include\nrepresentatives from Permittee and CDFW. Upon mutual agreement, representatives from\nReclamation, USFWS, and NMFS staff may also attend.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSP28M32XPN201SKGW5G": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.3",
                        "commitment": "North Delta Diversion Monitoring Team and Risk Assessments",
                        "name": "Convene NDDMT Weekly Beginning First Week of October",
                        "text": "Permittee shall convene the NDDMT weekly starting the first week in October each year during\nPhase 1 and Phase 2 operations.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSP3QEZQRVJ3HWC8EAFK": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.3",
                        "commitment": "North Delta Diversion Monitoring Team and Risk Assessments",
                        "name": "Begin Risk Assessments Last Week of October and Meet Weekly Through November",
                        "text": "The NDDMT shall begin to conduct risk assessments the last\nweek of October, to look ahead to conditions starting in November, and meet weekly throughout\nNovember.",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSP3QEZQRVJ3HWC8EAFM": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.3",
                        "commitment": "North Delta Diversion Monitoring Team and Risk Assessments",
                        "name": "Convene NDDMT As Needed December Through June",
                        "text": "Permittee may convene the NDDMT and conduct weekly Project operations risk\nassessments as needed from December – June each year.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSP3QEZQRVJ3HWC8EAFN": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.3",
                        "commitment": "North Delta Diversion Monitoring Team and Risk Assessments",
                        "name": "Convene NDDMT Weekly in July",
                        "text": "Permittee shall convene weekly\nNDDMT meetings in July to conduct risk assessments.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSP3QEZQRVJ3HWC8EAFP": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.3",
                        "commitment": "North Delta Diversion Monitoring Team and Risk Assessments",
                        "name": "Provide NDDMT Raw Data and Modeling to CDFW Within 10 Days of Request",
                        "text": "Permittee shall make all raw data and\nmodeling utilized as part of NDDMT available to CDFW within ten days of a request.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RB67EQDRWNDJBKFW6S",
                            "name": "Provide NDDMT Raw Data and Modeling to CDFW on Request"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSP3QEZQRVJ3HWC8EAFQ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.3",
                        "commitment": "North Delta Diversion Monitoring Team and Risk Assessments",
                        "name": "Conduct Risk Assessments Covering Components A Through G",
                        "text": "Risk assessments shall include, but not be\nlimited to, Components A – G below, and associated data sources. Permittee may change listed\ndata sources or modeling consistent with current best available science and as approved by\nCDFW.",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSQV25VV7Q7632NJ9MF1": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.4",
                        "commitment": "Chartering the North Delta Diversion Monitoring Team",
                        "name": "Develop and Submit NDDMT Charter for CDFW Approval",
                        "text": "Permittee shall submit drafts of the team charter to CDFW for\nreview no less than eight months prior to the start of Phase 1 Operations.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NK6K0BZ6XYWCKNWKMW",
                            "name": "Submit North Delta Diversion Monitoring Team Charter"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSSPGPGXPREKCV7YCHHF": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.5",
                        "commitment": "Collaborative Approach to Real-time Decision Making",
                        "name": "Convene NDDMT to Review Real-time Operations Data",
                        "text": "Permittee shall convene the NDDMT to consider Covered Fish Species survey\ndata, salvage data, other pertinent biotic and abiotic factors, and hydrologic and biological\nmodeling outputs.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSSPGPGXPREKCV7YCHHG": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.5",
                        "commitment": "Collaborative Approach to Real-time Decision Making",
                        "name": "Prepare Weekly Risk Assessment for Operating Criteria Changes",
                        "text": "NDDMT staff shall provide input on risk assessments prepared to anticipate\nimpacts on Covered Fish Species that could occur if a temporary change in operating criteria\ndescribed in Condition of Approval 11.111 were approved for the coming week.",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y32F2DZX3TCXSF7HD076",
                            "name": "Prepare Weekly Operating-Criteria Risk Assessment Report"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSSQYYRK2AF6VVNTC1XW": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.5",
                        "commitment": "Collaborative Approach to Real-time Decision Making",
                        "name": "Resolve Disputed Real-time Operations Decisions",
                        "text": "Permittee and CDFW WOMT representatives shall then confer and\nattempt to reach a resolution and agreed-upon Project operations. If a resolution is reached,\nPermittee shall operate consistent with the decision regarding Project operations made by\nPermittee and CDFW WOMT representatives.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSVD1KJC0F34NR5PD1GK": {
                        "code": "COA 11.111.6",
                        "commitment": "Salmon Presence Off-ramp",
                        "name": "Determine Salmon Passage and Temperature Trigger for June Shift",
                        "text": "95% of CHNWR and CHNSR have exited the Delta past Chipps Island as determined through Condition of Approval 11.111.5;\no Daily mean water temperature at Prisoner’s Point (CDEC station PPT) is > 22.2oC for seven\ndays (does not have to be consecutive) in June.",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSX62K9KSWNFWGPK95EM": {
                        "code": "COA 11.112",
                        "commitment": "Reservoir Storage",
                        "name": "Cap Combined South and North Delta SWP Diversions",
                        "text": "Permittee shall limit combined SWP water diversions at the existing south Delta\nfacilities and the north Delta intakes to the amount allowed under Condition of Approval 11.114.",
                        "type": "Other",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSX724175190C3250ET8": {
                        "code": "COA 11.112",
                        "commitment": "Reservoir Storage",
                        "name": "Restrict Additional Upstream Reservoir Releases for Diversion",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not change\nupstream reservoir operations to move additional stored water through the north Delta intakes.\nPermittee shall not make additional stored water releases, beyond those possible or required as of\nthe date of issuance of this ITP without the use of the Project, from the Lake Oroville Complex, or any\nother of its existing upstream reservoirs for the purpose of south Delta SWP exports, except: • A shift in exports from south Delta facilities to the north Delta intakes that…",
                        "type": "Other",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSYZF2RQ2A0WXRVCBAGK": {
                        "code": "COA 11.113",
                        "commitment": "Shifting Exports During Balanced Conditions",
                        "name": "Prohibit North Delta Diversions During Low-Export Balanced Conditions",
                        "text": "When balanced conditions are declared, consistent with COA, and the\nCVP and SWP are collectively withdrawing water from storage, Permittee shall not conduct diversions\nat the north Delta intakes when combined south Delta exports are less than or equal to 3,000 cfs.",
                        "type": "Other",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSYZF2RQ2A0WXRVCBAGM": {
                        "code": "COA 11.113",
                        "commitment": "Shifting Exports During Balanced Conditions",
                        "name": "Limit Export Shifting to North Delta During Balanced Conditions",
                        "text": "Shifting of exports from south Delta export facilities to north Delta export facilities during balanced\nconditions shall be limited by the following: • Export/inflow (E/I) ratio in D-1641; • Operating criteria described in Conditions of Approval 11.109, 11.111, 11.112, and 11.114; • Maintaining combined SWP and CVP south Delta diversions greater than 3,000 cfs; or • Maintaining total combined SWP diversion at the south Delta and north Delta diversions less\nthan or equal to 7,180 cfs, excluding…",
                        "type": "Other",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMSZ08PDFV1CSZRT18R6W": {
                        "code": "COA 11.113",
                        "commitment": "Shifting Exports During Balanced Conditions",
                        "name": "Develop and Implement Real-time Information Sharing Process with CDFW",
                        "text": "No less than three years prior to initiating Phase 1 Operations, Permittee shall collaborate with CDFW\nto develop a process to share information with CDFW in real time and facilitate evaluation of\nhydrologic and operational data required to implement this Condition of Approval and Condition of\nApproval 11.112.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NK6K0BZ6XYWCKNWKMX",
                            "name": "Develop Real-Time Information Sharing Process with CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMT0R3AVAQHERSDS0GMD2": {
                        "code": "COA 11.114",
                        "commitment": "Additional Diversions from North Delta Intakes Daily Cap",
                        "name": "Cap Combined South and North Delta SWP Diversions",
                        "text": "Permittee shall operate the north Delta intakes at all times to ensure that total SWP diversions from\nboth south and north Delta intakes do not exceed 10,350 cfs on a daily average.",
                        "type": "Other",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMT2GD69RBQ63A8A8HYSN": {
                        "code": "COA 11.115",
                        "commitment": "Delta Smelt and Longfin Smelt Biological Criteria Model Approval",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval for Biological Criteria Compliance Models",
                        "text": "All models used to assess compliance with\nthe Biological Criteria shall be subject to CDFW approval.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34WE7XE98281ZXQVPK6",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval of Biological Criteria Compliance Models"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMT49GX2D5VVT0VT7RHK4": {
                        "code": "COA 11.115.1",
                        "commitment": "Smelt Biological Criterion 1",
                        "name": "Assess Covered Activities Against Smelt Entrainment and Abundance Criteria",
                        "text": "Permittee shall ensure that Covered Activities, including\nconstruction and operations, do not result in: • A greater than 0.36 probability of reducing DS or LFS larvae exiting past Chipps Island, and\ninstead becoming entrained in the north Delta intakes or central and south Delta, by\ngreater than or equal to 3% as a result of Covered Activities relative to baseline\nconditions; and • A greater than 0.40 probability of reducing the LFS Fall Midwater Trawl Index by more\nthan 3% as a result of…",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMT614Q1SBCBDNAFM28AQ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.115.2",
                        "commitment": "Smelt Biological Criterion 2",
                        "name": "Assess Smelt Population Growth Rate Against Baseline",
                        "text": "Permittee shall ensure that Phase 1 and Phase 2\noperations do not result in a net negative change in DS or LFS population growth rate relative to\nbaseline conditions as measured using the DS and LFS life cycle models required by Condition of\nApproval 10.21.2.",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMT7TABTK6P93QMMQBAQF": {
                        "code": "COA 11.116",
                        "commitment": "Winter- and Spring-run Chinook Salmon Biological Criteria Model Approval",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval for Salmonid Biological Criteria Models",
                        "text": "All models used to assess\ncompliance with the Biological Criteria shall be subject to CDFW approval.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34WE7XE98281ZXQVPK6",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval of Biological Criteria Compliance Models"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMT9J6H7C4D8AMBPRXB29": {
                        "code": "COA 11.116.1",
                        "commitment": "Salmonid Biological Criterion 1",
                        "name": "Monitor for Juvenile Salmon Entrainment at North Delta Intakes",
                        "text": "Permittee shall ensure that Phase 1 and Phase 2\noperations do not result in entrainment of juvenile CHNWR or CHNSR into the north Delta\nintakes.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMT9J6H7C4D8AMBPRXB2A": {
                        "code": "COA 11.116.1",
                        "commitment": "Salmonid Biological Criterion 1",
                        "name": "Assess Covered Activities Against Salmonid Survival Criterion",
                        "text": "Permittee shall ensure that Covered Activities, including construction and operations, do\nnot result in a greater than 0.06 probability of reducing juvenile CHNWR or CHNSR through-Delta\nsurvival of CHNWR or CHNSR by more than 4% relative to baseline conditions.",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTBAKV3R7VSK61G0CBDQ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.116.2",
                        "commitment": "Salmonid Biological Criterion 2",
                        "name": "Assess Salmonid Population Growth Rate Against Baseline",
                        "text": "Permittee shall ensure that Phase 1 and Phase 2\noperations do not result in a net negative change in CHNWR or CHNSR population growth rate relative to baseline conditions as measured using the CHNWR and CHNSR life cycle models\nrequired by Condition of Approval 10.21.2.",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTD3MKXCW8AW2F365EEC": {
                        "code": "COA 11.117",
                        "commitment": "White Sturgeon Biological Criteria Model Approval",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval for White Sturgeon Biological Criteria Models",
                        "text": "All models used to assess compliance with the Biological\nCriteria shall be subject to CDFW approval.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34WE7XE98281ZXQVPK6",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval of Biological Criteria Compliance Models"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTEVCT94CYF2TVVG84MJ": {
                        "code": "COA 11.117.1",
                        "commitment": "White Sturgeon Biological Criterion 1",
                        "name": "Assess Covered Activities Against Sturgeon Catch Criterion",
                        "text": "Permittee shall ensure that Covered Activities,\nincluding construction and operations, do not result in a greater than 0.22 probability of reducing\ncatch per unit effort of young-of-year WS more than 4% relative to baseline conditions.",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTGMW3VF8AG8TM1SGS1C": {
                        "code": "COA 11.117.2",
                        "commitment": "White Sturgeon Biological Criterion 2",
                        "name": "Assess Sturgeon Population Growth Rate Against Baseline",
                        "text": "Permittee shall ensure that Phase 1 and Phase 2\noperations do not result in a net negative change in WS population growth rate relative to\nbaseline conditions as measured using the WS life cycle model required by Condition of Approval\n10.21.2.",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTJCND5F4VV6BR1CRRTB": {
                        "code": "COA 12",
                        "commitment": "Habitat Management Land Acquisition and Restoration",
                        "name": "Meet Compensatory Mitigation Acreage via Credits or HM Lands",
                        "text": "Permittee shall either purchase Covered Species credits from a CDFW-\napproved mitigation or conservation bank pursuant to Condition of Approval 12.10 to achieve the\nacreage requirements described in Table 12-1 and Table 12-2, or shall provide for both the\npermanent protection, restoration, and initial and long-term management and monitoring of Habitat\nManagement (HM) lands pursuant to Condition of Approval 12.11 below and consistent with Covered\nSpecies habitat criteria described in Attachment…",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTJDPF4BKMV539XW8FER": {
                        "code": "COA 12",
                        "commitment": "Habitat Management Land Acquisition and Restoration",
                        "name": "Obtain CESA Authorization for HM Lands Activities",
                        "text": "Because no take authorization is provided through this permit for the HM lands activities,\nPermittee shall obtain CESA authorization as necessary to implement HM land requirements.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34YSP53SW383CFT2CZJ",
                            "name": "Obtain CESA Authorization for HM Lands Activities"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTJDPF4BKMV539XW8FES": {
                        "code": "COA 12",
                        "commitment": "Habitat Management Land Acquisition and Restoration",
                        "name": "Maintain 10% HM Lands Stay-Ahead Ratio",
                        "text": "Permittee shall ensure the ratio of cumulative HM lands protection and restoration for each Covered\nSpecies remains at least 10 percent (10%) greater than the proportional cumulative impacts to each\nCovered Species habitat until the compensatory mitigation acreages in Table 12-1 and Table 12-2\nhave been achieved.",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTJDPF4BKMV539XW8FET": {
                        "code": "COA 12",
                        "commitment": "Habitat Management Land Acquisition and Restoration",
                        "name": "Amend ITP When Actual Impacts Vary from Anticipated",
                        "text": "Permittee may request an amendment if actual impacts as documented in the Phase\nAuthorization packages are less than anticipated in this ITP based on updated information, including\nsite surveys or modeling of Project operations. Amendment shall also be required if impacts are\ngreater than anticipated.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34V8WHD9WZSVEXW30W6",
                            "name": "Notify and Consult CDFW on ITP Amendment Conditions"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTJEPDSERNB5QPHEZ71K": {
                        "code": "COA 12",
                        "commitment": "Habitat Management Land Acquisition and Restoration",
                        "name": "Complete Mitigation or Security Before Phase Impacts",
                        "text": "Purchase of Covered Species credits, restoration (where required), permanent HM land\nprotection, and funding for perpetual monitoring and management of compensatory habitat, must\nbe complete before starting Covered Activities, or if Security is provided pursuant to Condition of\nApproval 13 below for all uncompleted obligations, before incurring impacts to Covered Species for\neach Phase’s Covered Activities.",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3V2EGJHQX6564T66396",
                            "name": "Complete Mitigation and HM Lands Protection Before Impacts"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTJEPDSERNB5QPHEZ71M": {
                        "code": "COA 12",
                        "commitment": "Habitat Management Land Acquisition and Restoration",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Written Approval for Mitigation Projects",
                        "text": "All\nindividual protection and restoration projects proposed to achieve the compensatory mitigation\nrequirements in this Condition of Approval shall be subject to CDFW approval in writing.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34YSP53SW383CFT2CZH",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval of Mitigation Habitat Restoration Projects"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTJEPDSERNB5QPHEZ71N": {
                        "code": "COA 12",
                        "commitment": "Habitat Management Land Acquisition and Restoration",
                        "name": "Calculate Phase Impacts and Mitigation for Authorization Package",
                        "text": "Permittee shall calculate the total impacts on\nCovered Species and the corresponding amount of compensatory mitigation, on-site restoration, or\nother mitigation obligations required for each Phase of the Project prior to the beginning of each\nPhase, which calculation shall be included in the Phase Authorization Package submitted to CDFW for\nreview.",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y32F2DZX3TCXSF7HD077",
                            "name": "Calculate Phase Impacts and Mitigation for Authorization Package"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTJEPDSERNB5QPHEZ71P": {
                        "code": "COA 12",
                        "commitment": "Habitat Management Land Acquisition and Restoration",
                        "name": "Document Stay-Ahead Compliance in Annual Status Report",
                        "text": "Permittee shall include in its Annual Status Report, pursuant to\nCondition of Approval 10.13, documentation demonstrating that cumulative HM lands permanently protected (and restored where required) for each Covered Species is at least 10 percent (10%)\ngreater than the proportional cumulative impacts to each Covered Species habitat, based on the\nrequirements shown in Table 12-1 and Table 12-2 below (10 percent stay-ahead requirements).",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3R3GHBSN2G09CZKZQ72",
                            "name": "Deliver Annual Status Report to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTJEPDSERNB5QPHEZ71Q": {
                        "code": "COA 12",
                        "commitment": "Habitat Management Land Acquisition and Restoration",
                        "name": "Notify CDFW and Provide Plan for Stay-Ahead Shortfall",
                        "text": "Permittee\nimmediately shall notify CDFW and provide a plan for permanent protection, and restoration if\nrequired, of the necessary HM lands before proceeding with the Covered Activities causing the\nimpact.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RC1N589S9ETAS5HQJX",
                            "name": "Notify CDFW and Provide a Plan for a Stay-Ahead Shortfall"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTJEPDSERNB5QPHEZ71R": {
                        "code": "COA 12",
                        "commitment": "Habitat Management Land Acquisition and Restoration",
                        "name": "Restore Temporarily Impacted Covered Species Habitat",
                        "text": "Permittee shall also restore on-site acreages of temporarily impacted Covered Species habitat\ndescribed in Table 12-1 pursuant to Condition of Approval 12.3.",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3V103NJ75GYQV09GB8T",
                            "name": "Restore Temporarily Impacted Habitat to Pre-Project Conditions"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTM6F7R8AKVMKB6H58V0": {
                        "code": "COA 12.1",
                        "commitment": "Project Footprint Features with Impact Multiplier Percentages",
                        "name": "Verify Transmission Line and Preconstruction Impact Multipliers",
                        "text": "Permittee shall verify the accuracy of the multipliers assumed through its Annual Status Report\ndocumentation of impacts and mitigation (Conditions of Approval 10.9, 10.13, 12).",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3H41AKKXC7WAC4X6PQW",
                            "name": "Verify Impact Multipliers in the Annual Status Report"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTNXG144G8WNFT4JXMPZ": {
                        "code": "COA 12.2",
                        "commitment": "Restoration from Temporary Preconstruction Impacts",
                        "name": "Backfill and Restore Preconstruction Investigation Sites",
                        "text": "Permittee shall backfill subsurface pits, trenches, and boreholes from preconstruction activities\nwithin one year of initiating Covered Activities with the excavated material, and shall place the\nstockpiled topsoil at the surface and fully restore the site where field investigations were conducted (see Condition of Approval 12.3.3).",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3V2EGJHQX6564T66398",
                            "name": "Backfill and Restore Preconstruction Investigation Sites"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTNY7D1418K170PZNHSR": {
                        "code": "COA 12.2",
                        "commitment": "Restoration from Temporary Preconstruction Impacts",
                        "name": "Site Geotechnical Test Locations Away From Aquatic Features",
                        "text": "Preconstruction activities on the surface over tunnel sections shall\navoid siting test trenches, CPTs, and boring in aquatic features.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTQPZPEYQ0BM549VQ78K": {
                        "code": "COA 12.3",
                        "commitment": "Temporary Impacts and On-Site Restoration",
                        "name": "Restore Temporarily Disturbed Covered Species Habitat On-Site",
                        "text": "Temporarily affected areas within Covered Species habitat and identified for on-site restoration shall\nbe restored within one year of disturbance to pre-Project conditions or better, including grade and\nhydrology.",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3V103NJ75GYQV09GB8T",
                            "name": "Restore Temporarily Impacted Habitat to Pre-Project Conditions"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTQPZPEYQ0BM549VQ78M": {
                        "code": "COA 12.3",
                        "commitment": "Temporary Impacts and On-Site Restoration",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW-Approved Species-Specific Restoration Guidelines",
                        "text": "Species-specific restoration efforts shall comply with guidelines approved by CDFW prior to the\ninitiation of Covered Activities following Condition of Approval 10.4 suitable habitat features and\nAttachment 4.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NPMSXZQMQNBGV7AENJ",
                            "name": "Submit Restoration and Revegetation Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTSFZE1MPKDC55PW5H2E": {
                        "code": "COA 12.3.1",
                        "commitment": "Temporary Impact Criteria",
                        "name": "Recontour and Reseed Temporary Impact Areas Same-Year",
                        "text": "recontouring and reseeding of each temporary\nimpact area shall occur within the year of the impact initially occurring and consistent with the\nRestoration and Revegetation Plan (Condition of Approval 12.3.3), and no additional ground\ndisturbing activities shall occur",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3V103NJ75GYQV09GB8T",
                            "name": "Restore Temporarily Impacted Habitat to Pre-Project Conditions"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTSGH2CPJYC0EHHW9011": {
                        "code": "COA 12.3.1",
                        "commitment": "Temporary Impact Criteria",
                        "name": "Remove Exclusion Fencing by October 31 Near Aquatic Features",
                        "text": "if the impact area is within 1,000 feet of an aquatic feature, all\nwork shall be completed within this area and exclusion fencing shall be removed by October 31 of\nthe same year, allowing the Covered Species unrestricted access between upland and aquatic\nhabitats",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y37E7QF03BCX148MFCR0",
                            "name": "Remove exclusion barriers after covered activities end"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTSGH2CPJYC0EHHW9012": {
                        "code": "COA 12.3.1",
                        "commitment": "Temporary Impact Criteria",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval of Restoration Plan Before Temporary Impacts",
                        "text": "Permittee shall not initiate\nCovered Activities that will result in temporary impacts to Covered Species habitat, including\npreconstruction activities, until the Restoration Plan is approved in writing by CDFW.",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NPMSXZQMQNBGV7AENJ",
                            "name": "Submit Restoration and Revegetation Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTV61PPK7RWYVRPSSH96": {
                        "code": "COA 12.3.2",
                        "commitment": "Temporary Impact Restoration Schedule",
                        "name": "Develop Temporary Impact Restoration Schedule",
                        "text": "Permittee shall develop a Temporary Impact Restoration Schedule that ensures: (1) removal of\ninvasive substrate, recontouring, and seeding of temporary impact areas shall occur within the\nsame year and at appropriate times to ensure seedling success ; and (2) all temporary impacts\nfrom prior years shall meet the recontouring and seeding criteria and shall achieve vegetation\nsuccess as described in the Restoration and Revegetation Plan (See Condition of Approval 12.3.3).",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NPMSXZQMQNBGV7AENK",
                            "name": "Develop Temporary Impact Restoration Schedule"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTWYDE1920SWZ9QXMMM0": {
                        "code": "COA 12.3.3",
                        "commitment": "Restoration and Revegetation Plan",
                        "name": "Submit Restoration and Revegetation Plan for CDFW Approval",
                        "text": "Permittee shall submit the Restoration Plan to CDFW as part of the appropriate\nPhase Authorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.2).",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NPMSXZQMQNBGV7AENJ",
                            "name": "Submit Restoration and Revegetation Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTWZNQTVFA2YPJBP8E28": {
                        "code": "COA 12.3.3",
                        "commitment": "Restoration and Revegetation Plan",
                        "name": "Establish Reference and Treatment Transects for Restoration",
                        "text": "Permittee shall establish a representative number of transects within disturbed areas (“treatment”) which will each be associated with a\nreference (“control”) site (i.e., site within intact natural habitat that will be used as a model for\nrestoration activities).",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3Y1MDXG6FS3PQ7VM4YJ",
                            "name": "Establish Restoration Treatment and Reference Transects"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTWZNQTVFA2YPJBP8E29": {
                        "code": "COA 12.3.3",
                        "commitment": "Restoration and Revegetation Plan",
                        "name": "Design Seed Mix and Target Vegetation Communities",
                        "text": "Seed mixes shall be identified for approval as part of the Restoration Plan and shall include a\nmix of locally native species and non-native forage species (no species designated by the\nCalifornia Invasive Plant Council (Cal-IPC) as high or moderate invasive species may be used), including diverse assemblages of native and non-native flora, with an emphasis on\nnonnative bunchgrasses and other grassland species including local, native wildflowers\nand/or shrub seeds. Self-sustaining and/or…",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTWZNQTVFA2YPJBP8E2A": {
                        "code": "COA 12.3.3",
                        "commitment": "Restoration and Revegetation Plan",
                        "name": "Remove Invasive Substrate and Manage Restoration Fill",
                        "text": "Gravel and other invasive substrate shall be removed from restoration areas. (2) To the maximum extent feasible, topsoil shall be salvaged from within on-site Project areas\nprior to construction. Imported fill soils shall be limited to weed-free and pathogen-free\ntopsoil similar in texture, chemical composition and pH to soils found at the Project Site(s). (3) Permittee may import and place up to three feet of soil in compacted areas to increase the\npotential for vegetation establishment. Fill…",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTX0GQVZGMA42T89ZK0E": {
                        "code": "COA 12.3.3",
                        "commitment": "Restoration and Revegetation Plan",
                        "name": "Protect Restoration Soils and Meet Seeding Window",
                        "text": "Minor recontouring may be conducted; however, Permittee shall limit grading, compaction,\nfill, and other earthmoving activities to the Project construction site. Soils shall be protected\nfrom wind erosion using a biodegradable erosion control blanket or appropriate mulch\ncover (i.e., hydroseed), or other appropriate methods approved by CDFW, until vegetation is\nestablished. Seed shall be applied in the early fall, between October 15 and October 31. If\nfeasible, seed shall be applied immediately…",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTX0GQVZGMA42T89ZK0F": {
                        "code": "COA 12.3.3",
                        "commitment": "Restoration and Revegetation Plan",
                        "name": "Install Barriers to Protect Restored Road Shoulders",
                        "text": "Drivers may attempt to use adjacent shoulders for parking or to avoid ruts that form in\nroadways. To protect restored habitat adjacent to permanent roadways, permanent roads\nshall be kept in good repair, and barriers or fill shall be placed between the edge of the road\nand restored shoulders at the same grade to restrict vehicular access.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTX0GQVZGMA42T89ZK0G": {
                        "code": "COA 12.3.3",
                        "commitment": "Restoration and Revegetation Plan",
                        "name": "Control Invasive Plants at Restoration Sites",
                        "text": "Permittee shall oversee the management of invasive plants within Project construction sites\nand Project maintenance areas and may use control methods such as hand removal, light\ngrubbing, mowing, or grazing within seeding and planting areas following vegetation\nrestoration.",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTX0GQVZGMA42T89ZK0H": {
                        "code": "COA 12.3.3",
                        "commitment": "Restoration and Revegetation Plan",
                        "name": "Meet Restoration Survivorship Success Standards",
                        "text": "Success standards to ensure a minimum of 70 percent survivorship for three years after the\nlast planting at each site and proposed remedial actions if those standards are not met.",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTYP66KXTJEHEW4M81KS": {
                        "code": "COA 12.3.4",
                        "commitment": "Restoration Monitoring and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Monitor and Maintain Restoration Areas to Success",
                        "text": "Permittee is responsible for monitoring and maintaining the\nhabitat restoration areas for a period of three years or until the Restoration Plan success criteria\nhave been met as determined by the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) and\nCDFW in writing.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTYQKRY2AEA4HFNVAVW0": {
                        "code": "COA 12.3.4",
                        "commitment": "Restoration Monitoring and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Submit Restoration Monitoring Reports to CDFW",
                        "text": "For the first year, Permittee shall submit two monitoring reports. After the first\nsix months following completion of restoration activities at a Project Site, Permittee shall submit\nthe first monitoring report detailing vegetation establishment, percent invasive plant species, site\nphotos, and other relevant observations regarding success of the restoration project(s) to CDFW.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RC1N589S9ETAS5HQK1",
                            "name": "Submit Restoration Monitoring Reports to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMTYQKRY2AEA4HFNVAVW1": {
                        "code": "COA 12.3.4",
                        "commitment": "Restoration Monitoring and Maintenance",
                        "name": "Perform Remedial Restoration When Standards Are Unmet",
                        "text": "Should the survival and/or cover requirements not meet the performance standards outlined in\nthe Restoration Plan, Permittee is responsible for replacement planting, additional watering,\nweeding, invasive plant eradication, or any other practice to achieve the above requirements.",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMV0G2RPZFHW44PCZ3G5Z": {
                        "code": "COA 12.4",
                        "commitment": "Bird Strike Diverters on Transmission Lines",
                        "name": "Submit Bird Strike Diverter Plan for CDFW Approval",
                        "text": "Permittee shall submit a plan describing the location\nand type of bird strike diverters installed as compensatory mitigation for impacts to SWHA and TRBL\nto CDFW for review and approval as part of the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization\nPackage (Condition of Approval 6.2).",
                        "type": "Plan",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3NPMSXZQMQNBGV7AENM",
                            "name": "Submit Bird Strike Diverter Location and Type Plan"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMV0G2RPZFHW44PCZ3G60": {
                        "code": "COA 12.4",
                        "commitment": "Bird Strike Diverters on Transmission Lines",
                        "name": "Install Bird Strike Diverters on Transmission Lines",
                        "text": "Permittee shall install bird strike diverters on newly constructed and existing transmission lines\nwithin the Project Area as a part of Covered Activities and shown in Attachment 1, Figures 5 and 6\nconsistent with Condition of Approval 11.17.1.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6YKM817BXJNTVA76DKTZ1",
                            "name": "Install Bird Strike Diverters on New Transmission Lines"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMV0G2RPZFHW44PCZ3G61": {
                        "code": "COA 12.4",
                        "commitment": "Bird Strike Diverters on Transmission Lines",
                        "name": "Maintain Installed Bird Strike Diverters",
                        "text": "Upon written approval of the Plan by CDFW, Permittee shall\ninstall and maintain all bird strike diverters.",
                        "type": "Avoidance & BMPs",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMV290BYP9VJ1MDF8SZN2": {
                        "code": "COA 12.5.1",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Compensation for Lost Occupied Nest Sites",
                        "name": "Plant Replacement Nest Trees for Each Removed Nest Site",
                        "text": "For each occupied nest site removed\nas a result of Covered Activities, Permittee shall plant five mature suitable nest trees (at least 20\nfeet tall) and 15 five-gallon container sized suitable nest trees (see Condition of Approval 10.4 and\nAttachment 5) at a location that is within preserved HM lands and approved in writing by CDFW.",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3V2EGJHQX6564T66399",
                            "name": "Plant Replacement Swainson's Hawk Nest Trees"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMV2AYG1M0RCCZPA7FTW6": {
                        "code": "COA 12.5.1",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Compensation for Lost Occupied Nest Sites",
                        "name": "Site Replacement Nest Trees per Spacing Criteria",
                        "text": "Establish replacement nest sites at least 0.5 miles apart. • Establish replacement nest sites at least 0.25 miles from any existing suitable nest tree and at\nleast 0.5 miles from any existing occupied nest tree. • Establish replacement nest sites as close as possible to the impacted nest site, unless such\nlocation would have low long-term conservation value due to threats such as ongoing\ndisturbance, seasonal flooding, or sea level rise. • Plant the five mature trees and 15 saplings in sites…",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMV436Y8K8NHQB9MMX3JE": {
                        "code": "COA 12.5.2",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Compensation for Lost Suitable Nest Trees",
                        "name": "Plant Replacement Trees for Each Suitable Nest Tree Removed",
                        "text": "For each suitable nest tree removed as a result\nof Covered Activities, Permittee shall plant five native trees (five-gallon container size) suitable\nfor SWHA nesting to replace lost suitable nest trees consistent with Condition of Approval 10.4\nand Attachment 4 at sites within or adjacent to conserved foraging habitat.",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3V2EGJHQX6564T66399",
                            "name": "Plant Replacement Swainson's Hawk Nest Trees"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMV5V36QAS8SYKGYQNNTW": {
                        "code": "COA 12.5.3",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Replacement Nest Tree Monitoring and Success Criteria",
                        "name": "Monitor Replacement Nest Trees for Ten Years and Beyond",
                        "text": "Permittee shall monitor\nand maintain all replacement trees (mature trees and saplings) for a period of ten years to ensure\nsurvival and appropriate growth and development.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMV5WNA9H2H2GRY0Y20RC": {
                        "code": "COA 12.5.3",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Replacement Nest Tree Monitoring and Success Criteria",
                        "name": "Irrigate and Maintain Replacement Nest Trees",
                        "text": "Permittee shall provide all\nnecessary maintenance (e.g., fertilizing, irrigation) to ensure successful tree establishment.\nPermittee shall irrigate trees for a minimum of five years after planting, and then gradually wean\nthe trees off the irrigation during a period of approximately two years.",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMV5WNA9H2H2GRY0Y20RD": {
                        "code": "COA 12.5.3",
                        "commitment": "SWHA Replacement Nest Tree Monitoring and Success Criteria",
                        "name": "Meet Replacement Nest Tree Survival Standard",
                        "text": "Success shall be measured as an 80% survival\nrate of mature trees and 80% survival rate of saplings at five and ten years after planting.",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMV7KRZKKJSNH8GTNVGEK": {
                        "code": "COA 12.6.1",
                        "commitment": "Construction Mitigation for Delta Smelt and Longfin Smelt",
                        "name": "Site, Design and Restore DS/LFS Tidal and Spawning Habitat",
                        "text": "Permittee shall complete siting,\ndesign, and restoration of required DS and LFS compensatory mitigation prior to initiation of in-\nwater construction Covered Activities that impact DS and LFS habitat.",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3V2EGJHQX6564T6639A",
                            "name": "Site, Design and Restore Construction Mitigation Habitat for Covered Fish"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMV7KRZKKJSNH8GTNVGEM": {
                        "code": "COA 12.6.1",
                        "commitment": "Construction Mitigation for Delta Smelt and Longfin Smelt",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval of Habitat Restoration Projects",
                        "text": "All DS tidal perennial habitat restoration and shallow\nspawning habitat restoration shall be subject to approval by CDFW.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34YSP53SW383CFT2CZH",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval of Mitigation Habitat Restoration Projects"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMV7KRZKKJSNH8GTNVGEN": {
                        "code": "COA 12.6.1",
                        "commitment": "Construction Mitigation for Delta Smelt and Longfin Smelt",
                        "name": "Monitor Habitat Mitigation Sites for Ten Years",
                        "text": "Permittee\nshall monitor habitat mitigation sites for a period of at least 10 years to ensure the effectiveness\nboth as refuge and spawning habitat.",
                        "type": "Monitoring",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMV7KRZKKJSNH8GTNVGEP": {
                        "code": "COA 12.6.1",
                        "commitment": "Construction Mitigation for Delta Smelt and Longfin Smelt",
                        "name": "Coordinate with CDFW on Mitigation Site Selection and Design",
                        "text": "Permittee shall coordinate\nwith CDFW throughout the process of site selection and restoration design for habitat mitigation\n(HM) lands intended to serve as compensatory mitigation for impacts to DS and LFS habitat.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34YSP53SW383CFT2CZT",
                            "name": "Coordinate with CDFW on Mitigation Site Selection and Design"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMV7M3QTHZW3VMB5W7Y74": {
                        "code": "COA 12.6.1",
                        "commitment": "Construction Mitigation for Delta Smelt and Longfin Smelt",
                        "name": "Integrate Spawning Habitat Study into Design",
                        "text": "Permittee shall integrate the results from the Ecological Response Evaluation Study: Delta Smelt\nand Longfin Smelt Spawning Habitat Study (Condition of Approval 10.21.5) into shallow spawning\nhabitat design and implementation.",
                        "type": "Design",
                        "actions": []
                      },
