                        "text": "conducting a baseline biological assessment and land survey report within four\nmonths of recording or transfer",
                        "type": "Survey",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3Y1MDXG6FS3PQ7VM4YH",
                            "name": "Complete Baseline Biological Assessment and Land Survey"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMWG6VA04DKPWKMX051FH": {
                        "code": "COA 12.11.6",
                        "commitment": "HM Lands Start-up Activities",
                        "name": "Complete Initial HM Lands Site Establishment Tasks",
                        "text": "developing and transferring Geographic Information Systems\n(GIS) data if applicable; (4) establishing initial fencing; (5) conducting litter removal; (6)\nconducting initial habitat restoration or enhancement, if applicable; and (7) installing signage.",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3V2EGJHQX6564T66397",
                            "name": "Complete HM Lands Start-Up Fencing, Signage and Enhancement"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMWHYM7C650MKCRWS45YY": {
                        "code": "COA 12.11.7",
                        "commitment": "HM Lands Interim Management",
                        "name": "Implement Interim Management of HM Lands",
                        "text": "Interim management period\nactivities described in the final management plan shall include fence repair, continuing trash\nremoval, site monitoring, vegetation and invasive species management, and any other expected\nmanagement activities.",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMWHZGBZBXMKPQ5MRZ3PA": {
                        "code": "COA 12.11.7",
                        "commitment": "HM Lands Interim Management",
                        "name": "Fund Interim Management from SWP Contractor Charges",
                        "text": "Permittee shall provide funding for interim management of the HM lands\nby using revenues derived from SWP charges to the SWP Contractors under long-term water\nsupply contracts and any subsequent agreements.",
                        "type": "Financial",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMWKQRXTQ20EGY49RWWPS": {
                        "code": "COA 12.12",
                        "commitment": "In-Perpetuity Management Funding",
                        "name": "Implement Perpetual Management of HM Lands",
                        "text": "After the interim management period, Permittee shall ensure that the designated long-term land\nmanager implements the management and monitoring of the HM lands according to the final\nmanagement plan.",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMWKR3XYAFRTEAMNZAGG4": {
                        "code": "COA 12.12",
                        "commitment": "In-Perpetuity Management Funding",
                        "name": "Provide Annual Long-Term HM Lands Management Funding",
                        "text": "After obtaining CDFW approval of the HM lands, Permittee shall provide long-\nterm management funding for the perpetual management of the HM lands.",
                        "type": "Financial",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3ENYWE6AXT12YDFDJM2",
                            "name": "Provide Annual Long-Term HM Lands Management Funding"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMWKR3XYAFRTEAMNZAGG5": {
                        "code": "COA 12.12",
                        "commitment": "In-Perpetuity Management Funding",
                        "name": "Establish Endowment When SWP Funding Ends",
                        "text": "If SWP charges to the SWP Contractors are no longer available as funding, Permittee shall\nestablish a long-term management fund (Endowment).",
                        "type": "Financial",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3ENYWE6AXT12YDFDJM0",
                            "name": "Establish Long-Term HM Lands Management Endowment"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMWKR3XYAFRTEAMNZAGG6": {
                        "code": "COA 12.12",
                        "commitment": "In-Perpetuity Management Funding",
                        "name": "Fund the Endowment at Minimum Ten Percent Annually",
                        "text": "Permittee shall fund the Endowment by contributing a minimum of ten percent of the amount\nrequired by the PAR (adjusted for present value) annually, commencing the fiscal year that SWP\ncharges to the SWP Contractors are no longer an available funding source, to a mutually agreed upon\naccount, until the Endowment is fully funded",
                        "type": "Financial",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3ENYWE6AXT12YDFDJM1",
                            "name": "Fund Annual Endowment Deposit Amount Installment"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMWNJCYH7CFZKH76128Q3": {
                        "code": "COA 12.12.1",
                        "commitment": "Identify an Endowment Manager",
                        "name": "Submit Endowment Manager Proposal to CDFW",
                        "text": "Permittee shall submit to CDFW a written proposal that includes: (i) the name of the proposed\nEndowment Manager; (ii) whether the proposed Endowment Manager is a governmental entity,\nspecial district, nonprofit organization, community foundation, or congressionally chartered\nfoundation; (iii) whether the proposed Endowment Manager holds the property or an interest in\nthe property for conservation purposes as required by Government Code section 65968(b)(1) or,\nin the alternative, the basis for…",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34YSP53SW383CFT2CZQ",
                            "name": "Submit Endowment Manager Proposal to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMWQ9FFCCSJVMSG0ZMMXV": {
                        "code": "COA 12.12.2",
                        "commitment": "Calculate the Endowment Funds Deposit",
                        "name": "Prepare Endowment Assessment (PAR-Equivalent)",
                        "text": "Permittee shall prepare an endowment assessment (equivalent to a Property Analysis\nRecord (PAR)) to calculate the amount of funding necessary to ensure the long-term management\nof the HM lands (Endowment Deposit Amount).",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y32F2DZX3TCXSF7HD078",
                            "name": "Prepare Endowment Assessment for CDFW Approval"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMWQAXVFYVR50AVZG23PV": {
                        "code": "COA 12.12.2",
                        "commitment": "Calculate the Endowment Funds Deposit",
                        "name": "Submit Endowment Assessment for CDFW Approval",
                        "text": "Permittee shall submit to CDFW for review and approval the results of the endowment\nassessment before transferring funds to the Endowment Manager.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34YSP53SW383CFT2CZR",
                            "name": "Submit Endowment Assessment for CDFW Approval"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMWS290SR3EMGS4Z6Y5CK": {
                        "code": "COA 12.12.2.1",
                        "commitment": "Endowment Capitalization Rate and Fees",
                        "name": "Obtain and Apply Endowment Capitalization Rate",
                        "text": "Permittee shall obtain the capitalization rate from the selected Endowment Manager for use in calculating the endowment assessment and\nadjust for any additional administrative, periodic, or annual fees.",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y32F2DZX3TCXSF7HD078",
                            "name": "Prepare Endowment Assessment for CDFW Approval"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMWTVQCN437BEHM5QQM8Y": {
                        "code": "COA 12.12.2.2",
                        "commitment": "Endowment Buffers and Assumptions",
                        "name": "Include Viability Buffers in Endowment Assumptions",
                        "text": "Permittee shall include in the endowment assessment assumptions the following buffers for endowment establishment and use that will\nsubstantially ensure long-term viability and security of the Endowment:",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y32F2DZX3TCXSF7HD078",
                            "name": "Prepare Endowment Assessment for CDFW Approval"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMWWMSW4CBNECH46JBQB9": {
                        "code": "COA 12.12.2.2.1",
                        "commitment": "Endowment 10 Percent Contingency",
                        "name": "Add 10 Percent Contingency to Endowment Calculation",
                        "text": "A 10 percent contingency shall be added to each endowment calculation to hedge against underestimation of the fund, unanticipated\nexpenditures, inflation, or catastrophic events.",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y32F2DZX3TCXSF7HD078",
                            "name": "Prepare Endowment Assessment for CDFW Approval"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMWYAQWPCQ67M605H4EVQ": {
                        "code": "COA 12.12.2.2.2",
                        "commitment": "Endowment Three Years Delayed Spending",
                        "name": "Assume Three Years Delayed Endowment Spending",
                        "text": "The endowment shall be established assuming spending will not occur for the first three years after full funding.",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y32F2DZX3TCXSF7HD078",
                            "name": "Prepare Endowment Assessment for CDFW Approval"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMX046KMDYSZKZTBFZQP7": {
                        "code": "COA 12.12.2.2.3",
                        "commitment": "Endowment Non-annualized Expenses",
                        "name": "Withhold Non-annualized Capital Expenses from Annual Disbursement",
                        "text": "For all large capital expenses to occur periodically but not annually such as fence replacement or well replacement, payments shall be withheld from\nthe annual disbursement until the year of anticipated need or upon request to Endowment\nManager and CDFW.",
                        "type": "Analysis",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y32F2DZX3TCXSF7HD078",
                            "name": "Prepare Endowment Assessment for CDFW Approval"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMX1XQXE5G4Y2BW203CPW": {
                        "code": "COA 12.12.3",
                        "commitment": "Transfer Long-term Endowment Funds",
                        "name": "Fund Endowment Deposit Amount Over Ten Years",
                        "text": "Permittee shall fund the Endowment Deposit Amount over a maximum 10-year period, in annual amounts of at least 10% of the total Endowment Deposit Amount, adjusted for inflation, as\napproved by CDFW in writing.",
                        "type": "Financial",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3ENYWE6AXT12YDFDJM1",
                            "name": "Fund Annual Endowment Deposit Amount Installment"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMX3TF14WVNXSCGMG8YVV": {
                        "code": "COA 12.12.4",
                        "commitment": "Management of the Endowment",
                        "name": "Hold and Pool Endowment with Separate Accounting",
                        "text": "the\napproved Endowment Manager may pool the Endowment with other endowments for the\noperation, management, and protection of HM lands for local populations of the Covered Species\nbut shall maintain separate accounting for each Endowment.",
                        "type": "Financial",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMX3V5B3GJBP6QJF07JK7": {
                        "code": "COA 12.12.4",
                        "commitment": "Management of the Endowment",
                        "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval Before Executing Endowment Agreements",
                        "text": "No\nagreement governing the management and expenditure of the Endowment, if established, shall\nbe executed prior to obtaining written approval of CDFW.",
                        "type": "Approval & Consultation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y34YSP53SW383CFT2CZS",
                            "name": "Obtain CDFW Approval of the Endowment Management Agreement"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMX3V5B3GJBP6QJF07JK8": {
                        "code": "COA 12.12.4",
                        "commitment": "Management of the Endowment",
                        "name": "Require CDFW Approval Before Principal Disbursement",
                        "text": "the\nEndowment Manager shall not make any disbursement from the Endowment that will result in\nexpenditure of any portion of the principal of the endowment without the prior written approval\nof CDFW in its sole discretion. Permittee shall ensure that this requirement is included in any\nagreement of any kind governing the holding, investment, management, and/or disbursement of\nthe Endowment funds.",
                        "type": "Financial",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMX3V5B3GJBP6QJF07JK9": {
                        "code": "COA 12.12.4",
                        "commitment": "Management of the Endowment",
                        "name": "Process CDFW-Directed Endowment Expenditures",
                        "text": "if\nCDFW determines in its sole discretion that an expenditure needs to be made from the\nEndowment to preserve the conservation values of the HM lands, the Endowment Manager shall\nprocess that expenditure in accordance with directions from CDFW.",
                        "type": "Financial",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMX5J1FNXQ8JJFBF8Z7F2": {
                        "code": "COA 12.13",
                        "commitment": "Reimburse CDFW",
                        "name": "Reimburse CDFW Costs for ITP Issuance and Monitoring",
                        "text": "Permittee shall reimburse CDFW for all reasonable costs incurred by CDFW related to issuance and\nmonitoring of this ITP, including, but not limited to transaction fees, account set-up fees,\nadministrative fees, title and documentation review and related title transactions, costs incurred\nfrom other state agency reviews, and overhead related to transfer of HM lands to CDFW, if\napplicable.",
                        "type": "Financial",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3EPKKKVFDBN1YQGB0HQ",
                            "name": "Reimburse CDFW Costs for ITP Issuance and Monitoring"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMX7ADGRE9KJQC795NMQE": {
                        "code": "COA 13.1",
                        "commitment": "Security Amount",
                        "name": "Calculate Security Amount Before Each Phase Approval",
                        "text": "The Security for each Phase shall be calculated prior to approval of that Phase based on the\ninstructions provided in the Phase Authorization Form (Attachment 6) and Condition of Approval 12.9.",
                        "type": "Financial",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3EPKKKVFDBN1YQGB0HT",
                            "name": "Calculate Phase Security Amount Before Phase Approval"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMX932P8X2GF2S1KQRDA9": {
                        "code": "COA 13.2",
                        "commitment": "Security Form and CESA Mitigation Funding Strategy",
                        "name": "Submit Initial CESA Mitigation Funding Strategy",
                        "text": "Permittee shall prepare and submit to CDFW within one year of issuance of a State Water Board\napproval of a change in point of diversion for the Project an initial CESA mitigation funding strategy\nfor review and approval. The strategy shall include detailed cost estimates regarding implementation\nof construction-related monitoring and avoidance costs and mitigation costs including, as applicable: 1) purchase of mitigation or conservation bank credits; 2) HM lands acquisition and start-up costs…",
                        "type": "Financial",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3EPKKKVFDBN1YQGB0HW",
                            "name": "Submit and Update the CESA Mitigation Funding Strategy"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMX94HD08Y0H66AQJBQWE": {
                        "code": "COA 13.2",
                        "commitment": "Security Form and CESA Mitigation Funding Strategy",
                        "name": "Submit Periodic Updates to Mitigation Funding Strategy",
                        "text": "Permittee shall submit detailed updates to the strategy to CDFW for review and approval as part of\nany Phase Authorization Package. If a Phase will exceed three years, the strategy shall be updated\nand submitted to CDFW for review and approval every three years. These updates shall include\nextension of the detailed funding strategy for five (5) years post submission date, and shall include a\ndescription of expenditures to date for compliance with Conditions of Approval 12.1 through 12.8. To the…",
                        "type": "Financial",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3EPKKKVFDBN1YQGB0HW",
                            "name": "Submit and Update the CESA Mitigation Funding Strategy"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMX94HD08Y0H66AQJBQWF": {
                        "code": "COA 13.2",
                        "commitment": "Security Form and CESA Mitigation Funding Strategy",
                        "name": "Submit Fish Monitoring and Science Funding Strategy",
                        "text": "With submittal of the draft Covered Fish Species Monitoring and Science Plan, Permittee shall\nprovide a funding strategy for CDFW review and approval, which shall include costs associated with 1) planning and implementing required studies and monitoring, and 2) costs associated with\npreparing and submitting required reports.",
                        "type": "Financial",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3EPKKKVFDBN1YQGB0HV",
                            "name": "Submit Covered Fish Monitoring Funding Strategy to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMXB5BDGZN1PNZT41YB2F": {
                        "code": "COA 13.3",
                        "commitment": "Demonstration of Performance",
                        "name": "Demonstrate Funding Arrangements Before Impacts to Covered Species",
                        "text": "Before incurring impacts to Covered Species, Permittee shall demonstrate to CDFW that Covered\nSpecies’ requirements have been satisfied, as evidenced by: • Receipt by CDFW of a copy of the contract(s) entered into or arrangement made to satisfy California Water Code, section 85089, subdivision (a); • Receipt by CDFW of documentation, acceptable to CDFW, demonstrating that subsequent financial agreements, entered into to cover repayment of Project-related\nbonds, explicitly identify funding for…",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3RC1N589S9ETAS5HQK2",
                            "name": "Demonstrate Project Funding Arrangements to CDFW"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMXB61WXZTSWY83SJ53JY": {
                        "code": "COA 13.3",
                        "commitment": "Demonstration of Performance",
                        "name": "Provide Ongoing Demonstration of Mitigation Performance",
                        "text": "During the permit term, Permittee shall demonstrate to CDFW that Covered Species’ requirements\nhave been satisfied on an ongoing basis and consistent with the requirements of Condition of\nApproval 12, as evidenced by: • Written documentation of the acquisition of the HM lands; • Copies of all executed and recorded conservation easements; • Written confirmation from the approved Endowment Manager of its receipt of the full Endowment, if required; and • Timely submission of all required reports.",
                        "type": "Reporting",
                        "actions": []
                      },
                      "req_01M2ESMXB61WXZTSWY83SJ53JZ": {
                        "code": "COA 13.3",
                        "commitment": "Demonstration of Performance",
                        "name": "Complete HM Lands Acquisition and Easement Recording Before Covered Activities",
                        "text": "Permittee must complete the required acquisition, protection and transfer of all HM lands and record\nany required conservation easements prior to commencing Covered Activities as specified in\nCondition of Approval 12. CDFW may require the Permittee to provide additional HM lands and/or\nadditional funding to ensure the impacts of the taking are minimized and fully mitigated, as required\nby law, if the Permittee does not complete these requirements within the specified timeframe.",
                        "type": "Restoration & Mitigation",
                        "actions": [
                          {
                            "id": "act_01M2G6Y3V2EGJHQX6564T66396",
                            "name": "Complete Mitigation and HM Lands Protection Before Impacts"
                          }
                        ]
                      }

    ><div slot="header" class="bcn-gd-article__head">
      <button type="button" class="bcn-gd-article__back" data-gd-article-back="">
